title: Dholuo Bible (Biblica)
method: Candidate names, not names. For each Strong's lemma the KJV concordance gives the verses it is tagged in; every word in those same verses of Dholuo Bible (Biblica) is scored by count × lift over its frequency in that Bible, forms sharing 5+ consecutive characters counted as one word, and a candidate is kept only where it beats the runner-up by 2×. This measures how one translation uses a word. It is not a translation, not a definition, and not published to any reader until a person confirms it.
morphology: Forms are grouped from five shared characters where the language inflects; the form shown is the one this translation prints most often.

lines.t: To jo-Farisai kod jogo molony e chik nodagi dwaro mar Nyasaye kuomgi giwegi, nikech ne pok obatisgi gi Johana.)
ngʼat mane ok oyie kod dwaro gi timbegi. Noa e dala mar Judea mar Arimathaya kendo norito biro mar pinyruoth Nyasaye.
“Nimar kane Daudi osetimo dwaro Nyasaye e ndalone, to notho moike kama noyike kwerene, mi ringre notowo,
To kane owinjo ni Arkelao nobet e loch e piny Judea kar wuon-gi ma Herode, noluoro dok kuno. Kaka nosesieme e lek, noloko wuoth modhi e gwengʼ mar Galili,
Eka Yesu nobiro koa e piny Galili nyaka e aora Jordan mondo Johana obatise.
Ka Yesu nowinjo ni Johana oseter e od twech, nodok Galili.

An to awachonu ni ngʼato angʼata moriembo chiege nikech wach moro amora makmana richo mar terruok, miyo chiegeno donjo e richo mar terruok, kendo ngʼato angʼata mokendo dhako makamano bende donjo e richo mar terruok.
Anyisou ni dichwo moro amora moketho keny gi chiege, makmana ne wach chode, mi okendo dhako machielo, to otimo richo mar terruok.”
To Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Ngʼato angʼata mowere gi chiege mokendo dhako machielo odonjo e richo mar terruok nikech chiege moriembono.
“En angʼo ma dapimgo tiengʼni? Gichalo nyithindo mobet e chirni kendo maluongo jowetegi kagiwacho niya,
Jo-Nineve biro chungʼ e bura kaachiel gi tiengʼni kendo nongʼadnegi bura kaka joketho; nimar gin ne giweyo richo kane giwinjo yalo mar Jona, to sani koro nitie ngʼato maduongʼ moloyo Jona.

Ruoth ma dhako mar piny ma milambo nochungʼ chiengʼ bura kaachiel gi tiengʼni kendo nongʼadne bura kaka jaketho, nimar nobiro koa e tungʼ piny kuma bor mondo owinj rieko Solomon, to sani koro nitie ngʼato ka maduongʼ moloyo Solomon.
to Jakobo ne en wuon Josef mane chwor Maria mane onywolo Yesu, miluongo ni Kristo.

Bangʼe Nyasaye notimo gi Ibrahim singruok kowacho ni yawuowi nyaka ter nyangu. Kane Ibrahim onywolo wuode ma Isaka, notere nyangu bangʼ ndalo aboro kosenywole. Achien Isaka nonywolo Jakobo, kendo Jakobo bende nodoko wuon kwerewa apar gariyo.
Kane Musa owinjo wachno, noringo odhi Midian, kama nodakie kaka japiny moro mi onywolo yawuowi ariyo.
“ ‘To in, Bethlehem, manie piny Juda, ok itin ngangʼ e dier jotelo mag Juda; nikech kuomi ema jatelo mabiro kwayo joga ma jo-Israel biro ae.’”
kendo nowachone niya, “Aa malo ikaw nyathi kod min mare mondo idhi e piny Israel, nikech joma netemo kawo ngima nyathi osetho.”
Omiyo noa malo, mokawo nyathi gi min mare, kendo nodhi e piny Israel.
Nodwokogi niya, “Un osemiu rieko mar ngʼeyo tiend gik mopondo mag pinyruodh polo, to gin ok osemigi.
to gokinyi to uwacho ni, ‘Kodh yamo maduongʼ wangʼ nochwe nikech polo mamarmar kendo dudo.’ Ulony kuom rango chal mar polo, to ok unyal ngʼeyo ranyisi mag kit ndalo.
Nowachonigi niya, “Un osemiu rieko mar ngʼeyo tiend gik mopondo mag pinyruoth Nyasaye. To joma moko, to iwuoyogo gi ngeche
Ma e kaka anywola mar Yesu Kristo ma wuod Daudi kendo wuod Ibrahim chalo:
Ibrahim ne en wuon Isaka, Isaka ne en wuon Jakobo, to Jakobo ne en wuon Juda gi owetene.

Kamano tienge duto mane nitie chakre Ibrahim nyaka Daudi ne gin apar gangʼwen; to chakre Daudi nyaka ndalo twech e Babulon ne tienge apar gangʼwen kendo chakre ndalo twech nyaka kinde mag Kristo bende ne tienge apar gangʼwen.
kendo imi joge ngʼeyo wach mar warruok kuom weruok mar richogi,
bende ni itayo joma ofuwo, kendo ni in japuonj nyithindo nikech Chik ma in-go otingʼo ngʼeyo kod adiera.
Yaye mano kaka mwandu kendo rieko gi ngʼeyo mar Nyasaye tut miwuoro! Mano kaka buchene oyombo parowa, kendo yorene fwenyo tek!
Kane oseluongo jodolo madongo gi jopuonj chik duto mane otelo ne ji, nopenjogi kama nowinjore nywolie Kristo, Mesia.
Nimar awachonu ni ka ok ber maru oyombo mano mar jo-Farisai gi mar jopuonj chik to ok unudonji e pinyruodh polo ngangʼ.
Kuom mano jopuonj chik moko nowacho kendgi giwegi niya, “Ngʼatni yanyo Nyasaye!”
Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Donge usesomo Ndiko mawacho niya, “ ‘Kidi mane jogedo odagi osedoko kidi motegno moriwo kor ot, Jehova Nyasaye ema osetimo mano, kendo en gima iwuoro ka waneno?’
Yesu nodwokogi kawacho niya, “Ukoso nikech ukia Ndiko kata teko Nyasaye.
Ndiko dichop kare nade mawacho ni gigo nyaka timre kaka gitimore sani?”
Wuowi moro matin mane ni duk, mane orwako law abola, noyudo luwo bangʼ Yesu. Kane gi liwe mi gimake, nopusore nigi,
moringo otony ka en duk, moweyo nyaka sukane kanyo.
nikech ka waserwakore kode, to ok bi yudwa duk.
Anto anyisou ni ngʼato angʼata morango dhako gi gombo oseterore kode gi ei chunye.

An to awachonu ni ngʼato angʼata moriembo chiege nikech wach moro amora makmana richo mar terruok, miyo chiegeno donjo e richo mar terruok, kendo ngʼato angʼata mokendo dhako makamano bende donjo e richo mar terruok.
To apoya nono, dhako moro mane osebedo ka iye chwer kuom higni apar gariyo nopore gi yo katoke kendo nomulo riak lawe.
Ji mangʼeny nowachna e odiechiengno ni, ‘Ruoth, Ruoth, donge ne wakoro wach e nyingi, kendo e nyingi donge ema ne wariembogo jochiende kendo watimogo honni mangʼeny?’
To jo-Farisai to nowacho niya, “Ogolo jochiende gi teko mar ruodh jochiende.”
Changuru joma tuo, chieruru joma otho, pwodhuru joma nigi dhoho, riemburu jochiende. Kaka useyudo wachni nono, un bende chiwuru nono.
mokwaye barupe mane nyalo miye teko mar donjo e sinagoke man Damaski, mondo ka oyudo joma luwo Yor Kristo, bed ni gin chwo kata mon, to omakgi otergi Jerusalem kaka joma otwe.
Kane oyudo owuotho ka ochiegni chopo Damaski, nopo ka ler moa e polo omenye molwore.
Saulo nochungʼ oa malo, to kane oyawo wengene, to ne ok onyal neno gimoro. Omiyo negimako bade kagitaye gitere Damaski.
Bende gihero kuonde ma imiyoe ji duongʼ e sewni kendo bedo e kombe moyiedhi manie sinagoke.

Achien thuolo nochopo mondo Herodia otim dwarone. Chiengʼ rapar mar nywol Herode nochopo, kendo ne oloso chiemo moyiedhi ne jotend ogandane madongo gi jotend jolweny mage kod jok midewo duto moa Galili.
Gihero bedo e kombe moyiedhi manie sinagoke, kod kuonde ma imiyoe ji duongʼ e sewni.
Le oseketi e tiend yiende kendo yien ka yien ma ok nyag olemo mabeyo ibiro tongʼ mi go piny kendo witi e mach.
Yath ka yath ma ok nyag olemo maber itongʼo igoyo piny kendo iwito e mach.
Le oseketi e tiend yiende, kendo yien ka yien ma ok nyag olemo mabeyo ibiro tongʼ mi go piny kendo witi e mach.”
Ka wangʼi ma korachwich miyo itimo richo to lodhe oko kendo iwite. Ber moloyo ka iwito fuon-ni achiel mar ringri moloyo ka ringri duto owiti e gehena.
Kamano bende ka lweti ma korachwich miyo itimo richo, to ngʼade oko iwite. Ber moloyo ka iwito fuon-ni achiel moloyo ka ringri duto odhi e gehena.
Anto anyisou ni kik utam ngʼat marach timo gima odwaro timo. Ka ngʼato othalo lembi ma korachwich to lokne komachielo bende,
To jopur puodho nomake, mogoye, moriembe gi lwete nono.
E kinde mar keyo nooro jatichne moro ir jopur puodho mondo gimiye olemo moko mane ochiek e puoth mzabibu. To jopur puodho nogoye kendo noriembe gi lwete nono.
Nochako ooro jatich machielo, to ngʼatni bende negigoyo kendo timo ne tim wichkuot, ka giriembe gi lwete nono.
To negisiko gikwaye mondo kik ochikgi gidhiyo e Bur Matut Maonge Gikone.
Eka malaika mar abich nogoyo turumbete, mine aneno sulwe moro mane oselwar e piny koa e polo. Sulweno ne omi kifungu mar bur matut maonge gikone.
Ruodhgi motelo nigi en malaika mar bur matut maonge gikone ma nyinge miluongego gi dho jo-Hibrania en Abadon, to gi dho jo-Yunani en Apoluon (tiende ni Ngʼat maketho gik moko).
“Ngʼat morwakou orwaka, kendo ngʼama orwaka, orwako jal ma noora.
“Ngʼato angʼata morwako achiel kuom nyithindo matindogi e nyinga, orwaka An awuon, to bende ngʼato angʼata morwaka ok An ema orwaka, to orwako jal mane oora.”
Awachonu adier ni ngʼato ma ok orwako pinyruoth Nyasaye kaka nyathi matin ok nodonji ngangʼ.”
“Koso, ere kaka ngʼato nyalo monjo od ngʼat maratego mi omaye gige odhigo, ka ok otweyo ngʼatno mokwongo? Kosetimo kamano eka dohedhre mar yako gik moko e odno.
Chutho onge ngʼat manyalo monjo od ngʼat maratego mi omaye gige odhigo ka ok otweyo ngʼatno mokwongo. Kosetimo kamano eka dohedhre mar yako gik moko e odno.
Kuom ranyisi, dhako mokendi Chik otweyo gi chwore mana ka chwore pod ngima; to ka chwore otho, to ogonye e chik mar kend.
“To bangʼ ka jatijno nosedhi, noyudo achiel kuom jotich wetene mane nigi gope moromo dinari mia achiel. Nomake matek mochako deye, kowachone ni, ‘Chula gopa ma in-go sani!’
Nowinjore kodgi ni nobiro chulogi dinari achiel ngʼato ka ngʼato kuom odiechiengʼno, eka noorogi e puothe mar mzabibu.
“Jotich mane ondiki kar sa apar gachiel odhiambo nobiro kendo moro ka moro kuomgi noyudo dinari achiel.
Eka Satan noweye, kendo malaike nobiro motiyone.
Nomulo lwete mi midhusi noweye, kendo noa malo mochako miyogi chiemo.
Omiyo Yesu nodhi ire, momako lwete kokonye mondo ochungʼ. Midhusi noweye kendo nochungʼ mochako miyogi chiemo.
Kane Sila gi Timotheo obiro koa Makedonia, Paulo nochiwore ni tich mar lando Injili kende ma ok oriwo gi gimachielo; kotimo neno ne jo-Yahudi ni Yesu e Kristo.
Asenyiso jo-Yahudi kaachiel gi jo-Yunani ni nyaka gilokre giwe richogi kendo gidwog ir Nyasaye kendo giyie kuom Ruodhwa Yesu.

To kata obedo kamano, ok akwan ngimana ka gima lichna; gima ochuna maduongʼ en mana tieko ngʼweya kendo chopo tich ma Ruoth Yesu osemiya mondo atim, ma en tich mar lando Injili mar ngʼwono mar Nyasaye.
Ka en tiyo ni ji, to mondo oti, ka en puonj, to mondo opuonji.
Koro ok wanachak wabed kaka nyithindo mayom yom, ma bagni koni gi koni nikech yamb puonj mayoreyore, ma dhano molal siekogo mondo giwuondwago kendo gigolwago oko e yie madiera.
Giduto gin gik malal nono, nikech gin mana chike gi puonj mag dhano.
Eka japuonj chik nobiro ire mowachone niya, “Japuonj, abiro luwi kamoro amora midhiye.”
Eka jo-Farisai moko gi jopuonj chik nowachone niya, “Japuonj wadwaro neno hono mitimo kaka ranyisi.”
Eka ngʼat moro nobiro ir Yesu mopenje niya, “Japuonj, en angʼo maber monego atim mondo eka ayud ngima mochwere?”
Eka negiwinjo tiend wach ni kare ne ok owachnegi ni giritre kuom thowi mitedogo makati, to ni mondo giritre kuom puonj jo-Farisai gi jo-Sadukai.
Jogo duto nowuoro ahinya, magipenjore niya, “Ma to en angʼo? Puonj manyien kendo man-gi teko! Ngʼatni chiko koda ka jochiende kendo giwinje.”
Joma oyie kuom Kristo noketo chunygi kuom puonj joote, kendo kuom lalruok, gi ngʼingo makati kod lamo.
Yesu nodwoko niya, “We otimre kamano sani; en gima ber ne an kodi mondo watim ma, eka wachop tim makare duto.” Eka Johana noyie.
Ogwedh jogo makech kayo kendo riyo mar tim makare oloyo, nimar gibiro yiengʼ.
Joma isando nikech tim makare gin joma ogwedhi, nimar pinyruodh polo en margi.
(Ji duto, kata mana jasol osuru, kane giwinjo weche Yesu, ne giyie ni yor Nyasaye ni kare, nikech nosebatisgi gi Johana.
Nowachonegi niya, “Un ema utimoru joma kare e wangʼ ji, to Nyasaye ongʼeyo chunyu. Gima okaw ni ber ahinya gi ji, kuom Nyasaye en gima kwero.
“Awachonu ni ngʼatni, ma ok ngʼat machielono, nodhi dala ka en kare e nyim Nyasaye. Nimar ngʼato angʼato matingʼore malo kende nodwok piny, to ngʼat madwokore piny notingʼ malo.”

Nowachonegi niya, “Boluru gogo mau yo bat korachwich mar yie, to ubiro mako rech.” Kane gitimo kamano, ywayo gogo nyaka ei yie notamogi, nikech rech ne ngʼeny mohewogi ywayo.
Ogwedh jogo makech kayo kendo riyo mar tim makare oloyo, nimar gibiro yiengʼ.
Nimar ne adenyo to ne umiya gimoro achamo; riyo noloya, to ne umiya gimoro amodho; ne an wendo; kendo nurwaka ei ot;
“Eka joma karego nodwoke ni, ‘Ruoth, karangʼo mane wanenie kidenyo mi wamiyi chiemo, kata ka riyo oloyi, mi wamiyi gimoro imodho?
Iwacho ni ingʼeyo gima Nyasaye dwaro, kendo inyalo pogo gima ber moloyo nikech isepuonjori chik.
Omiyo gimoro amora ma iyie e chunyi kuom wechegi ni ber keti obedni malingʼ-lingʼ e kindi gi Nyasaye. Ogwedh ngʼatno ma chunye ok ngʼadne bura kuom gima oparo ni ber.
Ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka non wuodhe owuon eka doyud gima dopakrego kuom tich maber mosetimo kik ipiem gi ngʼat machielo,
Eka Satan nokawe, motere nyaka ewi got moro mabor ahinya, kendo nosiemone pinjeruodhi mag piny gi duongʼ mane gin-go.
Nimar Wuod Dhano nodwogi e duongʼ mar Wuon mare kaachiel gi malaikege, kendo chiengʼno enomi ngʼato ka ngʼato pokne kaluwore gi gima osetimo.

Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Awachonu adier ni chiengʼ ma nolokie gik moko duto manyien, ka Wuod Dhano nobed e kom lochne man-gi duongʼ, un musebedo ka uluwa bende unubed e kombe mag loch apar gariyo, kungʼado bura ne ogendini apar gariyo mag Israel.
Nyasaye nowuoyo kode kawacho ni, ‘Nyikwayi nobed jodak e piny moro ma ok margi, kendo nolokgi wasumbini mi nosandgi malit kuom higni mia angʼwen.
Osewenu richou mi koro udoko wasumbini ni tim makare.
To ka koro osegonyu kuom richo mi ubedo wasumbini mag Nyasaye, ohala muyudo kelo ngima maler ma gikone en ngima mochwere.
Iwe noywayo achiel kuom adek mar sulwe manie polo mi opudho kendo owitogi e piny. Thuol mangʼongono nochungʼ e nyim dhakono mane chiegni nywol, mondo ocham nyathine kosenywole.
Eka lweny nochakore e polo. Mikael gi malaike mage nokedo gi thuol malichno, to thuol mangʼongono gi malaike mage bende nokedo kodgi.
To kane thuol mangʼongono oneno ni osewite modire e piny, ne olawo dhako mane onywolo nyathi ma wuowi cha.
Kendo kik upar e kindu uwegi ni, ‘Wan gi Ibrahim kaka wuonwa.’ Awachonu ni kata mana kuom kitegi Nyasaye nyalo loko nyithind Ibrahim.
En ngʼa kuomu ma parruok moparorego nyalo miyo omed bedo mangima kata mana kuom sa achiel kende?
To Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Ere kaka welo mag wuon kisera nyalo kuyo adier kapod en kodgi? Kata kamano ndalo nobi ma wuon kisera nogol e kindgi; eka ginitwe chiemo e kindeno.
To apoya nono, dhako moro mane osebedo ka iye chwer kuom higni apar gariyo nopore gi yo katoke kendo nomulo riak lawe.
Noluongo jopuonjrene apar gariyo ire, mi omiyogi teko mondo giriemb jochiende kuom ji, kendo gichang kit midekre gi tuoche duto.
Bangʼ ka Yesu nosetieko tiego jopuonjrene apar gariyo, nodhi nyime koa kanyo mondo opuonj kendo oyal e mier mag Galili.
Nimar awachonu ni ka ok ber maru oyombo mano mar jo-Farisai gi mar jopuonj chik to ok unudonji e pinyruodh polo ngangʼ.

Nodwoko kowacho niya, “Nikech un gi yie matin nono. Awachonu adier ni ka un gi yie matin marom gi koth karadali to unyalo wacho ne godni ni, ‘Wuogi ia ka idhi kacha,’ kendo dowuogi modhi. Onge gima nyalo tamou. [
Eka nowacho niya, “Awachonu adier ni ka ok ulokoru ma uchalo gi nyithindo matindo, to ok ubi donjo e pinyruodh polo ngangʼ.
mi nowachone joritne niya, “Ngʼatno nyaka bed Johana ja-Batiso. Nyaka bed ni osechier oa kuom joma otho! Mano emomiyo teko mar timo honni tiyo kuome.”
Omiyo gol chik mondo orit liel nyaka chiengʼ mar adek. Nono to jopuonjrene nyalo biro mi kwal ringre mi giwach ne ji ni osechier oa kuom joma otho. Miriambo machien-ni dibed marach moloyo mokwongo.”
Oonge ka; osechier, mana kaka nowacho. Biuru une kama noninde.
“Piny Zebulun gi piny Naftali, man Yor Nam modak loka aora Jordan, Galili mar joma ok jo-Yahudi,
Yesu nooro ji apar gariyogi gi ote machal kama: “Kik udhi e dier joma ok jo-Yahudi, kendo kik udonj e dala moro amora mar jo-Samaria.
To nikech nyinga, noteru e nyim jotelo gi ruodhi kendo nubednegi kaka joneno kaachiel gi joma ok jo-Yahudi.
“An abatisou gi pi mondo omi ulokru uwe richou. To ngʼato biro bangʼa ma oloya gi duongʼ, ma kata akande ok awinjora tingʼo. En obiro batisou gi Roho Maler kod mach.
Ja-Kenturo nodwoko kawacho niya, “Ruoth, ok awinjora ibi idonji ei oda. To wach mana wach kende, to jatichna biro chango.
Wach mane Johana yalo ne chal kama: “Ngʼat moro biro bangʼa ma oloya gi duongʼ, ok awinjora gonyo kata tond wuochene.
Ka dala mudonjeno en dala mowinjore, to kwe maru nodongʼne, to ka ok kamano, to kweuno noduognu.
“Kik upar ni asebiro mondo akel kwe e piny. Ne ok abiro mondo akel kwe, to nabiro mondo akel ligangla.
Yesu nowachone niya, “Nyara yieni osechangi. Dhi gi kwe kendo chandruokni mondo orum chuth.”

Ngʼato angʼata moketho achiel kuom chike matindoe mogik kuom Chikegi, kendo mopuonjo joma moko mondo otim kamano, nokaw kaka ngʼat matinie mogik e pinyruodh polo, to ngʼato angʼata maluwo kendo puonjo ji chikegi nokaw kaka ngʼama duongʼ e pinyruodh polo.

Kamano bende ka lweti ma korachwich miyo itimo richo, to ngʼade oko iwite. Ber moloyo ka iwito fuon-ni achiel moloyo ka ringri duto odhi e gehena.
Kane oseriemb ogandano oko, nodonjo mi okawo nyakono gi bade, kendo noa malo.
Donge nodonjo e od Nyasaye, kendo en kaachiel gi joma ne ni kode, negichamo makati ma nosepwodhi moket tenge, ma chik ne ok oyienegi mondo gitim, makmana jodolo kende
Yesu nodonjo ei hekalu mi noriembo oko joma ne ngʼiewo kendo uso gik moko kanyo. Noloko mesni mag jowil pesa ataro kod kombe mag joma ne uso akuche, kendo
“Awachonu bende ni ka ji ariyo kuomu e piny-ka owinjore kuom gimoro amora mukwayo to Wuora manie polo notimnugo.
Ka uyie to unuyud gimoro amora mukwayo kulamo.”
Kuom mano anyisou ni gimoro amora mukwayo kulamo, beduru gi yie ni useyude mi nobed maru adier.
Kodagi winjogi, to nyis kanisa wachno; to kodagi winjo nyaka kanisa, to kawe kaka dikaw ngʼat ma japiny kata jasol osuru.
Luoro maduongʼ nomako kanisa, kod ji duto mane owinjo gik mane otimore.

Saulo mane oyudo ni kanyo noyie gi nek mar Stefano. Kochakore chiengʼno kanisa man Jerusalem nochako yudo sand malit kendo giduto negiringo mi gikere e pinje mag Judea gi Samaria, makmana joote kende ema nodongʼ Jerusalem.
