Kane okinyi ochopo, noluongo jopuonjre ire kendo noyiero apar gariyo kuomgi, mane owalo obedo joote:
Nyasach jo-Israel noyiero kwerewa kendo nomiyo ginyaa e thuolo mane gidak Misri. Nyasaye notelonigi kagologi Misri kuno gi tekone maduongʼ;

kendo bangʼ kane gisewuoyo amingʼa, Petro nochungʼ malo mowachonegi kama: “Owetewa, ungʼeyo kaka kinde mosekalo Nyasaye noyiero e dieru mondo joma ok jo-Yahudi owinj Injili mi giyie kuom Yesu, ka an awuon ema ayalonegi.
To donge Nyasaye biro ngʼado bura kare ni joge moyier, maywakne odiechiengʼ gi otieno? Bende obiro tamore ma ok owinjogi?
Ji nochungo ka ngʼicho, to jotelo mopogore opogore bende nojare. Negiwacho niya, “Ne oreso jomoko, koro oresre owuon ka en e Kristo mar Nyasaye, Jalno Moyier.”
Achiki e nyim Nyasaye kendo e nyim Kristo Yesu, kaachiel gi malaika moyier, ni mondo ilu puonjgi adimba ma ok idewo wangʼ ngʼato kendo ma ok idok kor ngʼato angʼata.

Kane chwo mane wan-go osekete ei yie maduongʼ mane wantie, negitweyo yie gi tonde molwore mondo kik obarre. To nikech negiluor ni yie ne nyalo terogi kuonde mathany-thany motimo kuoyo man e dho nam mar Afrika, ne giloro nanga mar yie mi giweye mondo yamo otere atera.
To ochunore ni yie nyaka moki e chula moro.”
Luoro nomakowa ni dipo ka watwomo lwanda. Omiyo negibolo nanga angʼwen yo kachien yie, eka gilemo mondo piny oyawre.
Kane Yesu osetieko wacho gigi, oganda nowuoro puonjne,
Kane oganda owinjo wachneno, negihum gi puonjne.
Ji nowuoro puonjne, nikech nopuonjo ka ngʼat man-gi teko, to ok ka Jopuonj Chik.
Ka koro ne gichiegni chopo Jerusalem, bangʼ chopo Bethfage manie Got Zeituni, Yesu nooro jopuonjrene ariyo,
Kane oyudo Yesu obet ewi Got Zeituni Jopuonjre nobiro ire mopenje lingʼ-lingʼ niya, “Wachnwa ane, gigi biro timore karangʼo, kendo angʼo mabiro bedo ranyisi mar bironi kod mar giko mar ndalo?”
Kane gisewero wend pak, ne giwuok gidhi nyaka e Got Zeituni.
Ngʼato ka ngʼato matimo richo ok dwar ler, kendo ok odwar donjo ei ler, nikech oluor ni dipo ka timbene ongʼere.
Ka obiro, nopuonj piny mondo ongʼe tiend richo, tim makare kod kum mabiro.
Joma osiko timo richo nyaka kwer ratiro e nyim ji eka joma moko obed maluor.
Kechne chopo kuom jogo moluore chakre tiengʼ ka tiengʼ.
kendo joma ok jo-Yahudi omi Nyasaye duongʼ kuom kechne, mana kaka ondiki niya, “Emomiyo anapaki e kind ogendini, kendo anawer wende mapako nyingi.”
To kuom hera maduongʼ mane Nyasaye oherowago kod kechne mogundho,
ni chwech duto chiengʼ moro nowe thuolo mondo kik gitow to giyud thuolo maduongʼ ma nyithind Nyasaye nigo.
Tim kamano mar konyo chuny ngʼatno, to ok nikech konyruokni. Ere gima omiyo paro manie chuny ngʼat machielo ema mona timo gima aneno ni an gi thuolo mar timo?
Koro Ruoth e Rohonogo; kendo kama Roho mar Ruoth nitie, thuolo nitie.
Petro nodwoko niya, “Kuom jomoko.” Yesu nowachone niya, “Ka kamano to kare nyithindo ni thuolo.
To negidwoke niya, “Wan koth Ibrahim kendo pok ne wabedo wasumb ngʼato nyaka nene. Ere gima omiyo iwachonwa ni ibiro miyowa wabed thuolo.”
Omiyo ka Wuowi ema omiyo ubedo thuolo, to ubiro bedo thuolo chutho.
Eka ngʼat moro nobiro ir Yesu mopenje niya, “Japuonj, en angʼo maber monego atim mondo eka ayud ngima mochwere?”
Kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato moseweyo ode, kata owetene kata nyiminene, kata wuoro kata min, kata nyithindo, kata puothe nikech an, noyud gigo nyadi mia, kendo nocham ngima mochwere.
“Eka gini aa kanyo mi gidonji e kum mochwere, to joma kare e ngima mochwere.”
E ndalo ma Herode ne ruodh Judea, ne nitie jadolo ma nyinge Zekaria, ma ne en achiel kuom oganda jodolo mag Abija; chiege Elizabeth bende ne nyar dhood Harun.
To ne gionge gi nyithindo, nikech Elizabeth ne migumba, kendo ji ariyogo ne hikgi oseniangʼ.
To malaika nowachone ni: “Kik ibed maluor, Zekaria; lamoni osewinji chiegi Elizabeth biro nywoloni wuowi, kendo inichake Johana.
Jo-Yahudi nowacho e kindgi giwegi niya, “Ngʼatni dwadhi kune ma ok wanyal yudee? Dibed ni odwaro dhi kuma jowa odakie ka gikere e dier jo-Yunani mondo opuonj jo-Yunani?
Koro ne nitie jo-Yunani moko kuom joma ne biro lemo e Sawono.
Paulo nowuotho mochopo Derbe gi Lustra, kama japuonjre moro nodakie miluongo ni Timotheo. Min Timotheo ne ja-Yahudi moyie kuom Yesu, to wuon-gi ne ja-Yunani.
Emomiyo chunya mor kendo lewa yot; ringra bende nobed gi geno,

Kaka Paulo nongʼeyo ni moko kuom jogo ne gin jo-Sadukai, to moko jo-Farisai, nokok ne bura mar Sanhedrin kowacho niya, “Owetena, an ja-Farisai kendo an wuod ja-Farisai. Achungʼ kae kawuono mondo oyala nikech geno ma an-go kuom chier mar joma otho!”
kendo an-gi geno kuom Nyasaye machalre gi jogi, ni nitie chier moikne joma beyo kod joma richo.
“Ngʼat morwakou orwaka, kendo ngʼama orwaka, orwako jal ma noora.
Kendo ngʼato angʼata morwako nyathi machal kama e nyinga to an ema orwaka.
“Ngʼato angʼata morwako achiel kuom nyithindo matindogi e nyinga, orwaka An awuon, to bende ngʼato angʼata morwaka ok An ema orwaka, to orwako jal mane oora.”
To kit olemo ma ginyago ema ubiro ngʼeyogigo. Bende ji pono olemb mzabibu e yiend kudho, kata olemb ngʼowu kuom oriangʼ?
Kodhi moko nolwar e kind kudho, to kudhogo nodongo, mine githungʼo chamgo.
Kodhi mane olwar e kind kudho to ochungʼ kar ngʼat mawinjo wach, to parruok kuom ngima mar pinyni gi wuond ma mwandu kelo thungʼo wachno kendo mone nyak.
“Emomiyo awachonu ni, kik uparru kuom ngimau, kata kuom gik ma ubiro chamo kata madho; kata kuom dendu kata gik ma ubiro rwako. Donge ngima duongʼ moloyo chiemo, koso del donge duongʼ moloyo lewni?
Johana norwakore gi lewni molos gi yie ngamia kendo notweyo kamba mar pien e nungone. Nochamo bonyo kod mor kich manie thim.
Malaike abiriyo motingʼo masiche abiriyo nowuok e hekalu. Ne girwakore gi lewni maler mapakni kendo manyilni to negitweyo okanda mar dhahabu e korgi.
Omiyo negidhi. “Nochako owuok oko kar sa auchiel gi sa ochiko kendo notimo kaka notimo mokwongo.
Chakre sa auchiel mar odiechiengʼ nyaka sa ochiko, mudho nobiro moimo piny duto.
To kar sa ochiko, Yesu noywak gi dwol maduongʼ kowacho niya, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakthani?” (ma tiende ni, “Nyasacha, Nyasacha, iweya nangʼo?”).
Singruok mane Nyasaye otimono en maru kaachiel gi nyithindu; kendo en mar ji duto modak kuma bor, ma gin jogo duto ma Ruoth Nyasachwa noluong ire.”
“Kane ndalo ochopo mondo Nyasaye ochop singruok mane otimo ni Ibrahim, noyudo ka kar kwan jowa mane odak Misri ne osemedore.
To koro sani iyala nikech geno ma an-go kuom singruok mane Nyasaye otimo ne kwerewa.
Kane Ruoth Herode owinjo wachno, chunye nochandore, en kaachiel gi ji duto modak Jerusalem.
To kane owinjo ni Arkelao nobet e loch e piny Judea kar wuon-gi ma Herode, noluoro dok kuno. Kaka nosesieme e lek, noloko wuoth modhi e gwengʼ mar Galili,
Kane Yesu owinjo wach ngʼatno, nohum nono kendo nowachone joma ne luwo bangʼe niya, “Awachonu adier ni pok ayudo kata ngʼat achiel e piny Israel ma nigi yie maduongʼ machal kama.
To achien parruok kuom ngima mar pinyni gi wuond ma mwandu kelo kaachiel gi gombo mag pinyni ma gigombogo gik mathoth, thungʼo Wach mamone nyak.
Mano emomiyo Nyasaye nojwangʼogi e paro modwanyore ma chunygi ne gombo timo, ka giketho dendgi gi kit chode duto e kindgi ngʼato gi ngʼato.
To richo nokawo thuolo mane chik okelo mopidho kit gombo mayoreyore kuoma nimar ka chik onge to richo otho.
Nikech chuny jogi osedinore; gisedino itgi, kendo gisemiyo wengegi. Nono to dipo ka wengegi oneno, kendo itgi owinjo wach; mi chunygi ofwenyo tiend weche, kendo gidwog ira mi achang-gi.’
“Osedino wengegi kendo osemiyo chunygi odoko matek, mondo kik gine gimoro gi wengegi, kendo kik giwinj tiend weche gi chunygi, mi gilokre gidwog ira mi achang-gi.”

Mokwongo ne anyiso joma nodak Damaski kendo joma odak Jerusalem nyaka joma odak Judea duto kaachiel gi joma ok jo-Yahudi ka ayalonegi mondo gilokre giwe richo kendo gidwog ir Nyasaye, mondo ginyis ni giseweyo richo adier gi kit ngimagi.

Eka odok kendo oomo jochiende abiriyo mamoko maricho moloye, kendo gibiro gidonj mi gidag kanyo. Bangʼe achien ngima ngʼatno bedo marach moloyo kaka nochal mokwongo. Kamano e kaka biro timore ne tiengʼ marachni.”
Yesu nopenjogi niya, “Un gi makati adi?” Negidwoke niya, “Abiriyo kende gi rech matindo manok.”
Negichiemo giduto mi giyiengʼ. Bangʼ chiemo jopuonjre nochoko ngʼinjo mag chiemo mane ji ochamo oweyo moromo okepe abiriyo.
Weuru tiyo ni chiemo marumo, to tiuru ni chiemo masiko nyaka chop uyud ngima mochwere, ma Wuod Dhano biro miyou. Nyasaye Wuoro oseketo kido mare kuome manyiso ni oyie kode.”
Nyaka wati tije mag Jal mane oora ka pod piny odiechiengʼ, nikech otieno biro maonge ngʼama nyalo tiyo.
mi odak kodgi kendo tiyo kodgi nikech en bende ne en jatwangʼ hema mana kaka gin.
Eka nowachone jopuonjrene niya, “Cham ochiek mathoth to jotich nok.
Kuom mano, kwauru Ruodh keyo mondo oor jotich odhi e puothe mar keyo.”
“Kane ochopo odhiambo, wuon puoth mzabibu nowachone nyapache ni, ‘Luong jotich mondo ichulgi misachgi, kichako gi joma ne ondiki achien mogik, eka idok ir joma nondiki mokwongo.’
Un timbe wuonu ema utimo.” Ne gikone ka gikwere niya, “Wan ok wan kimirwa. Wuoro ma wan-go en Nyasaye owuon.”
Otieno chiegni rumo kendo ru piny chiegni. Omiyo waweuru timbe mag mudho, to wamanreuru gi gige lweny mag ler.
Timbe mag ringruok nenore ratiro, gin kaka: chode, timbe mochido, anjawo,
E ndalogo Johana ja-Batiso nobiro, koyalo e thim mar Judea,
Ma e jalno mane owuo kuome gi dho janabi Isaya niya, “Ngʼat moro kok e thim ni, ‘Losuru yo ne Jehova Nyasaye, losneuru yore moriere tir.’ ”
Eka Roho Maler notelo ne Yesu nyaka e thim mondo Satan oteme.
Gipongʼ gi kit timbe mamono duto, gi richo, gi wuoro kod timbe mobam. Bende gipongʼ gi ich lit, gi nek, gi dhawo, gi wuond kod himruok. Gin jokuoth,
Wadaguru e ngima mobidhore kaka joma ni e ler mar odiechiengʼ, ka waweyo kit richo duto kaka, tugo e thum, mer, terruok, anjawo, dhawo kod nyiego.
Jowetena, jood Kloe moko osekelona wach ni nitie dhawo e dieru.
Kane jo-Farisai oneno mano, negipenjo jopuonjrene niya, “Angʼo momiyo japuonju chiemo gi josol osuru kod joricho?”
Wuod Dhano nobiro ka chiemo kendo metho, to uwacho ni, ‘Neyeuru jawuoro kendo jamer mosiep josol osuru gi joricho.’ To rieko ifwenyo adimba kuom timbene.”
mi ochako goyo jotich wetene, kendo owere ne chiemo gi metho kaachiel gi jomer,
To kata kamano, un ok chiku gi kido mar richo, to Roho ema chikou, ka en adier ni Roho mar Nyasaye odak eiu. Kendo ka ngʼato onge gi Roho mar Kristo ok en ngʼat Kristo.
Donge ungʼeyo ni un uwegi un e hekalu mar Nyasaye, kendo ni Roho mar Nyasaye odak eiu?
Donge ungʼeyo ni ringreu en hekalu mar Roho Maler modak eiu kendo ma Nyasaye osechiwonu? Ok un mau uwegi;
“Onge jatich manyalo tiyo ne ruodhi ariyo. Nimar obiro chayo achiel to ohero machielo, kata obiro chiwore ne achiel to ochayo machielo. Ok inyal tiyo ne Nyasaye kendo ne pesa.
Japuonjrene machielo nowachone niya, “Ruoth, yiena adhi ayik wuonwa mondi.”
mondo openje niya, “In e jalno mane onego obi, koso warit ngʼat machielo?”
To apoya nono, dhako moro mane osebedo ka iye chwer kuom higni apar gariyo nopore gi yo katoke kendo nomulo riak lawe.
To dhako moro ne ni kanyo mane osebedo ka iye chwer kuom higni apar gariyo.
Sano sano nyakono nochungʼ malo mochako wuotho e dier ot (ne en ja-higni apar gariyo). Ji duto nohum nono kuom gima notimoreno.
Yesu nodhi e piny Galili duto, kopuonjo e sinagokegi, koyalo Injili mar pinyruoth kendo kochango kit tuoche gi midekre duto e dier ji.
Yesu nodhi kuonde duto, e mier matindo kod gwenge duto, kopuonjo e sinagokegi, koyalo Injili mar pinyruoth, kendo kochango kit midekre gi tuoche duto.
Ma e chakruok mar Injili mar Yesu Kristo Wuod Nyasaye.
Ma e jalno mane owuo kuome gi dho janabi Isaya niya, “Ngʼat moro kok e thim ni, ‘Losuru yo ne Jehova Nyasaye, losneuru yore moriere tir.’ ”
“Ngʼat moro kok e thim niya, ‘Losuru yo ne Jehova Nyasaye, losneuru yo moriere tir.’ ”
Kaka nondiki e kitabu mar weche mag Isaya janabi niya: “Ngʼat moro kok e thim ni, ‘Losuru yo ne Jehova Nyasaye, losneuru yore moriere tir.
Oganda mane otelo nyime kod mago mane odongʼ chien nekok ni, “Hosana ne Wuod Daudi!” “Ogwedh ngʼat mabiro e nying Jehova Nyasaye!” “Hosana manie polo malo!”
Jogo mane otelo e nyim Yesu gi jopuonjrene, kod mago mane odongʼ chien, ne goyo koko niya, “Hosana!” “Ogwedh ngʼat mabiro e nying Jehova Nyasaye.”
“Ogwedh pinyruoth mabiro mar Daudi kwarwa!” “Hosana manie polo malo!”
Eka anawach gie chunya niya, “Chunya in-gi gik mangʼeny mabeyo misekano moromi kuom higni mangʼeny. Koro ywe, chiem, methi kendo bed mamor.” ’
Keluru nyarwath machwe uyangʼ. Wachamuru wabed mamor.
To nodwoko wuon mare ni, ‘Neye, hignigi duto asebedo katiyoni ka misumba kendo aserito chikeni. To eka pok imiyoa kata mana nyadiel mondo ayangʼ, abedgo mamor kod osiepena.
Bangʼ mano nokawo makati abiriyogo gi rechgo, kendo kane osegoyo erokamano, nongʼingogi bangʼe omiyogi jopuonjrene, mondo opog ji.
Bangʼe nokawo kikombe mi ogoyo erokamano bangʼe omiyogi kowacho niya, “Madhuru gima ni e iye, un duto.
Nowachone ogandago mondo obed piny e lum. Bangʼ mano nokawo makati abiriyogo, kendo kane osegoyo erokamano, nongʼingogi bangʼe omiyogi jopuonjrene mondo opog ji, mine gitimo kamano.
Kane gichopo Efeso, Paulo noweyo Priskila gi Akula. Nodonjo e sinagogi ka en kende en owuon ei sinagogi mi owuoyo kod jo-Yahudi mane ni kanyo.
To kane oweyogi mondo odhi, nowachonegi niya, “Ka en dwaro mar Nyasaye, to abiro duogo.” Bangʼe nokwangʼ oa Efeso.
E kindeno ja-Yahudi moro monywol Aleksandria, ma nyinge Apolo, nobiro Efeso. Ne en gi ngʼeyo matut e puonj mag Muma.
“ ‘Jehova Nyasaye nowachone Ruodha ni: “Bed e bada ma korachwich, nyaka chop aket wasiki e bwo tiendi.” ’
Ka Daudi owuon nowuoyo kuom teko mar Roho Maler kolero niya: “ ‘Ruoth nowachone Ruodha ni, “Bed e bada korachwich, nyaka aket wasiki e bwo tiendi.” ’
nyaka aket wasiki e bwo tiendi.” ’
Kuom mano, remo makare duto mosebedo kichwero e piny, chakre remb Abel nyaka remb Zekaria wuod Berekia, mane unego marach e kind hekalu gi kendo mar misango, ibiro keti ewiu.
E ndalo ma Herode ne ruodh Judea, ne nitie jadolo ma nyinge Zekaria, ma ne en achiel kuom oganda jodolo mag Abija; chiege Elizabeth bende ne nyar dhood Harun.
Kane Zekaria onene, ne obwok kendo luoro nomake.
Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ondiki ni, ‘Dhano ok bed mangima nikech chiemo kende, to nikech wach ka wach moa e dho Nyasaye.’”
Kane oyudo owacho wechegi, jatelo moro nobiro mokulore e nyime kawacho niya, “Nyara otho machiegni. To yie ibi iket lweti kuome mondo obed mangima.”
Simon Petro nodwoke niya, “In e Kristo, Wuod Nyasaye Mangima.”
Kane ochwalore nyime koa kanyo, noneno owete ariyo mamoko, Jakobo wuod Zebedi gi owadgi ma Johana. Ne gin e yie kaachiel gi wuon-gi ma Zebedi, ka giloso gokegi. Yesu noluongogi,
Magi e nying jopuonjre apar gariyogo: Mokwongo ne en Simon (miluongo ni Petro), gi owadgi ma Andrea; kod Jakobo wuod Zebedi gi owadgi ma Johana;
Eka min yawuot Zebedi nobiro ir Yesu kaachiel gi yawuote, kendo bangʼ goyo chong-gi piny e nyime, ne gikwaye ni otimnegie ngʼwono.
Eka jadolo maduongʼ gi joge, mane gin jokanyo mar buch jo-Sadukai, nyiego nomako.
To ka jo-Yahudi noneno ogandano, nyiego nomakogi mi gichako wuoyo marach kuom gik mane Paulo wacho.
Wadaguru e ngima mobidhore kaka joma ni e ler mar odiechiengʼ, ka waweyo kit richo duto kaka, tugo e thum, mer, terruok, anjawo, dhawo kod nyiego.
To kane oyudo ji duto nindo, jasike nobiro mopidho buya e dier ngano, bangʼe to odhi.
Ka ngano nodongo moiko wiyegi to buya bende nochako limbo.
“Jotij wuon puodho nobiro ire mowachone ni, ‘Jaduongʼ, donge ne ikomo kodhi mabeyo lilo e puothi? Ka kamano to buya to oa kure?’
Nochako ogoyonegi ngero machielo niya, “Pinyruodh polo chalo gi thowi mane dhako moro okawo kendo oruwo ei mogo mangʼeny mi bangʼe okuodo mogono.”
Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Beduru motangʼ kendo ritreuru ne thowi mar jo-Farisai gi jo-Sadukai.”
Ere kaka pod ok uwinjo ni ne ok awuo kodu kuom makati? To ritreuru kuom thowi mar jo-Farisai gi jo-Sadukai.”
To rangajno tin kendo yorno diny matero ji e ngima, kendo mana joma nok kende ema yude.

Ka lweti kata tiendi miyo idonjo e richo to ngʼade oko kendo iwite mabor. Ber moloyo kidonjo e ngima ka ionge lweti kata kingʼol moloyo bedo gi lwetegi ariyo kata tiendeni ariyo to owiti e mach manyaka chiengʼ.
Kamano bende ka wangʼi miyo itimo richo to lodhe oko kendo iwite mabor. Ber moloyo kidonjo e ngima gi wangʼ achiel kar bedo gi wenge ariyo to owiti e mach mar Gehena.
Eka joma kare norieny kaka wangʼ chiengʼ ei pinyruoth mar Wuon-gi. Ngʼat man-gi ite to mondo owinji.
Kane gin kuno kite nolokore ka gineno. Lela wangʼe norieny ka chiengʼ, kendo lepe nolokore rachar marieny ka ler.
“Gikanyono bangʼ chandruok maduongʼ mag ndalono, “ ‘wangʼ chiengʼ noimre, kendo dwe ok norieny; sulwe nolwar koa e polo, kendo chwech mag polo noyiengni.’
Wach nodoko dhano kendo nodak kodwa. Waseneno duongʼne, ma en duongʼ mar Wuowi ma Miderma, ma noa ka Wuoro kopongʼ gi ngʼwono kod adiera.
Chik nochiw kokalo kuom Musa, to ngʼwono kod adiera, to Yesu Kristo ema nokelo.
To ngʼato angʼata mawuotho e adiera donjo e ler, mondo onere maler ni gik motimo duto gin gik ma Nyasaye oyiego.”
Ruoth Nyasaye osemiyowa chik niya, “ ‘Asemiyo udoko ler ne Ogendini, mondo uland warruok e tunge piny duto.’”
To geno ok kuod wiwa, nikech Nyasaye oseolo herane ei chunywa kuom Roho Maler, ma osemiyowa.
Roho mwaseyudo ok en roho mar piny, to en Roho moa kuom Nyasaye, mamiyo wangʼeyo mich ma Nyasaye osemiyowa.

Nochopo kinde ma jopuonjre Johana kod jo-Farisai tweyo chiemo. Jomoko nobiro mopenjo Yesu: “Ere kaka Jopuonjre mag Johana kod jopuonjre mag jo-Farisai jotweyo chiemo to jopuonjreni to chiemo achiema?”
Sechego noyudo Yesu nindo ewi raten man kachien yie. Jopuonjre nochiewe kagiwachone niya, “Japuonj, donge litni ka watho?”
To jogo nonyiere anyiera. Kane osegologi oko duto, nokawo wuon nyathi gi min-gi kaachiel gi jopuonjre mane ni kode, mi odonjo kodgi nyaka iye kuma nyathi ne nitie.
Bangʼ kane osenywol Yesu e dala mar Bethlehem e piny Judea, e ndalo loch Ruoth Herode, Joma Riek moko moa yo wuok chiengʼ nobiro Jerusalem,
Kane Ruoth Herode owinjo wachno, chunye nochandore, en kaachiel gi ji duto modak Jerusalem.
Eka Herode noluongo ajuokego lingʼ-lingʼ, kendo ne ononogi, mi neginyise kinde nogono mane sulwe onenore.
“Piny Zebulun gi piny Naftali, man Yor Nam modak loka aora Jordan, Galili mar joma ok jo-Yahudi,
Kane oyudo Yesu wuotho e dho Nam Galili, noneno owete ariyo, Simon miluongo ni Petro gi owadgi ma Andrea. Noyudo gibolo gokgi e nam, nimar ne gin jolupo.
To apoya nono, ahiti mangʼongo notugore e nam, mi apaka nochako tago yie koni gi koni. To Yesu noyudo nindo otero.
joma odak e mudho oseneno ler maduongʼ; jogo modak e piny ma tipo mar tho oumo, ler oserienynegi.”
“Awachonu adier ni nitie jomoko mochungʼ buta ka ma ok nokal e tho kapok gineno Wuod Dhano kabiro gi pinyruodhe.”
“Eri wadhi nyaka Jerusalem, kendo Wuod Dhano ibiro ndhogi mi chiw e lwet jodolo madongo gi jopuonj chik. Gibiro ngʼadone buch tho,
“Ji duto ma luonga ni, ‘Ruoth, Ruoth,’ ok nodonji e pinyruodh polo, to mana ngʼama timo dwaro mar Wuora manie polo ema nodonji.
Nimar ngʼato angʼata matimo dwaro mar Wuora manie polo e owadwa gi nyaminwa kod minwa.”

Yesu nopenjogi niya, “Kuom yawuowi ariyogi, mane manotimo gima wuon-gi ne dwaro?” Negidwoke niya, “Wuowi mokwongo.” Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Awachonu adier ni josol osuru gi jochode kuongonu donjo e pinyruodh Nyasaye.
kendo ka ngʼato dwaro yalo kodi mondo okaw lawi mar akor to wene kotini bende.
Herode ne dwaro nego Johana, to noluoro oganda nikech ne gikawe kaka janabi.
Eka Yesu nowachone jopuonjrene niya, “Ka ngʼato dwaro luwo bangʼa to nyaka okwedre kende owuon kendo otingʼ msalape eka oluwa.
Ochalo gi ngʼat manogero ot, mane okunyo bur matut nyaka e lwanda kendo noketoe mise, kane koth ochwe ma pi opongʼo piny, apaka mogingore nogoyo odno to ne ok onyal yienge, nikech nogere motegno.
To jal mawinjo wechena to ok otimgi chalo gi ngʼat mane ogero ot ewi lowo maonge gi mise. E kindeno ma apaka mogingore nogoyo odno, nogore piny kendo nokethore chuth.”
Nimar ka oketo mise to ok onyal tieke, ji duto manene biro nyiere,
“Kik ukan mwandu ne un uwegi e piny kama olwenda gi nyal kethoe gik moko, kendo kama jokwoge turoe kendo kweloe.
To kanuru mwandu magu e polo kama olwenda kata nyal ok kethie gik moko kendo jokuo ok turie ma kwelie,
“Pinyruodh polo chalo gi mwandu mopandi e puodho, ma ngʼat moro nonwangʼo kendo nopando, eka noa kanyo kopongʼ gi mor kendo nodhi mouso gige duto mane en-go modwogo ongʼiewogo puodhono.
To nikech oonge gi tiendene, obet kuom kinde machwok kende. Ka chandruok gi sand obiro nikech Wach Nyasaye, to opodho piyo piyo nono.
To nikech gionge tiendegi Wach ok bedi eigi amingʼa. Ka chandruok kata sand obiro nigi nikech Wach Nyasaye to gipodho piyo piyo nono.
Joma sand nokeyo nikech wach nek Stefano nodhi Foinike, Saipras nyaka Antiokia, ka gilando Injili ne jo-Yahudi kende.
To kilamo to donji e odi maiye, ilor dhoot eka ilam Wuonu ma ok ne. Eka Wuonu maneno gima otim lingʼ-lingʼ nomiyi pokni.
Kata kamano, ka uneno gigi duto timore to ngʼeuru ni kindeno chiegni, kendo mana ka gima en e dhoot.
“To kane oyudo gin e yo gidhi ngʼiewo mafuta, wuon kisera nochopo. Nyiri mane oikore nodonjo kode e nyasi mar arus; kendo nolor dhoot.
Filipo gi Bartholomayo; Thoma gi Mathayo ma jasol osuru; Jakobo wuod Alfayo, gi Thadayo;
gi Andrea, Filipo, Bartholomayo, Mathayo; gi Thoma, Jakobo wuod Alfayo, Thadayo, Simon ma ja-Zilote,
Mathayo, Thoma, Jakobo wuod Alfayo, Simon mane iluongo ni ja-Zilote,
Owacho bende kamachielo niya, “In Jadolo nyaka chiengʼ koluwo kit dolo mar Melkizedek.”
Melkizedek mwawuoyo kuomeni ne en ruodh Salem kendo ne en jadolo mar Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo. Noromo gi Ibrahim ka Ibrahim noa e lweny mane oseloyoe ruodhi, mi nogwedhe,
Kaka Melkizedek ne onge gi wuon kata min kata anywolane bende ne oonge gi chakruokne kata gikone, En kaka Wuod Nyasaye, kendo tij dolo mare osiko nyaka chiengʼ.
Eka Satan notere nyaka dala maduongʼ maler, kendo nomiyo ochungo e osuch hekalu malo mogik.
Koso pok usomo e Chik ni chiengʼ Sabato, jodolo manie hekalu doko mogak odiechiengʼno, to ok kwan-gi kaka joketho?
To awachonu ni nitie ngʼato ka maduongʼ moloyo hekalu.
E dala mar Jopa ne nitie japuonjre moro miluongo ni Tabitha (ma dho jo-Yunani luongo bi Dorka tiende ni Nyakech) mane osiko katimo maber ni ji kendo nokonyo joma odhier.
Lida ne chiegni gi Jopa, omiyo ka jopuonjre nowinjo ni Petro ni kuno, ne giorone ji ariyo, ka gikwaye niya, “Yie ibi irwa piyo ma ok odeko!”
Wachni nolandore e Jopa duto, mi ji mangʼeny noyie kuom Ruoth.
Bangʼ kane osenywol Yesu e dala mar Bethlehem e piny Judea, e ndalo loch Ruoth Herode, Joma Riek moko moa yo wuok chiengʼ nobiro Jerusalem,
Negidwoke niya, “E Bethlehem manie piny Judea, nikech janabi nondiko kama:
To kane owinjo ni Arkelao nobet e loch e piny Judea kar wuon-gi ma Herode, noluoro dok kuno. Kaka nosesieme e lek, noloko wuoth modhi e gwengʼ mar Galili,
mi openjo niya, “Ere jal mosenywol mondo obed ruodh jo-Yahudi? Ne waneno sulwene yo wuok chiengʼ kendo wasebiro mondo walame.”
E thuolono Yesu nochungʼ e nyim ruoth, kendo ruoth nopenje niya, “In e ruodh jo-Yahudi koso?” To Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ee, en kaka iwachono.”
eka ne gikado osimbo mar kudho kendo gisidho e wiye. Negiketo odundu e lwete korachwich, eka gigoyo chong-gi piny e nyime, kendo negichako jare kagiwacho niya, “Misawa, ruodh jo-Yahudi!”
Simon ma ja-Zilote gi Judas Iskariot mane ondhoge.
Donge ngʼatni en wuod fundi bao-cha? Donge min-gi nyinge Maria, koso owetene donge gin Jakobo gi Josef gi Simon kod Judas?
Eka achiel kuom ji apar gariyogo, mane iluongo ni Judas Iskariot, nodhi ir jodolo madongo,
Kane Yesu pod wuoyo gi oganda mane ochokore, min-gi kaachiel gi owetene nochungʼ oko ka gidwaro wuoyo kode.
Omiyo Yesu nochungʼ kendo noluongogi ire, mopenjogi niya, “Angʼo mudwaro mondo atimnu?”
Bangʼ kinde matin, joma nochungʼ kanyo nodhi nyaka but Petro mowachone niya, “Ka iwacho adier, to in achiel kuomgi, nikech yo miwuoyogo huli e iro.”
Kata ka okwayo rech to omiye thuol?
To negidwoke niya, “Wan gima wan-go ka en mana makati abich gi rech ariyo kende.”
Eka nogolo chik mondo ji obed piny e lum. Bangʼe nokawo makati abichgo gi rech ariyogo, nongʼiyo polo malo, kogoyo erokamano. Nongʼingo makatigo mi nomiyo jopuonjre kendo jopuonjre nomiyogi ji.
E ndalogo Johana ja-Batiso nobiro, koyalo e thim mar Judea,
Lep Johana nochwe gi yie ngamia, kendo notweyo kamba mar pien e nungone. Chiembe ne gin bonyo gi mor kich mag bungu.
Eka Yesu nobiro koa e piny Galili nyaka e aora Jordan mondo Johana obatise.
To nodwokogi niya, “Tiengʼ ma timbene richo kendo mamono manyo ranyisi mar hono! To ok bi miye moro amora makmana ranyisi mar janabi Jona.
Nimar mana kaka Jona ne ni ei rech marangʼongo kuom ndalo adek odiechiengʼ gotieno, e kaka Wuod Dhano bende biro bedo ei chuny lowo kuom ndalo adek odiechiengʼ gotieno.
Jo-Nineve biro chungʼ e bura kaachiel gi tiengʼni kendo nongʼadnegi bura kaka joketho; nimar gin ne giweyo richo kane giwinjo yalo mar Jona, to sani koro nitie ngʼato maduongʼ moloyo Jona.
“Onge jatich manyalo tiyo ne ruodhi ariyo. Nimar obiro chayo achiel to ohero machielo, kata obiro chiwore ne achiel to ochayo machielo. Ok inyal tiyo ne Nyasaye kendo ne pesa.
“Ka uhero joma oherou kende, to en ohala mane muyudo? Kata mana joricho bende ohero mana joma oherogi.
nikech ohero pinywa kendo osegeronwa sinagogi.”
to Jakobo ne en wuon Josef mane chwor Maria mane onywolo Yesu, miluongo ni Kristo.
Kama e kaka nywol mar Yesu Kristo notimore: Noyudo min mare ma Maria osesingi ne Josef mondo okende, to kane pok gibedo kaachiel, noyude ka en gi ich kuom Roho Maler.
Nikech Josef chwore ne en ngʼat makare, kendo ne ok odwar ni okuod wiye e nyim ji, omiyo nochano e pache mar weye ma lingʼ-lingʼ.
Jo-Farisai ma muofnigi! Kuong ulwok i kikombe gi bakul, eka ngʼegi oko bende biro bedo maler.
Josef nokawo ringre Yesu moboye gi nanga maler marep-rep,
To chiwuru gima ni e bakul ne joma odhier, eka gik moko duto biro bedonu maler.
Eka jodolo madongo gi jodong oganda nochokore e dala jadolo maduongʼ, mane nyinge Kaifas,
Joma nomako Yesu nokawe motere nyaka ir Kaifas jadolo maduongʼ, kuma jopuonj chik kod jodongo noyudo osechokoree.
e kinde ma jodolo madongo ne gin Anas gi Kaifas, wach Nyasaye ne obiro ne Johana wuod Zekaria e thim.

Kamano bende, ji ok nyal olo divai manyien e piende moti mag tingʼo divai. Ka gitimo kamano to piendego biro barore, mi divai pukre oko, kendo piende mag tingʼo divai biro kethore. Ooyo, giolo divai manyien e piende mag tingʼo divai manyien, eka iritogi maber giduto kargi ariyo.”
Nowachonegi niya, “Kuom mano japuonj chik moro ka moro mosetiegi kuom wach pinyruodh polo chalo gi wuon ot magolo kuom gik mokano e deche, mwandu machon gi manyien.”
Anyisou ni ok anamadh olemb mzabibuni kendo, chakre kawuono nyaka chop odiechiengʼno ma anamadhee manyien, kaachiel kodu, e pinyruoth mar Wuora.”
Ngʼatni nodak kar yiko joma otho, kendo onge ngʼat mane nyalo make mi tweye kata mana gi nyororo.

Nimar noyudo Yesu osechiko jachien marachno mondo owuog kuom ngʼatno. Kuom kinde mangʼeny nomake, to kata nosetwe lwetene, gi tiendene gi nyororo, kendo okete e bwo jarit, nosebedo kochodo nyororo kendo jochiende ne riembe nyaka e thim.
Mano emomiyo asekwayo mondo ubi awuoye kodu matin. En mana nikech geno mar jo-Israel emomiyo otweya gi nyororo.”
Koro nyiswa ane, iparo nade? Bende en gima kare mondo wagol osuru ne Kaisar, koso ok owinjore?”
Negidwoke niya, “Gin mag Kaisar.” Eka nowachonegi niya, “Miuru Kaisar gige Kaisar, to miuru Nyasaye gige Nyasaye.”

Negibiro ire mi giwachone niya, “Japuonj wangʼeyo ni in ngʼama ja-ratiro. Ji ok nyal ywayi maloki nikech ok iluoro wangʼ ngʼato, to ipuonjo mana yor Nyasaye kaluwore gi adierane. Koro nyiswa ane, bende en gima kare mondo wagol osuru ne Kaisar koso ok owinjore?
Kane Yesu odonjo e gwengʼ mar Kaisaria man Filipi, nopenjo jopuonjrene niya, “Uwinjo ji wacho ni Wuod Dhano en ngʼa?”
Bangʼe Yesu gi jopuonjrene ne jowuok modhi e gwenge mag Kaisaria Filipi. To kane gin e yo gidhi, nopenjogi niya, “Uwinjo ji wacho ni An ngʼa?”
Filipo nopo kochopo e dala mar Azoto, kendo nowuotho koni gi koni, koyalo Injili e mier duto nyaka nochopo Kaisaria.

Humbe nolandore e piny Siria duto, kendo ji nokelone joma ne tuo gi kit tuoche mayoreyore gi joma ne nigi rem mapek gi joma ne nigi jochiende gi joma ne chunygi yudhore kod joma ne nigi athany, mi nochangogi.
Ka nochopo odhiambo, nokelne ji mathoth mane nigi jochiende, kendo noriembo jochiendego oko gi wach, bende nochango ji duto mane tuo.
Kane Yesu owinjo mano, nowachonegi niya, “Joma ngima ok ema dwar jathieth makmana joma tuo.
Kane oyudo jopuonjre Johana wuok mondo odogi, Yesu nochako wuoyo gi oganda kuom Johana kowacho niya, “Angʼo mane udhi mondo une e thim? Ne udhi neno odundu ma yamo tero koso?
Kata obedo ni onenore kaka odundu mayom yom to ok notur, kendo kata obedo ni oliel ka taya ma mirimiri to ok notho, nyaka chop otel ne adiera mi lochi.
eka ne gikado osimbo mar kudho kendo gisidho e wiye. Negiketo odundu e lwete korachwich, eka gigoyo chong-gi piny e nyime, kendo negichako jare kagiwacho niya, “Misawa, ruodh jo-Yahudi!”
kendo nodhi modak e dala miluongo ni Nazareth. Kamano gima nowachi gi dho janabi niya, “Enoluonge ni ja-Nazareth,” nochopo kare.
Mapiyo bangʼ mano, Yesu nodhi e dala miluongo ni Nain, to jopuonjrene gi oganda maduongʼ bende nodhi kode.
Ka joote noduogo neginyiso Yesu gima negisetimo. Eka nokawogi modhi kodgi ka gin kendgi giwegi e dala miluongo ni Bethsaida,
Nowuok Nazareth modhi odak Kapernaum, mane ni e dho nam e gwengʼ mar Zebulun gi Naftali,
Kane Yesu osedonjo ei Kapernaum, ja-Kenturo moro nobiro ire, kakwaye kony.
To in Kapernaum, bende ibiro tingʼori malo nyaka polo koso? Ooyo, ibiro lwar piny nyaka piny joma otho. Ka dine bed ni honni mane otim e iyi ne otim ei Sodom to dikoro pod entie nyaka kawuono.
Kaka Yesu nongʼeyo pachgi, nowachonegi niya, “Angʼo momiyo uyie mondo paro maricho obed e chunyu?
Kawuru lodina mondo utingʼ kendo puonjreuru kuoma, nimar chunya muol kendo ahora mos, eka unuyud yweyo ne chunyu.
Mana gisano Yesu nongʼeyo e chunye gima negipenjore e chunygi, omiyo nowachonegi niya, “Angʼo momiyo uparo gigi e chunyu?
Nyaguru olemo manyiso ni uselokoru uweyo richo.
Le oseketi e tiend yiende kendo yien ka yien ma ok nyag olemo mabeyo ibiro tongʼ mi go piny kendo witi e mach.
To kit olemo ma ginyago ema ubiro ngʼeyogigo. Bende ji pono olemb mzabibu e yiend kudho, kata olemb ngʼowu kuom oriangʼ?
Nikech timbe maricho nomedre, hera mar ji mangʼeny nodok mangʼich,
Onge hera maduongʼ ma ngʼato nyalo herogo osiepene moloyo chiwonegi ngimane.
Asehulonegi nyingi, kendo pod abiro medo nyiso ji ngʼama in, mondo hera miherago obed kuomgi, kendo an awuon bende abed kuomgi.”

Nikech jatend jolweny maduongʼ ne dwaro ngʼeyo gimomiyo jo-Yahudi nedonjo ni Paulo, kinyne nogonye mogolo chik mondo jodolo madongo duto gi buch jodong jo-Sanhedrin orom. Eka nokelo Paulo mi ochunge e nyimgi mondo owuo.
Kuom mano, un kod jobuch Sanhedrin kwauru jatend jolweny maduongʼ mondo okelnugo e nyimu, ka uwuondoru ni udwaro medo nono wachne maber. Waikore mar nege kapok ochopo ka.”
Wuowino nodwoke niya, “Jo-Yahudi osewinjore mondo okwayi kiny iternegi Paulo e nyim jobuch Sanhedrin ka giwuondore ni gidwaro medo nono wachne maber.
Obiro nywolo wuowi, kendo nyaka imiye nying ni Yesu, nikech obiro waro joge kogolo e richo.”
To mondo ungʼe ni Wuod Dhano nigi teko e piny mar weyo richo.” Eka nowachone ja-athanyno niya, “Aa malo kaw pieni mondo idhi dala.”
Emomiyo awachonu ni richo gi ayany moyanygo Nyasaye duto nowe ne ji, to ngʼato angʼata mowuoyo marach kuom Roho Maler ok nowene richone.
Omiyo mirima nomaka kodgi, mi nasingora ka akwongʼora ni, ‘Ok ginidonji e yweyona ngangʼ.’”
Gin jomage ma nokwongʼorenegi ni ok ginidonji e kar yweyone, ka ok gin joma notamore winjo wachne?

Koro wan maweseyie wadonjo e yweyono, mana kaka Nyasaye osewacho niya, “Omiyo mirima nomaka kodgi, mi nasingora ka akwongʼora ni, ‘Ok ginidonji e yweyona ngangʼ.’ ” Nyasaye nowuoyo kama kata obedo ni nosetieko tije chon chakre kinde manochweyo piny.
Kane oyudo Yesu chiemo e od Mathayo, josol osuru mangʼeny kod joricho mangʼeny nobiro mochiemo kode kaachiel gi jopuonjrene bende.
Kane jo-Farisai oneno mano, negipenjo jopuonjrene niya, “Angʼo momiyo japuonju chiemo gi josol osuru kod joricho?”
To dhiuru upuonjru tiend wachni, ‘Gima adwaro en ni ukech joweteu, to ok ni uchiwna misango.’Nimar ok ne abiro mondo aluong joma kare, to nabiro mondo aluong joricho.”
“Neuru ni ok uchayo achiel kuom jomatindogi. Nimar anyisou ni malaikegi manie polo osiko ka ngʼiyo wangʼ Wuora manie polo. [
Donge un gi miechu munyalo chiemoe kendo methoe? Koso uchayo kanisa Nyasaye, momiyo ukuodo wi joma ochando? Angʼo ma dawachnu? Uparo ni dapaku kuom wachni? Ok kamano ngangʼ!
Kik iyie mondo ngʼato ochayi nikech pod itin, to bed ranyisi ni joma oyie kuom weche miwacho, gi gik mitimo, kod hera miherogo ji kendo kuom bedo ja-adiera kendo kuom dak e ngima maler.
Ka ochuna ni nyaka apakra, to abiro pakora, kuom gik manyiso nyawona.
Abiro mana pakora kuom ngʼat machalo kamano, to ok anyal pakora kuoma awuon, makmana ka apakora kuom gigo manyiso nyawona.

To kata ka daher mar pakora, to ok dikawa ni afuwo, nikech gik ma dimi apakra gin adier. To ok abi pakora, nikech ok adwar ni ngʼato okawa ni an ngʼama lich moloyo gik moseneno ka atimo, kata mosewinjo ka awacho.
Koso en ber mane ma ngʼato yudo ka piny duto obedo mare to ngimane to olalne? Koso en angʼo ma ngʼato dichiw mondo owil gi ngimane?
Ere ber ma ngʼato yudo ka piny duto obedo mare to ngimane to olalne?
Ere ber ma ngʼato yudo ka piny duto obedo mare, to olalo kata owito ngimane.
To Yesu nodwoke niya, “Bwe nigi buchegi kendo winy mafuyo e kor yamo nigi utegi, to Wuod Dhano onge gi kamoro amora monyalo kete wiye.”
Bangʼe nokelo wiye koketo e san kendo nomi nyakono, mane otingʼe otere ne min mare.
dhako moro nobiro ire gi chupa mar alabasta, mopongʼ gi mo mangʼwe ngʼar kendo ma nengone tek, kendo noole duto e wiye sa ma nobet kochiemo e mesa.
E ndalogo Johana ja-Batiso nobiro, koyalo e thim mar Judea,
Yesu nodhi e piny Galili duto, kopuonjo e sinagokegi, koyalo Injili mar pinyruoth kendo kochango kit tuoche gi midekre duto e dier ji.
Yesu nodhi kuonde duto, e mier matindo kod gwenge duto, kopuonjo e sinagokegi, koyalo Injili mar pinyruoth, kendo kochango kit midekre gi tuoche duto.

Kata kamano, jomoko nochako kedo kode. Jogi ne gin jokanyo mar oganda mane iluongo ni sinagogi mar wasumbini mogony. Ne gin jo-Yahudi modak Kurene, gi Aleksandria kod gwenge mag Kilikia kod Asia. Jogi nochako mino wach gi Stefano,
Jogi noor gi baruwa mondiki kama: Wan joote gi jodongo, ma wan oweteu kuom Ruoth, Ne un joma ok jo-Yahudi moyie man Antiokia gi Siria kod Kilikia: Wamosou,
Nowuotho e piny Siria gi Kilikia kojiwo kanisni.
Oganda maduongʼ nopedho kodegi e yo, to jomoko to nongʼado bede yiende, kendo gin bende negi pedhogi e yo.
Ka bath mogo modwal ochiw kaka olemo mokwongo ler, to mano nyiso ni mogo modwal duto ler; kendo ka tiend yath ler, to bede yath bende ler.
To ka bede yath moko nolwer oko, mondo un, ma un kaka yadh bungu, ochomu kargi, eka omi un bende ucham mwandu kaachiel kodgi koa e tiend yadh Zeituni maduongʼ,
Kane gisegure, to ne gipogore lepe ka gigoyo ombulu.
Eka negigure. Ne gipogore lepe, ka gigoyo ombulu mondo gingʼe gima ngʼato ka ngʼato onego okaw.
Yesu nowacho niya, “Wuora, wenegi, nikech gikia gima gitimo!” To ne gipogore lepe ka gigoyo ombulu.
An Paulo, misumba Yesu Kristo, mane oluongi mondo obed jaote, kendo nowala mondo ayal Injili mar Nyasaye.
To un bende un e kanyakla achiel gi jogo moseluongi mondo ubed jo-Yesu Kristo.
Ni ji duto man Rumi, ma Nyasaye ohero kendo oluongo mondo obed jomaler: Ngʼwono gi kwe moa kuom Nyasaye Wuonwa kod Ruoth Yesu Kristo obed kodu.
Liete nomuoch moyawore kendo ringre jomaler mangʼeny mane osetho nochier modoko mangima.
Mano emomiyo ji mathoth kuomu ool kendo tuo; kendo moko kuomu osetho.
Bangʼ mano nofwenyore ni jowete moloyo mia abich, ka gin kanyachiel, kendo thothgi pod ngima nyaka sani, kata obedo ni moko kuomgi osetho.
Joma oyie kuom Kristo noketo chunygi kuom puonj joote, kendo kuom lalruok, gi ngʼingo makati kod lamo.
Nyasaye moseluongou mondo ubedi e lalruok gi Wuode Yesu Kristo Ruodhwa en ja-adiera.
Donge kikombe mar gweth ma wagoyene Nyasaye erokamano ketowa e lalruok achiel e remb Kristo? Koso makati mwangʼingo donge ketowa e lalruok achiel, e ringre Kristo?
“Nimar pinyruodh polo chalo gi wuon puodho mane owuok gokinyi kogwen, mondo ondik ji mane biro tiyone e puothe mar mzabibu.
Nowinjore kodgi ni nobiro chulogi dinari achiel ngʼato ka ngʼato kuom odiechiengʼno, eka noorogi e puothe mar mzabibu.
Nowachonegi ni, ‘Un bende dhiuru uti e puotha mar mzabibu, kendo abiro chulou gimoro amora mowinjore.’
Giyako ute mon ma chwogi otho kendo gilamo lamo moyware mondo ginyisrego ni ji kaka gilony e lamo. Joma kamagi ibiro kum malit moloyo.”
Giyako ute mon ma chwogi otho kendo gilamo lamo moyware mondo ginyisrego ni ji kaka gilony e lamo. Joma kamagi ibiro kum malit moloyo.”
To ngʼat ma jaketho machielo nokwere niya, “Ok iluoro Nyasaye, nomedo wachoni, nimar in e bwo kum achielno?

“Los weche piyo piyo gi ngʼama odonjoni madwa teri e od bura. Tim kamano kapod un kode e yo, nono to onyalo keti e lwet jangʼad bura to jangʼad bura nyalo keti e lwet askari, kendo inyalo boli e od twech.

Ka idhi gi ngʼama odonjoni e nyim jangʼad bura, tem matek mondo iwuo kode kendo uwinjru kapod un e yo, nono to obiro ywayi koteri ir jangʼad bura, to jangʼad bura biro keti e lwet askari, to askari biro boli e od twech.
Nowachonegi niya, “E dala moro ne nitie jangʼad bura mane ok oluoro Nyasaye kata ok odewo ji.
To Yesu nowacho niya, “Weuru nyithindo matindo obi ira, kendo kik utamgi, nikech pinyruodh polo en mar ji machal ka magi.”
To Yesu nowacho niya, “Kik utame nikech onge ngʼat manyalo timo hono e nyinga manyalo loko pache bangʼ thuolo manok mi owach gimoro marach kuoma,
Kane Yesu oneno gima jopuonjrene timo, nokecho kodgi, mi owachonegi niya, “Weuru nyithindo matindo obi ira kendo kik utamgi, nikech pinyruoth Nyasaye en mar ji machal ka magi.
Muofni neno, rongʼonde wuotho, jogo man-gi dhoho ichango, joma itgi odinore winjo wach, joma otho ichiero, kendo Injili iyalo ne joma odhier.
Oganda maduongʼ nobiro ire, kendo negikelone rongʼonde, muofni, pudhe, momni gi ji matuo mamoko mangʼeny, mine giketogi e tiende kendo nochangogi.
Ji nohum kane gineno ka momni wuoyo, pudhe ngima, rongʼonde wuotho, kendo muofni neno, kendo negipako Nyasach Israel.
E dhorangaye noketie jakwecho miluongoni Lazaro, ma adhonde nopongʼo dende
Kane en e Piny Joma otho kisande malit, nongʼiyo malo to noneno Ibrahim gi kuma bor kod Lazaro e bathe.
Omiyo noluonge kowacho niya, ‘Wuora Ibrahim kecha kendo or Lazaro olut lith lwete e pi mondo okwena lewa, nikech an-gi rem malit e ligek majni.’
To ka gimakou to kik uparru kuom gima duwachi, kata kaka unyalo wuoyo kodgi. Nomiu gima uwacho e sechego,
Eka negikelone ngʼat man-gi jachien kendo ma muofu bende mamomo; eka Yesu nochange, momiyo koro nonyalo wuoyo kendo neno.
Kane Yesu pod wuoyo gi oganda mane ochokore, min-gi kaachiel gi owetene nochungʼ oko ka gidwaro wuoyo kode.
Eka nogolo chik mondo ji obed piny e lum. Bangʼe nokawo makati abichgo gi rech ariyogo, nongʼiyo polo malo, kogoyo erokamano. Nongʼingo makatigo mi nomiyo jopuonjre kendo jopuonjre nomiyogi ji.
Bangʼe nokawo makati abichgo gi rech ariyogo nongʼiyo polo malo, kogoyo erokamano. Nongʼingo makatigo mi omiyo jopuonjrene mondo opog ji. Rech ariyo ka bende nopogo matindo tindo ni ji duto.
Kane osewacho mano, nokawo makati mi ogoyo ni Nyasaye erokamano e nyimgi giduto. Eka nongʼingo makatino mochako chiemo.
“E kindeno pinyruodh polo nopim gi nyiri apar manokawo techegi bangʼe owuok odhi romo ne wuon kisera.
Mago mofuwo nokawo techegi to ne ok gitingʼo mafuta kata matin gidhigo.
To mago mariek to notingʼo mafuta e kubni kaachiel gi techegi.
nowachonegi niya, “Ondiki ni, ‘Oda noluongi ni od lamo,’to un to uloke ‘kar chokruok mar jomecho.’”
Jomecho ariyo bende negiguro kode, achiel e bathe korachwich to machielo e bathe koracham.
Kamano bende e kaka jomecho mane ogur kode bende nodhuole gi ayany.
Nowachone niya, “Ka in wuod Nyasaye to chikri piny. Nimar ondiki niya, “ ‘Obiro miyo malaika mage chik nikech in, kendo gibiro tingʼi malo e lwetgi, mondo kik ichwany tiendi e kidi.’”
“En ngʼa kuomu ma ka wuode okwayo kuon to omiye kidi?
Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Donge usesomo Ndiko mawacho niya, “ ‘Kidi mane jogedo odagi osedoko kidi motegno moriwo kor ot, Jehova Nyasaye ema osetimo mano, kendo en gima iwuoro ka waneno?’

To ne omak ondiek malichno kaachiel gi janabi mar miriambo, mane osetimo timbe honni e nyinge. Honnigo ema ne osewuondogo joma ne oketnegi kido mar ondiek malichno kendo negilamo gima ket kode. Ondiek malichno gi Janabi mar miriambo ne owiti kangima e ataro mar mach maliel mager.
To Jachien, mane owuondogi ne owit e ataro mar mach maliel mager, kama ondiek malichno kod janabi mar miriambo nowitie. Kanyo gini sandre odiechiengʼ gi otieno nyaka chiengʼ.
Eka tho gi Piny Joma otho nowiti e ataro mar mach. Ataro mar mach en e tho mar ariyo.
Osendiki ni: ‘Ne okwane kod joketho’; kendo awachonu ni wachni nyaka timrena. Ee, gino mondik kuoma koro chiegni timore.”
Ndiko to wacho nangʼo? “Ibrahim noyie kuom Nyasaye, kendo mano nomiyo Nyasaye okwane kaka ngʼama kare.”
To gweth miwuoyeni dobed mana mar joma oter nyangu kende, koso en mar joma ok oter nyangu bende? Wawacho ni yie mar Ibrahim nomiyo okwane kaka ngʼama kare.
Moko kuomgi ne gin, Maria ma aa Magdala, Maria min Jakobo gi Joses, kod min yawuot Zebedi.
Maria ma aa Magdala gi Maria machielo to noweyo kobet piny kama omanyore kod liel.
Bangʼ Sabato, kogwen mar odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar juma, Maria ma aa Magdala gi Maria machielo nodhi limo liel.
Koro kane oneno oganda maduongʼ, nodhi e bath got mi obet piny. Jopuonjrene nobiro ire,
Eka nodonjo ei yie kendo jopuonjrene noluwe.
Kane oyudo Yesu chiemo e od Mathayo, josol osuru mangʼeny kod joricho mangʼeny nobiro mochiemo kode kaachiel gi jopuonjrene bende.
“Joma odhier gie chunygi gin joma ogwedhi, nimar pinyruodh polo en margi.
Joma ywak gin joma ogwedhi, nimar ibiro hoyogi.
Joma muol gin joma ogwedhi nimar piny nobed girkeni margi.
Otienono, Paulo noneno fweny mar ja-Makedonia kochungʼ kendo saye niya, “Bi loka Makedonia mondo ikonywa.”
Bangʼ kane Paulo oseneno fwenyno, ne waikore piyo piyo mondo wadhi e piny Makedonia, nikech ne wangʼeyo ni Nyasaye dwarowa loka kono mondo wayalnegi Injili.
Kane waa kanyo, ne wadhi nyaka Filipi, mane en dala maduongʼ e bath piny Makedonia ma kono, kendo joma odakie ne ni e bwo loch jo-Rumi. Kanyo ne wadakie kuom ndalo mogwarore.
To ere rachne ka Nyasaye noyiere mar nyiso mirimbe, kendo mar nyiso ji tekone, to osetimo kinda kohore mos amingʼa mak otoyo mirimbe kuom joma owinjore okum, ma gin joma noyik ne tho?
kuom ritruok maler, kuom ngʼeyo, kuom timo kinda, kuom ngʼwono, kuom Roho Maler gihera mar adier;
Tekone maduongʼ biro miyo ubed motegno, mondo ubed joma odhil matimo kinda e yore duto, kendo

Dhakono norwakore gi lewni maralik gi makwar, kendo nolichore gi dhahabu kod kite mabeyo ma nengogi tek gi lulu. To notingʼo kikombe mar dhahabu e lwete, mopongʼ gi gik makwero kod timbe mochido mag terruokne.

Mwandugigo gin: dhahabu gi fedha kod kite mabeyo ma nengogi tek gi lulu kod lewni mabeyo, gi lewni maralik, lewni mayom kod lewni makwar gi yien duto madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar, gi gik moko duto molos gi lak liech, gi yien ma nengogi tek kod molos gi nyinyo, kod mula kendo molos gi kite mabeyo,

kendo goyo nduru kagiwacho niya: “ ‘Mano kaka lit! Mano kaka lit, yaye dala maduongʼ, morwakore gi lewni mayom kod lewni marep-rep gi makwar, mapakni gi dhahabu gi kite mabeyo ma nengogi tek kod lulu!
Kane oyudo Yesu gi jopuonjrene ni e yo, nochopo gwengʼ kama dhako miluongo ni Maritha norwake e ode.
To Maritha nodich gi tich mangʼeny mane nyaka tim. Nodhi ire mopenjo niya, “Ruoth, ok idewo ni nyaminwa oweya atiyo mana kenda nyise mondo okonya!”
Ruoth nodwoke niya, “Maritha, Maritha, iparori kendo ithagori kuom gik mangʼeny kayiem,
to Jakobo ne en wuon Josef mane chwor Maria mane onywolo Yesu, miluongo ni Kristo.
Kama e kaka nywol mar Yesu Kristo notimore: Noyudo min mare ma Maria osesingi ne Josef mondo okende, to kane pok gibedo kaachiel, noyude ka en gi ich kuom Roho Maler.
To bangʼ paro mar timo kamano, Malaika mar Ruoth nofwenyorene e lek mowachone niya, “Josef wuod Daudi, kik iluor dhi gi Maria dala kaka chiegi, nikech gima otingʼo e iye owuok kuom Roho Maler.
Kane osengʼeyo gima notimorene, nodhi nyaka od Maria min Johana, ma niluongo bende ni Mariko, kendo kanyo ji nochokore mangʼeny ka gilamo Nyasaye.
Kane Barnaba gi Saulo nosetieko tijgi, negidwogo ka gia Jerusalem ka gin gi Johana ma bende iluongo ni Mariko.
Barnaba ne dwaro mondo Johana miluongo ni Mariko odhi kodgi,
“Kapo ni atimo nenda awuon to nenda ok nikare.
Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Kata obedo ni atimo nenda awuon to nenda pod en mana adier nimar angʼeyo kuma ne aaye gi kuma adhiye. Un to ukia kuma aaye kata kuma adhiye.
An atimo nenda awuon, to ngʼama chielo matimo nenda en Wuoro mane oora.”
Owacho bende kamachielo niya, “In Jadolo nyaka chiengʼ koluwo kit dolo mar Melkizedek.”
Bende Nyasaye nokete jadolo maduongʼ koluwo kit dolo mar Melkizedek.
kama Yesu ma nosetelonwa nosedonjoe. Osedoko jadolo maduongʼ manyaka chiengʼ, koluwo kit dolo mar Melkizedek.
To bangʼ paro mar timo kamano, Malaika mar Ruoth nofwenyorene e lek mowachone niya, “Josef wuod Daudi, kik iluor dhi gi Maria dala kaka chiegi, nikech gima otingʼo e iye owuok kuom Roho Maler.
Kane Josef ochiewo gokinyi, notimo gima malaika mar Ruoth nochike mondo otim, kendo nokawo Maria odhigo dala mobedo chiege.

Bangʼ kane gisedhi, malaika mar Ruoth nofwenyore ne Josef e lek. Nowachone niya, “Aa malo ikaw nyathi gi min mare mondo itony idhi Misri. Dag kuno nyaka aduogni wach, nikech Herode biro manyo nyathini mondo onege.”
“Emomiyo awachonu ni, kik uparru kuom ngimau, kata kuom gik ma ubiro chamo kata madho; kata kuom dendu kata gik ma ubiro rwako. Donge ngima duongʼ moloyo chiemo, koso del donge duongʼ moloyo lewni?
Omiyo kik uparru kuwacho ni, ‘Wabiro chamo angʼo?’ Kata ni, ‘Wabiro madho angʼo?’ Kata ni, ‘Wabiro rwako angʼo?’
Kuom mano, kik uparru kuom kiny, nikech kiny noparre kuome owuon. Odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ nigi chandruokne morome.
kowacho niya, “Weuru richo, nikech pinyruodh polo ni machiegni.”
Chakre kindeno kadhi nyime, Yesu nochako yalo niya, “Weuru richo nikech pinyruodh polo osekayo machiegni.”
Eka Yesu nochako kwedo mier mane thoth honnige osetimoree, nikech negitamore weyo richo.
Nowachonigi, “Kik uhiny piny, kata nam, kata yiende nyaka chop waket kido e lela wangʼ jotich Nyasachwa.”
To nokwergi ni kik giketh lum manie piny kata gimoro mangʼich kata yien, to ginyalo mana hinyo jogo maonge gi kido mar Nyasaye e lela wengegi.
Bende nochuno ji duto, jomatindo gi jomadongo, jo-mwandu kod jochan, wasumbini gi joma ni thuolo, mondo oket kido e lwetegi ma korachwich kata e lela wengegi,
Kama e kaka nywol mar Yesu Kristo notimore: Noyudo min mare ma Maria osesingi ne Josef mondo okende, to kane pok gibedo kaachiel, noyude ka en gi ich kuom Roho Maler.
To kane gichopo ei ot, negineno nyathino kod Maria min mare, kendo negikulore piny ka gilame. Bangʼe ne giyawo mwandugi kendo negimiye mich mag dhahabu, gi ubani gi mane-mane.

Bangʼ kane gisedhi, malaika mar Ruoth nofwenyore ne Josef e lek. Nowachone niya, “Aa malo ikaw nyathi gi min mare mondo itony idhi Misri. Dag kuno nyaka aduogni wach, nikech Herode biro manyo nyathini mondo onege.”
“Onge jatich manyalo tiyo ne ruodhi ariyo. Nimar obiro chayo achiel to ohero machielo, kata obiro chiwore ne achiel to ochayo machielo. Ok inyal tiyo ne Nyasaye kendo ne pesa.
“Onge jatich manyalo tiyo ne ruodhi ariyo. Nimar obiro chayo achiel to ohero machielo, kata obiro chiwore ne achiel to ochayo machielo. Ok inyal tiyo ne Nyasaye kendo ne pesa.”
Ngʼama ohero ngimane, ngimane biro lalne, to ngʼama ochayo ngimane e pinyni biro rite nyaka chop oyud ngima mochwere.
Bende ka ngʼato angʼata omiyo achiel kuom jomatindogi kata mana pi mangʼich gi kikombe, nikech en japuonjrena, to awachonu adier ni pokne ok nobaye ngangʼ.”
Awachonu adier ni ngʼato angʼata mamiyou pi e okombe e nyinga, nikech un jo-Kristo pokne ok nobaye ngangʼ.
Beduru e odno, ka uchamo kendo umadho gimoro amora ma gimiyou, nimar jatich owinjore gi pokne. Kik uwuothi ka ua e ot ka ot.
Nowachone niya, “Magi duto abiro miyi ka ikulorina piny kendo ilama.”
Japuonjrene machielo nowachone niya, “Ruoth, yiena adhi ayik wuonwa mondi.”
To Yesu nowachone niya, “In luwa, kendo we joma otho oik jogegi motho gin giwegi.”
Nodwokogi niya, “Un osemiu rieko mar ngʼeyo tiend gik mopondo mag pinyruodh polo, to gin ok osemigi.
Nowachonigi niya, “Un osemiu rieko mar ngʼeyo tiend gik mopondo mag pinyruoth Nyasaye. To joma moko, to iwuoyogo gi ngeche

Nowacho niya, “Un osemiu rieko mar ngʼeyo gik mopondo mag pinyruoth Nyasaye, to ji mamoko awuoyonegi gi ngero, mondo omi, “ ‘kata ka obedo ni gingʼicho, to ok ginine gimoro; kendo gibiro siko ka giwinjo weche miwacho, to wach ok nodonjnegi.’
kendo nodhi modak e dala miluongo ni Nazareth. Kamano gima nowachi gi dho janabi niya, “Enoluonge ni ja-Nazareth,” nochopo kare.
Nowuok Nazareth modhi odak Kapernaum, mane ni e dho nam e gwengʼ mar Zebulun gi Naftali,
To oganda nodwokogi niya, “Ma en Yesu, janabi moa Nazareth, e piny Galili.”
To kuom chier mar joma otho, donge usesomo gima Nyasaye nowachonu ni,
Jopuonjre nokano wachni e chunygi, ka gipenjore e chunygi tiend “chier aa kuom joma otho.”
To kuom chier mar joma otho, donge usesomo e kitap Musa kama ondikie wach bungu maliel, kaka Nyasaye nowachone niya, ‘An Nyasach Ibrahim, Nyasach Isaka kendo Nyasach Jakobo?’
E sechego Yesu nowacho niya, “Apakoi Wuonwa, Ruodh polo gi piny, nikech isepando gigi ne joma riek gi joma osomo, to isefwenyogi ne nyithindo matindo.
Negipenje niya, “Bende iwinjo gima nyithindogi wacho?” Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Ee, awinjo. Kare pok usomo kama wacho ni, “ ‘Ne isechano mondo nyithindo kod nyithindo mayom omiyi pak’?”

E sechego ka Roho Maler nomiyo Yesu opongʼ gi ilo, nowacho niya, “Apakoi, Wuonwa, Ruodh polo gi piny, nikech isepando gigi ne joma riek gi joma osomo, to isefwenyogi ne nyithindo matindo. Ee, Wuora, nimar mano ema ne berni kotimore.
Ne giwuotho e chulano duto mi gichopo Pafo, kendo kanyo ne giyude ja-Yahudi moro ma ajwoga kendo mane wuondore ni janabi, ma nyinge Bar-Yesu.
Kane wasechopo e lowo motwo ka wangima, ne wayudo ni chulano iluongo ni Malta.
But kama newantiereno ne nitie puothe madongo mag ruodh chulano miluongo ni Publio. Ruodhno norwakowa, moritowa maber kaka wende kuom ndalo adek.
Ngʼat man-gi it mondo owinj gima Roho wacho ne kanisa. Ngʼat molocho to anami adiera mar chamo olemb yadh ngima manie puotho mar Nyasaye.
Ngʼat man-gi it mondo owinj gima Roho wacho ni kanisa. Ngʼat molocho to tho mar ariyo ok notime gimoro kata matin.

Ngʼat man-gi it mondo owinj gima Roho wacho ni kanisa. Ngʼat molocho abiro miyo manna moko mopandi. Bende abiro miye kidi marachar mondikie nying manyien maonge ngʼat mongʼeyo makmana ngʼat monwangʼe.
Bangʼ timo kamano, noolo pi e karaya bangʼe ochako luoko tiend jopuonjrene, kendo noyweyo tiendegi gi taulo mane oyudo otweyo e nungone.
Kane obiro ir Simon Petro, Petro nowachone niya, “Ruoth, idwaro luoko tienda adier?”
Petro nonyise koramo niya, “Ooyo, Ruoth, ok inyal luoko tiendena ngangʼ.” Yesu nodwoke niya, “Ka ok aluoko tiendi, to ok iwinjori bedo koda e kanyakla mar jopuonjrena.”
Achiel kuomgi, mane en ngʼat molony ahinya e chik noteme kapenje niya,
To jo-Farisai kod jogo molony e chik nodagi dwaro mar Nyasaye kuomgi giwegi, nikech ne pok obatisgi gi Johana.)
Chiengʼ moro achiel, ngʼat moro molony e chik nochungʼ mondo otem Yesu, nopenjo niya, “Japuonj, en angʼo monego atim eka ayud ngima mochwere kaka girkeni mara?”
“Kik upar ni asebiro mondo aketh Chik kata Jonabi. Ok asebiro mondo akethgi, to asebiro mar chopogi.
Awachonu adier ni nyaka chop chiengʼ ma polo gi piny nolal nono, onge nukta matinie mogik kata kido moro amora mar kalam manolal kuom Chik, nyaka gik moko duto chop kargi.
Omiyo, e gik moko duto, timuru ne joweteu gik ma duher mondo gin bende gitimnu, nikech mano e tiend Chik gi Jonabi.
To Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Ere kaka welo mag wuon kisera nyalo kuyo adier kapod en kodgi? Kata kamano ndalo nobi ma wuon kisera nogol e kindgi; eka ginitwe chiemo e kindeno.
“E kindeno pinyruodh polo nopim gi nyiri apar manokawo techegi bangʼe owuok odhi romo ne wuon kisera.
Wuon Kisera nokawo sa mathoth kapok obiro, omiyo wengegi nobedo mapek kargi duto mi nindo noterogi.
Bangʼ tweyo chiemo kuom ndalo piero angʼwen odiechiengʼ kod otieno, kech nochako kaye.
“To e chuny otieno koko moro nogore matek ni, ‘Wuon kisera eri odonjo! Wuoguru oko mondo uromne!’
Otieno kata odiechiengʼ, kata ka onindo kata oneno, to kodhigo twi atwiya mi dongi, ka jachwoyo ok ongʼeyo kaka mano timore.
Mana kaka notimore e ndalo mag Nowa e kaka nobedi chiengʼ ma Wuod Dhano nobi.
Nimar e ndalo mane pok pi opongʼo piny, ji ne chiemo kendo metho, bende negi kendo kendo ikendogi, nyaka nochopo odiechiengʼ mane Nowa odonjo e yie,
wuod Kainan, wuod Arfaksad, wuod Shem, wuod Nowa, wuod Lamek,
Koth nochwe maduongʼ, aore nopongʼ mogingore, kendo yamo nokudho matek mogoyo odno; to kata kamano ne ok opodho, nikech mise mare ne ni e lwanda.
Koth nochwe maduongʼ, aore nopongʼ mogingore kendo yamo nokudho matek mogoyo odno, mi norwombore piny gi ruombruok matek.”
Kaonge ngʼama oyie rwakou kata winjo wecheu, to tengʼuru buru momoko e tiendeu sa ma uwuok e odno kata e dalano.
Yesu noa e hekalu, kendo kane oyudo owuotho odhi, jopuonjrene nobiro ire mondo onyise kaka gedo mag hekalu lich.
Kuom mano, watemuru matek mondo watim gima kelo kwe kendo ma wanyalo jiworego ngʼato gi ngʼato.
To ngʼat ma hulo wach, wuoyo gi ji mondo ogergi, ojiwgi kendo oduog chunygi.
Kendo Injilini mar pinyruoth noyal e piny duto mondo ongʼad bura ne ogendini duto, eka giko nobi.
E ndalogo, Kaisar Agusto nogolo chik mondo okwan ji e piny Rumi duto.
Eka Satan notere kama otingʼore malo kendo ka diemo wangʼ nono nonyise pinjeruodhi duto mag piny.
Kuom mano, ngʼama kwongʼore gi nying kendo mar misango ok kwongʼre mana gi kama ler kende, to okwongʼore koda ka gi gik moko duto manie iye.
Kendo ngʼama kwongʼore gi nying hekalu kwongʼore kode kaachiel gi Jal modak e iye.
Eka nochako kwongʼore mowachonegi koramo niya, “Ok angʼeyo ngʼatno adier!” To mana gisano thuon gweno moro nokok.
Koro ngʼat moro miluongo ni Anania, kaachiel gi chiege Safira, bende noloko puothgi moro pesa.
Eka Petro nowachone Anania niya, “Ere kaka iseweyone Satan thuolo e chunyi momiyo isewuondo Roho Maler, ka idongʼ gi bath pesa mane iyudo kuom puodho?
Kane Anania owinjo wachno, nogore piny motho. Ji duto mane owinjo gima notimoreno ne luoro omako.
“Ngʼato angʼata mohulo ni ongʼeya e nyim ji, an bende abiro hulo ni angʼeye e nyim Wuora manie polo.
“Awachonu, ngʼato angʼata mohulo ni ongʼeya e nyim ji, Wuod Dhano biro hulo ni angʼeye e nyim malaike mag Nyasaye.
Kata kamano, e kindeno, ji mangʼeny kuom jotelo bende noyie kuome. To nikech negiluoro jo-Farisai, ne ok ginyal hulo yie margi e lela nimar negiluor ni dipo ka oriembgi e sinagogi.
Obiro nywolo wuowi, kendo nyaka imiye nying ni Yesu, nikech obiro waro joge kogolo e richo.”
To ne ok oriwore kode nyaka bangʼ kane osenywolo nyathi ma wuowi kendo nomiye nying ni Yesu.
Magi e nying jopuonjre apar gariyogo: Mokwongo ne en Simon (miluongo ni Petro), gi owadgi ma Andrea; kod Jakobo wuod Zebedi gi owadgi ma Johana;
To kane oneno jo-Farisai gi jo-Sadukai ka biro kama ne obatisoe ji, nowachonegi niya, “Un koth thuondegi! En ngʼa mane onyisou mondo uring utony ne mirima mager mabiro?
Yesu nongʼiyo jogo gi mirima kendo ka chunye lit ahinya nikech chunygi ne tek. Nowacho ni jal ma lwete otalno niya, “Rie lweti,” mi norieyo lwete kendo lwete nochango chuth.
Johana nowacho ne oganda mane biro mondo obatisgi niya, “Un koth thuondegi! En ngʼa mane onyisou mondo uring utony ne mirima mager mabiro?
kowacho niya, “Weuru richo, nikech pinyruodh polo ni machiegni.”
Kane osebatiso Yesu to nowuok oa ei pi. To gisano polo noyawore kendo noneno Roho mar Nyasaye kalor e kido mar akuru, kendo piyo kuome.
To dwol moro moa e polo nowacho niya, “Ma en wuoda, ma ahero, kendo chunya mor kode.”
Ruodhe ne mirima omako kode mi nochiwe e lwet jo-jela mondo orodhe maonge kech, nyaka chop ochul gowi duto mane en-go.
“Ji ariyo ne nigi gowi mar jahol pesa, moro. Achiel nenigigope mar silingʼ mia abich, to machielo piero abich.
“Omiyo noluongo jogope ruodhe achiel achiel. Nopenjo mokwongo ni, ‘In-gi gowi mar ruodha marom nadi?’
Eka nomulo wengegi kowacho niya, “Biro timorenu kuom yie ma un-go,”
Nikech chuny jogi osedinore; gisedino itgi, kendo gisemiyo wengegi. Nono to dipo ka wengegi oneno, kendo itgi owinjo wach; mi chunygi ofwenyo tiend weche, kendo gidwog ira mi achang-gi.’
Kane gitingʼo wengegi, ne ok gineno ngʼato makmana Yesu kende.
Oganda maduongʼ moa Galili gi gwengʼ mar Dekapoli gi Jerusalem gi Judea kod gwengʼ man loka Jordan ne oluwe.
Koro kane oneno oganda maduongʼ, nodhi e bath got mi obet piny. Jopuonjrene nobiro ire,
Kane Yesu osetieko wacho gigi, oganda nowuoro puonjne,
Kane gisewinjo wach ruoth, negichako wuodhgi mi gidhi, kendo sulwe mane oyudo giseneno yo wuok chiengʼ notelonigi nyaka nochopo mi ochungʼ ewi kama ne nyathi nitie.

Bangʼ kane gisedhi, malaika mar Ruoth nofwenyore ne Josef e lek. Nowachone niya, “Aa malo ikaw nyathi gi min mare mondo itony idhi Misri. Dag kuno nyaka aduogni wach, nikech Herode biro manyo nyathini mondo onege.”
Omiyo noa malo gotieno mi okawo nyathi gi min mare kendo nowuok modhi Misri,
“Koro winjuru tiend ngero mar jakomo,
Yesu nogoyonegi ngero machielo kama: “Pinyruodh polo chalo gi ngʼat mane okomo kodhi maber e puothe.
Nogoyonegi ngero machielo kama: “Pinyruodh polo chalo gi koth karadali ma ngʼato nokawo mopidho e puothe.
Odiechiengʼno jo-Sadukai, mawacho ni chier onge, nobiro ire gi penjo moro.
Koro, chiengʼ chier dhakoni nobed chi ngʼa kuom ji abiriyogi, nikech ji abiriyogo nokende giduto?”
Chiengʼ chier ji ok nokendi kata kendgi ngangʼ to ginichal gi malaike manie polo.
Kane gichokore kaachiel Galili, nowachonegi niya, “Wuod Dhano ibiro ndhogi mi keti e lwet ji.
“Eri wadhi nyaka Jerusalem, kendo Wuod Dhano ibiro ndhogi mi chiw e lwet jodolo madongo gi jopuonj chik. Gibiro ngʼadone buch tho,
nikech nopuonjo jopuonjrene. Nowachonegi niya, “Wuod Dhano ibiro ndhogi mi keti e lwet ji. Gibiro nege, to bangʼ ndalo adek obiro chier.”
Kuom mano jo-Farisai gi jopuonj chik nopenjo Yesu niya, “Angʼo momiyo jopuonjreni ketho chikwa kod puonj mag kwerewa, ka gichiemo gi lwedo mochido?”
Useweyo Chike Nyasaye mi koro umako mana puonj ma kwereu machon noweyonu.”
Agoyonu erokamano nikech usiko upara e yore duto, kendo nikech umako puonj duto mane amiyou.

english: to the sick of the palsy

lines.t: Jomoko nokelone ja-athany, konindo e pien. Kane Yesu oneno yie ma jogo ne nigo, nowachone ja-athanyno niya,“Wuoda, bed gi kwe e chunyi, richoni oweni.”
To mondo ungʼe ni Wuod Dhano nigi teko e piny mar weyo richo.” Eka nowachone ja-athanyno niya, “Aa malo kaw pieni mondo idhi dala.”
To kane ok ginyal chopo ir Yesu nikech oganda maduongʼ mane ni kode, ne gitucho wi tado mochomore gi kama Yesu ne nitie tir mi giloro ja-athanyno konindo e par nyaka nochopo e nyim Yesu.
en ema otiyo e kama ler mar lemo, ma en Hemb Romo madier ma Ruoth ema oguro, to ok dhano.
Singruok mokwongo ne nigi chike matayo lemo kaachiel gi kama ler mar lemo e piny-ka.
Ne olos hema ma opog iye ariyo. Kama ikwongo donjoe ne iluongo ni Kama Ler, kendo kanyo noketie rachung taya gi mesa moketie makati miketo e nyim Nyasaye pile.
Ka noneno yiend ngʼowu moro e bath yo, nobaro kochomo yien-no, to ne ok oyudo gimoro amora kuome, makmana ite. Eka nowachone niya, “Kik ichak inyag olemo kendo!” Gikanyono yien-no noner.
Gikanyono dhoge noyawore kendo lewe nogonyore, mi nochako wuoyo, kopako Nyasaye.
Gikanyono nochungo ka ji duto nene modhiyo dala kopako Nyasaye.
Filipo ne nigi nyiri angʼwen mapok okendi mane gin johul wach.
Kuom wach nyiri ma ok okendi to awacho kama: Aonge gi chik moa kuom Ruoth, to achiwo pacha kaka ngʼat ma wechene inyalo geno kuom ngʼwono mar Ruoth.
To ka ikendo, to ok itimo richo; kata ka nyako okendi bende ok otimo richo. To joma okendo gi mokendi biro neno chandruok mathoth e ngimani, to adwaro ni akonyu mondo kik une chandruokni.
Kane gineno chir mane Petro gi Johana nigo, kendo kane ginwangʼo ni gin ji ajia ma ok osomo, ne giwuoro ahinya, eka negifwenyo ni jogi yande nigi Yesu.
Kane giselamo, kama ne gichokoreno noyiengni, kendo Roho Maler nopongʼogi giduto, mi giyalo Wach Nyasaye gi chir.
Emomiyo ka koro wan gi geno machal kama, wawuoyo gi chir mathoth.
To Barnaba nokawe motere ir joote. Nonyisogi kaka Saulo noseromo gi Ruoth kane oyudo en e wuodhe, kaka Ruoth nosewuoyo kode, kendo kaka Saulo noseyalo gi chir kuom nying Yesu e Damaski.

Eka Paulo gi Barnaba nomedo wuoyo gi chir kagiwacho niya, “Ne bernwa mondo un ema wayalnu Wach Nyasaye mokwongo. To nikech udage kendo nikech ok ukwanoru ka joma owinjore yudo ngima mochwere, koro waweyou mondo wayal wachni ni joma ok jo-Yahudi.
Paulo gi Barnaba nobedo kuno kuom ndalo mogwarore, ka giwuoyo gi chir kuom Ruoth Yesu, kendo Nyasaye nodoko janeno kuom wach ngʼwonone, komiyo joote timo honni gi ranyisi.
Ajuogani ne otwere but ruodh chulano miluongo ni Sergio Paulo, mane en ngʼat mariek, kendo kaka nodwaro winjo Wach Nyasaye, nooro wach mondo oluongne Barnaba gi Saulo.
Eka Saulo, ma bende niluongo ni Paulo, nopongʼ gi Roho Maler, mi nongʼiyo wangʼ Elima tir, bangʼe owachone niya,
Paulo kod joma ne en-go ne oa Pafo mi okwangʼ nyaka Perga, e piny Pamfilia, kendo kanyo ema Johana noweyogie modok Jerusalem.
Ogwedh jogo makech kayo kendo riyo mar tim makare oloyo, nimar gibiro yiengʼ.
Nimar ne adenyo to ne umiya gimoro achamo; riyo noloya, to ne umiya gimoro amodho; ne an wendo; kendo nurwaka ei ot;
“Eka joma karego nodwoke ni, ‘Ruoth, karangʼo mane wanenie kidenyo mi wamiyi chiemo, kata ka riyo oloyi, mi wamiyi gimoro imodho?
Eka Roho Maler notelo ne Yesu nyaka e thim mondo Satan oteme.
Jo-Farisai gi jo-Sadukai nobiro ir Yesu mi oteme kapenje ka gidwaro mondo onyisgie ranyisi moa e polo.
Jo-Farisai moko nobiro ire mondo oteme. Negipenje niya, “Bende chik oyie mondo ngʼato oketh keny gi chiege nikech wach moro amora?”
Ka dine Jal mane oora mondo abatis ji gi pi we nyisa, to dine ok angʼeye. Nonyisa ni, ‘Ngʼama ineno ka Roho olor mi opiyo kuome e Jal mabiro batiso ji gi Roho Maler.’
Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Chiemba en timo dwach Jal mane oora kendo tieko tichne.
“Awachonu adier ni ngʼato angʼata mawinjo wachna, kendo moyie kuom Jal mane oora, nigi ngima mochwere, kendo ok bi ngʼadne buch tho; to osengʼado oa e tho modonjo e ngima.
Kama e kaka nywol mar Yesu Kristo notimore: Noyudo min mare ma Maria osesingi ne Josef mondo okende, to kane pok gibedo kaachiel, noyude ka en gi ich kuom Roho Maler.
To bangʼ paro mar timo kamano, Malaika mar Ruoth nofwenyorene e lek mowachone niya, “Josef wuod Daudi, kik iluor dhi gi Maria dala kaka chiegi, nikech gima otingʼo e iye owuok kuom Roho Maler.
“An abatisou gi pi mondo omi ulokru uwe richou. To ngʼato biro bangʼa ma oloya gi duongʼ, ma kata akande ok awinjora tingʼo. En obiro batisou gi Roho Maler kod mach.
To kata kamano awachonu ni kata mana Solomon e rwakruokne malich duto ne ok orwakore ka achiel kuomgi.
“Paruruane kaka ondanyo dongo. Ok ginyagre gi tich kata gi chwecho. To kata kamano awachonu ni kata mana Solomon e rwakruokne malich duto ne ok orwakore ka achiel kuomgi.
Eka achiel kuom jodongogo nopenja niya, “Joma orwakore gi lewni marocheregi gin ngʼa gini, to gia kanye?”
Kane oyudo Yesu wuotho e dho Nam Galili, noneno owete ariyo, Simon miluongo ni Petro gi owadgi ma Andrea. Noyudo gibolo gokgi e nam, nimar ne gin jolupo.
Muofni neno, rongʼonde wuotho, jogo man-gi dhoho ichango, joma itgi odinore winjo wach, joma otho ichiero, kendo Injili iyalo ne joma odhier.
Nowachone niya, “Bi.” Eka Petro nowuok e yie kendo nochako wuotho ewi pi kochomo ir Yesu.
Aorou mondo udhi mana kaka rombe madhi e dier ondiegi. Kuom mano, beduru mariek ka thuonde, kendo mamuol ka akuche.
Yesu nodonjo ei hekalu mi noriembo oko joma ne ngʼiewo kendo uso gik moko kanyo. Noloko mesni mag jowil pesa ataro kod kombe mag joma ne uso akuche, kendo
Kane gichopo Jerusalem, Yesu nodonjo ei hekalu mi noriembo oko joma ne ngʼiewo kendo uso gik moko kanyo. Noloko mesni mag jowil pesa ataro kod kombe mag joma ne uso akuche,
