Magi e nying jopuonjre apar gariyogo: Mokwongo ne en Simon (miluongo ni Petro), gi owadgi ma Andrea; kod Jakobo wuod Zebedi gi owadgi ma Johana;
Kane oyudo Yesu wuotho e dho Nam Galili, noneno Simon gi owadgi ma Andrea ka jobolo gokgi e nam, nimar ne gin jolupo.
Nikech Musa nomiyou chik mar mondo oteru nyangu (to chutho Musa ok ema nomiyou chikni, to noa kuom kwereu), omiyo utero ji nyangu nyaka chiengʼ Sabato.
To ka inyalo ter nyathi nyangu chiengʼ Sabato, mondo kik uketh Chik Musa, anto iu wangʼ koda nangʼo ka achango ringre dhano duto chiengʼ Sabato?

Bangʼe Nyasaye notimo gi Ibrahim singruok kowacho ni yawuowi nyaka ter nyangu. Kane Ibrahim onywolo wuode ma Isaka, notere nyangu bangʼ ndalo aboro kosenywole. Achien Isaka nonywolo Jakobo, kendo Jakobo bende nodoko wuon kwerewa apar gariyo.
Kane oyudo Yesu wuotho e dho Nam Galili, noneno owete ariyo, Simon miluongo ni Petro gi owadgi ma Andrea. Noyudo gibolo gokgi e nam, nimar ne gin jolupo.
Kane Yesu obiro e od Petro, noneno min chi Petro ka onindo e kitanda, ka en-gi midhusi.
Magi e nying jopuonjre apar gariyogo: Mokwongo ne en Simon (miluongo ni Petro), gi owadgi ma Andrea; kod Jakobo wuod Zebedi gi owadgi ma Johana;
Ne gitweye mi gitere nyaka ne gichiwe e lwet Pilato, mane en ruoth.
Eka Pilato nopenje niya, “Donge iwinjo neno ma jogi donjonigoni?”
Omiyo ka oganda nosechokore kaachiel, Pilato nopenjogi niya, “En ngʼat mane mudwaro mondo agonynu: Barabas koso Yesu miluongo ni Kristo?”
Nimar Johana Ja-Batiso nobiro ka ok ochiem kata metho, to giwacho ni, ‘En gi jachien.’
Wuod Dhano nobiro ka chiemo kendo metho, to uwacho ni, ‘Neyeuru jawuoro kendo jamer mosiep josol osuru gi joricho.’ To rieko ifwenyo adimba kuom timbene.”
Nimar e ndalo mane pok pi opongʼo piny, ji ne chiemo kendo metho, bende negi kendo kendo ikendogi, nyaka nochopo odiechiengʼ mane Nowa odonjo e yie,
Donge morni ne inyalo loke pesa e nengo mamalo mondo omi jodhier pesago.”
Ne inyalo loke pesa mangʼeny moloyo chudo mar ngʼato kuom higa achiel mi pesago pogi ne joma odhier.” Ne gikwero mamano gi dwol makwiny.
“Angʼo ma nomone hono mo mangʼwe ngʼarno mondo pesa moyudi omi joma odhier? Onge tiende ketho mo ma nengone tek kama, moromo chulo misach ngʼat achiel kuom higa ngima.”
Kane Yesu owinjo wach ngʼatno, nohum nono kendo nowachone joma ne luwo bangʼe niya, “Awachonu adier ni pok ayudo kata ngʼat achiel e piny Israel ma nigi yie maduongʼ machal kama.
Jomoko nokelone ja-athany, konindo e pien. Kane Yesu oneno yie ma jogo ne nigo, nowachone ja-athanyno niya,“Wuoda, bed gi kwe e chunyi, richoni oweni.”
Eka nomulo wengegi kowacho niya, “Biro timorenu kuom yie ma un-go,”
“Kare jatich ma ja-adiera kendo mariek en ngʼa, ma ruodhe omiyo tich mar rito jotije manie ode, ka miyogi chiembgi e sa mowinjore?
“Ruodhe nodwoke ni, ‘Isetimo maber ahinya. In jatich maber kendo ma ja-adiera! Isebedo ja-adiera gi gik matin nono omiyo koro abiro keti jarit gik mangʼeny. Bi idonji e mor mar ruodhi!’
“Ruodhe nodwoke ni, ‘Isetimo maber ahinya. In jatich maber kendo ma ja-adiera! Isebedo ja-adiera gi gik matin nono, omiyo koro abiro keti jarit gik mangʼeny. Bi idonji e mor mar ruodhi!’
Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Beduru motangʼ mondo ngʼato kik wuondu.
Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Beduru motangʼ mondo ngʼato kik wuondu.
Nodwoko niya, “Beduru motangʼ mondo kik wuondu. Nimar ji mangʼeny nobi e nyinga ka hedhore ni, ‘An e en,’ kendo ni, ‘Sa chiegni,’ kik uluwgi.
Giduto negichiemo mi giyiengʼ chuth, kendo bangʼ chiemo jopuonjre nochoko ngʼinjo mag chiemo mane ji ochamo oweyo okepe apar gariyo mopongʼ.
Negichiemo giduto mi giyiengʼ. Bangʼ chiemo jopuonjre nochoko ngʼinjo mag chiemo mane ji ochamo oweyo moromo okepe abiriyo.
kendo bangʼ chiemo jopuonjre nochoko ngʼinjo mag chiemo mane ji ochamo oweyo okepe apar gariyo mopongʼ mag makati gi rech.
Magi duto notimore mondo ochop gima ne Ruoth owacho gi dho janabi niya,
mondo ochop gima nowachi gi dho janabi Isaya niya,
Mano notimore mondo ochop gima nowachi gi dho Janabi Isaya niya, “Nokawo nyawo marwa kendo notingʼo tuochewa.”
Kane ochwalore nyime koa kanyo, noneno owete ariyo mamoko, Jakobo wuod Zebedi gi owadgi ma Johana. Ne gin e yie kaachiel gi wuon-gi ma Zebedi, ka giloso gokegi. Yesu noluongogi,
kendo gisano ne giweyo yie kod wuon-gi mi giluwe.
Eka nodonjo ei yie kendo jopuonjrene noluwe.
Eka Yesu nowachone jopuonjrene niya, “Awachonu adier ni en gima tek mondo jamoko odonji e pinyruodh polo.
Bende anyisou ni yot mondo ngamia okadhi e wangʼ sandan moloyo jamoko donjo e pinyruodh Nyasaye.”
Yot mondo ngamia okadhi e wangʼ sandan moloyo jamoko donjo e pinyruoth Nyasaye.”
Kama e kaka nywol mar Yesu Kristo notimore: Noyudo min mare ma Maria osesingi ne Josef mondo okende, to kane pok gibedo kaachiel, noyude ka en gi ich kuom Roho Maler.
To bangʼ paro mar timo kamano, Malaika mar Ruoth nofwenyorene e lek mowachone niya, “Josef wuod Daudi, kik iluor dhi gi Maria dala kaka chiegi, nikech gima otingʼo e iye owuok kuom Roho Maler.
“An abatisou gi pi mondo omi ulokru uwe richou. To ngʼato biro bangʼa ma oloya gi duongʼ, ma kata akande ok awinjora tingʼo. En obiro batisou gi Roho Maler kod mach.
Kane oneno oganda maduongʼ mane olwore, nokechogi, nikech ne ichandogi kendo gionge gi kony, mana ka rombe maonge gi jakwath.
Joma ok jo-Yahudi duto nochokre e nyime, kendo enopog ji, kopogo ngʼato ka ngʼato gi wadgi, mana kaka jakwath pogo rombe kogolo e dier diek.
Eka Yesu nonyisogi niya, “Otienoni un duto ubiro ringo uweya, nimar ondiki niya, “ ‘Abiro goyo jakwath, mi kweth mag rombe noke.’

An to awachonu ni ngʼato angʼata moriembo chiege nikech wach moro amora makmana richo mar terruok, miyo chiegeno donjo e richo mar terruok, kendo ngʼato angʼata mokendo dhako makamano bende donjo e richo mar terruok.
Nikech chuny ema gik maricho kaka; paro maricho, nek, terruok, chode, kuo, hango wach, gi ketho nying ji wuokie.
Anyisou ni dichwo moro amora moketho keny gi chiege, makmana ne wach chode, mi okendo dhako machielo, to otimo richo mar terruok.”
Bende ka ngʼato angʼata omiyo achiel kuom jomatindogi kata mana pi mangʼich gi kikombe, nikech en japuonjrena, to awachonu adier ni pokne ok nobaye ngangʼ.”
To Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Ok ungʼeyo gima ukwayo. Bende unyalo madho kikombe ma adhi madhoni?” Negidwoke niya, “Wanyalo.”
“Unune malit un jopuonj chik gi jo-Farisai mawuondoregi! Ulwoko ngʼe kikombe gi bakul, to gi e chunygi to gipongʼ gi wuoro kod anjawo.
Nimar ne adenyo to ne umiya gimoro achamo; riyo noloya, to ne umiya gimoro amodho; ne an wendo; kendo nurwaka ei ot;
“Eka joma karego nodwoke ni, ‘Ruoth, karangʼo mane wanenie kidenyo mi wamiyi chiemo, kata ka riyo oloyi, mi wamiyi gimoro imodho?
Nimar ne adenyo, to onge gima numiya mondo acham; riyo noloya, to onge gima numiya mondo amodhi;
Oganda maduongʼ nobiro ire, kendo negikelone rongʼonde, muofni, pudhe, momni gi ji matuo mamoko mangʼeny, mine giketogi e tiende kendo nochangogi.
Eka ngʼat moro ma jatend sinagogi ma nyinge Jairo nobiro kanyo. Kane oneno Yesu nogoyo chonge piny e tiende
To kapo ni tiendi ema teri e richo to ngʼade oko. Ber moloyo kidonjo e ngima kingʼol kar donjo e gehena gi tiende ariyo, [
An Paulo koro akwayou kuom muolo kod ngʼwono mar Kristo mondo uwinja. An ma usebedo kuwacho ni amuol ka an kodu, to ager ka an mabor kodu!
Kuom mano, kaka un jo-Nyasaye moyiero, maler kendo mogeno, rwakreuru gi kech, gi miwafu, gi bolruok, gi muolo, kod kinda.
To in, ngʼat Nyasaye, pogri gi mago duto kiketo chunyi kuom ngima makare kod luoro Nyasaye gi yie kod hera kendo kitimo kinda kod muolo.
“Angʼo momiyo jopuonjreni ketho chike gi timbe mag jodongo? Ok giluok lwetgi kapok gichiemo!”
Joma nomako Yesu nokawe motere nyaka ir Kaifas jadolo maduongʼ, kuma jopuonj chik kod jodongo noyudo osechokoree.
Ka Judas, ngʼat mane ondhoge oneno ka osengʼadne Yesu buch tho, luoro nomake mi nodwoko pesa mamingli mag fedha piero adek ne jodolo madongo gi jodongo,
nowachonegi niya, “Ondiki ni, ‘Oda noluongi ni od lamo,’to un to uloke ‘kar chokruok mar jomecho.’”
Nodwoko niya, “Jachien machal kama inyalo golo mana kuom lamo kod tweyo chiemo.”
Yesu nochako puonjogi kowachonegi niya, “Donge ondiki ni: ‘Oda noluongi ni od lamo mar ogendini duto’?To un useloke ‘kar chokruok mar jomecho.’”
“Joma odhier gie chunygi gin joma ogwedhi, nimar pinyruodh polo en margi.
Muofni neno, rongʼonde wuotho, jogo man-gi dhoho ichango, joma itgi odinore winjo wach, joma otho ichiero, kendo Injili iyalo ne joma odhier.
Yesu nodwoke niya, “Kidwaro doko malongʼo chuth to dhiyo ius gigi duto mondo imi joma odhier eka inibed gi mwandu e polo. Bangʼ timo kamano to bi mondo iluwa.”
Le oseketi e tiend yiende kendo yien ka yien ma ok nyag olemo mabeyo ibiro tongʼ mi go piny kendo witi e mach.
“An abatisou gi pi mondo omi ulokru uwe richou. To ngʼato biro bangʼa ma oloya gi duongʼ, ma kata akande ok awinjora tingʼo. En obiro batisou gi Roho Maler kod mach.
Odheru mare mar piedho cham ni e lwete, kendo obiro yweyo maler kare mar dino cham, kochoko ngano mage okano e dero, to mihudhi to owangʼo gi mach ma ok nyal negi.”
kowachonegi niya, “Dhiuru e dala man nyimu cha kendo udhi yudo mapiyo kanyna moro motwe kuno ka nyathine ni bute kanyo; gonygiuru mondo ukelnagi.
“Nyisuru nyar Sayun niya, ‘Nee, Ruodhi biro iri, obiro komuol, kendo koidho kanyna; koidho kanyna matin, adier en mana nyathi punda.’”
Negikelone kanyna gi nyathi kanyna, kendo negiketo lepgi e ngʼegi, mi Yesu nobet kuomgi.
Gihero bende mondo omosgi e chirni, kendo mondo ji oluong-gi ni, ‘Rabi.’
“To un kik uyie oluongu ni, ‘Rabi,’ nimar un gi Ruoth achiel kende, to un duto un owete.
Eka Judas, ngʼat mane biro ndhoge nowacho niya, “Rabi, dobed an koso?” Yesu nodwoko niya, “Ee, en in.”
kendo nodhi modak e dala miluongo ni Nazareth. Kamano gima nowachi gi dho janabi niya, “Enoluonge ni ja-Nazareth,” nochopo kare.
mondo ochop gima nowachi gi dho janabi Isaya niya,
“Usewinjo bende ni nowachi ni, ‘Kik iketh kwongʼruok, to riti kwongʼruok moro amora misetimone Ruoth Nyasaye.’
To awachonu ni chiengʼ ngʼado bura ji duto biro dwoko wach kuom weche manono ma gisewacho ka ok giparo matut.
To ne ok giyie weche mon-go, nikech wechegi ne nenore koyuma.
Nimar Jal ma Nyasaye oseoro wacho weche Nyasaye, nikech Nyasaye chiwo Rohone mogundho ma ok ongʼwonyo lwete.
Ka waweye odhi nyime kama, to ji duto biro yie kuome, kendo kamano otimore to jo-Rumi biro biro mi kaw karwa ka, kaachiel gi pinywa bende.”
Frugia, Pamfilia, Misri kod gwenge mag Libya mokiewo gi Kurene; kaachiel gi welo moa Rumi, mane otingʼo jo-Yahudi kod joma moko molokore mondo oluw din jo-Yahudi.
ka gipuonjo ji mondo oluw timbe magalagala ma chikwa odagi mondo wan jo-Rumi wayiego kata waluw.”

Kuno nonwangʼo ja-Yahudi moro mane onywol Ponto miluongo ni Akula. Ngʼatno noyudo odar oa Italia gi chiege Priskila, nikech ruoth Klaudio nosegolo chik mondo jo-Yahudi duto odar oa Rumi. Paulo nodhi limogi,
Kane gigo duto osetimore, Paulo nongʼado e chunye mondo odhi Jerusalem, kokadho Makedonia gi Akaya. Nowacho e chunye niya, “Bangʼ dhi Jerusalem, to nyaka alim Rumi bende.”
Otienono Ruoth Yesu nobiro mochungʼ but Paulo mowachone niya, “Bed mana gi chir! Mana kaka isetimo nenda ei Jerusalem, e kaka nyaka itime e Rumi bende.”
E kindeno Yesu noyudo kadho e kind puothe mag cham chiengʼ Sabato. To jopuonjrene nodenyo, omiyo negichako jako wi ngano moko mochiek mondo gicham.
Ka jo-Farisai noneno mano, negiwachone niya, “Neye! Jopuonjreni timo gima chik ok oyie mondo gitim chiengʼ Sabato.”
Koso pok usomo e Chik ni chiengʼ Sabato, jodolo manie hekalu doko mogak odiechiengʼno, to ok kwan-gi kaka joketho?
To kane oneno jo-Farisai gi jo-Sadukai ka biro kama ne obatisoe ji, nowachonegi niya, “Un koth thuondegi! En ngʼa mane onyisou mondo uring utony ne mirima mager mabiro?
Jo-Farisai gi jo-Sadukai nobiro ir Yesu mi oteme kapenje ka gidwaro mondo onyisgie ranyisi moa e polo.
Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Beduru motangʼ kendo ritreuru ne thowi mar jo-Farisai gi jo-Sadukai.”
Koro e yo kane odhiyo Jerusalem, Yesu nowuotho e kind Samaria gi Galili.
To nochune ni nyaka okadh e piny Samaria.
Kuom mano, nochopo e dala moro e piny Samaria miluongo ni Sukar, mane ni machiegni gi puodho mane Jakobo omiyo Josef wuode.
Yesu nooro ji apar gariyogi gi ote machal kama: “Kik udhi e dier joma ok jo-Yahudi, kendo kik udonj e dala moro amora mar jo-Samaria.
Eka nooro joote mondo otel nyime odhi e dala jo-Samaria mondo oikne gik moko;
To ja-Samaria moro mane dhi wuoth nochopo kama ne ngʼatno nitie, kendo ka nonene, nokeche.
Negimor mar timo ma, to chutho gin jogop jogo. Nimar owinjore mondo joma ok jo-Yahudi, moseyudo konyruok mar chuny mar jo-Yahudi opog negie mwandu mag pinyni.

Koro ma e sunga marwa: Chunywa miyowa ratiro ni wasedak e pinyni, to moloyo e winjruok marwa kodu, ka waluoro Nyasaye kendo ka wawuotho e ler mar adier. Ok wasedak kamano nikech waluwo rieko mar pinyni, to nikech ngʼwono mar Nyasaye.
Nikech gige lweny mwakedogo ok gin mag pinyni, to gin gige lweny mager mag Nyasaye, mwakonyorego kuom muko kuonde mochiel motegno.
nomedo wacho ni, ‘Kuom mano, dichwo nowe wuon kod min kendo nopadre gi chiege, mi ji ariyogo nodok ringruok achiel?’
Omiyo koro ok gin ji ariyo, to gin ringruok achiel. Kuom mano, gima Nyasaye oseriwo kaachiel kik dhano moro amora pogi.”
Beduru motangʼ kendo lamuru mondo kik udonj e tem. Chuny oikore makmana ringruok to nyap.”
Yesu nowachone niya, “Aa kuoma, Satan! Nikech ondiki ni, ‘Lam Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi kendo en kende ema itine.’”
Ka Satan riembo Satan to mano nyiso ni en gi pogruok kende owuon. Koro ere kaka pinyruodhe nyalo chungo?
Yesu nolokore mowachone Petro niya, “Wuog oko e nyima, Satan! In kidi mar chwanyruok ne an; nikech iketo pachi kuom dwaro dhano to ok kuom dwach Nyasaye.”
Oganda noked gi oganda machielo, kendo pinyruoth gi pinyruoth machielo. Kech nobedi kuonde mangʼeny kendo piny noyiengni kuonde mopogore opogore.
To piny noyiengni matek, nimar malaika mar Ruoth nolor piny koa e polo, mi nodhi nyaka e liel mongʼielo kidi oko e dho liel kendo obetie.
Oganda noked gi oganda machielo, kendo pinyruoth noked gi pinyruoth machielo. Piny noyiengni kuonde mopogore opogore kendo kech nobedi e piny. Magi e chakruok mar rem mar muoch ma nobedie.

Bangʼ mano joote gi jodongo kod kanisa, nongʼado wach mondo giyier jomoko kuomgi gior Antiokia kaachiel gi Paulo kod Barnaba. Ne giyiero Judas ma niluongo ni Barsaba gi Sila, mane gin jotelo e dier owete.
Kaluwore gi mano, waoro bende Judas gi Sila mondo onyisu gi dhogi weche mwandikonu e baruwani.
Judas gi Sila, mane gin jonabi, nomedo wuoyo gi owete ka gijiwogi kendo gitegogi e yie.
Kane oyudo Yesu wuotho e dho Nam Galili, noneno owete ariyo, Simon miluongo ni Petro gi owadgi ma Andrea. Noyudo gibolo gokgi e nam, nimar ne gin jolupo.
Magi e nying jopuonjre apar gariyogo: Mokwongo ne en Simon (miluongo ni Petro), gi owadgi ma Andrea; kod Jakobo wuod Zebedi gi owadgi ma Johana;
Simon ma ja-Zilote gi Judas Iskariot mane ondhoge.
Odheru mare mar piedho cham ni e lwete, kendo obiro yweyo maler kare mar dino cham, kochoko ngano mage okano e dero, to mihudhi to owangʼo gi mach ma ok nyal negi.”
To kane oyudo ji duto nindo, jasike nobiro mopidho buya e dier ngano, bangʼe to odhi.
“To nodwoko ni, ‘Ooyo, kik utim kamano nikech seche ma upudho buyago unyalo pudho ngano bende kaachiel kodgi.
Yesu nolokore mowachone Petro niya, “Wuog oko e nyima, Satan! In kidi mar chwanyruok ne an; nikech iketo pachi kuom dwaro dhano to ok kuom dwach Nyasaye.”
Daudi bende wacho ni: “Mad mesagi bednegi obadho gi otegu, kod kidi mar chwanyruok kendo gir chulo kuor ne gin.
Owetena, asiemou mondo ungʼi maber joma kelo pogruok, kendo keto chwanyruok e yoreu ma ok oluwore gi puonj museyudo. Wereuru kodgi.
“Kwereu ne ni kod Hema miluongo ni Hemb Rapar. Hemano nolosi mana kaka Nyasaye nonyiso Musa mondo olose, koluwo ranyisi mane omiye.
Ne olos hema ma opog iye ariyo. Kama ikwongo donjoe ne iluongo ni Kama Ler, kendo kanyo noketie rachung taya gi mesa moketie makati miketo e nyim Nyasaye pile.
E tok pasia mar ariyo ne nitie hema miluongo ni Kama Ler Moloyo,
joma odak e mudho oseneno ler maduongʼ; jogo modak e piny ma tipo mar tho oumo, ler oserienynegi.”
To ka wengeni richo to ringri duto biro pongʼ gi mudho. Omiyo ka ler manie iyi en mudho, to mano kaka en mudho maduongʼ miwuoro!
To jokanyo mag pinyruoth to nodir oko e mudho mandiwa, kama ji nobed gi ywagruok malich ka gimwodo lekegi.”
to Jesse ne en wuon Ruoth Daudi. Daudi ne en wuon Solomon, ma min-gi, kane pok Daudi okawe, ne en chi Uria,
Solomon ne en wuon Rehoboam, Rehoboam ne en wuon Abija, to Abija ne en wuon Asa.
To kata kamano awachonu ni kata mana Solomon e rwakruokne malich duto ne ok orwakore ka achiel kuomgi.
Wuod Dhano nobiro ka chiemo kendo metho, to uwacho ni, ‘Neyeuru jawuoro kendo jamer mosiep josol osuru gi joricho.’ To rieko ifwenyo adimba kuom timbene.”

Ruoth ma dhako mar piny ma milambo nochungʼ chiengʼ bura kaachiel gi tiengʼni kendo nongʼadne bura kaka jaketho, nimar nobiro koa e tungʼ piny kuma bor mondo owinj rieko Solomon, to sani koro nitie ngʼato ka maduongʼ moloyo Solomon.
Kane ochopo dalagi, nochako puonjo ji e sinagokegi, kendo negihum nono, ka gipenjore niya, “Rieko gi teko mar timo honni ma ngʼatni nigogi oyudo kanye?
E sechego Yesu nowacho niya, “Apakoi Wuonwa, Ruodh polo gi piny, nikech isepando gigi ne joma riek gi joma osomo, to isefwenyogi ne nyithindo matindo.
Emomiyo eri koro aoronu jonabi gi joma riek kod jopuonj. Moko kuomgi ubiro nego kendo ubiro guro; moko ubiro rodho e sinagokeu kendo ubiro lawogi e dala ka dala.

E sechego ka Roho Maler nomiyo Yesu opongʼ gi ilo, nowacho niya, “Apakoi, Wuonwa, Ruodh polo gi piny, nikech isepando gigi ne joma riek gi joma osomo, to isefwenyogi ne nyithindo matindo. Ee, Wuora, nimar mano ema ne berni kotimore.
Kane oneno oganda maduongʼ mane olwore, nokechogi, nikech ne ichandogi kendo gionge gi kony, mana ka rombe maonge gi jakwath.
Kane Yesu ogowo loka, noneno oganda maduongʼ, nokechogi kendo nochango jogo duto mane tuo.
Yesu nokechogi, mi nomulo wengegi. Gikanyono negichako neno, kendo ne giluwe.
Omiyo koro hera moherougo osemedore moloyo, koparo kaka un duto ne uwinjo wachwa, kendo kaka ne urwake kumiye luoro maduongʼ.
Nyasaye owuon nyalo timo nenda kaka chunya gombou duto ka an-gi hera matut mar Kristo Yesu.
Ka bedowa kuom Kristo nyalo kelonwa hoch, kata hera maduogo chuny, kata lalruok kuom Roho, kata ngʼwono kod miwafu,
Kane gin e yo gidhi, negiromo gi ja-Kurene moro miluongo ni Simon, kendo ne gichune mondo otingʼ msalaba.
kendo giwacho niya, “In manyocha iwacho ni inyalo ketho hekalu mi ichak igere bangʼ ndalo adekni, koro resri kendi ane! Ka in wuod Nyasaye to wuog ane e msalaba ilor piny!”
“Ne oreso jomoko, to en koro ok onyal resore owuon! Donge en Ruodh Israel? Dak koro oa ewi msalaba olor piny ka sani mondo wayie kuome.
eka ne gikado osimbo mar kudho kendo gisidho e wiye. Negiketo odundu e lwete korachwich, eka gigoyo chong-gi piny e nyime, kendo negichako jare kagiwacho niya, “Misawa, ruodh jo-Yahudi!”
Negibolo kuom Yesu kandho makwar, eka ne gikado osimbo mar kudho kendo gisidho e wiye.
Jolweny nokado osimbo mar kudho, mi gisidhone kendo negiketo e wiye. Ne girwakone kandho makwar,
In to in ngʼa ma inyalo ngʼado bura ne jatich ngʼat machielo? Kochungʼ kata kopodho, to obadho mana ruodhe owuon, kendo obiro mi ochungʼ motegno nimar Ruoth nigi teko mar miyo ochungʼ.
Beduru motangʼ, kendo chunguru motegno e yie maru, bende beduru jochir kendo motegno.
Kristo nogonyowa mondo wabed joma ni thuolo. Omiyo chungʼuru motegno, kendo kik uyie tingʼ mapek kurwako jok mar wasumbini kendo.
To Judas nodhi ir jodolo madongo kod jotend jorit hekalu kendo noloso kodgi kaka onyalo ndhogo Yesu.
Eka Yesu nowachone jodolo madongo, jotelo mag jorit hekalu, kod jodongo, mane obiro ire, niya, “An jatend koko mar jo-jendeke, momiyo ubiro ira gi ligengni kod arunge?
Kane Petro gi Johana pod wuoyo gi ji, jodolo gi jatend jorit hekalu kod jo-Sadukai nobiro irgi.
Eka askeche ruoth nokawo Yesu motero nyaka e laru mar od ruoth, kendo negichokore oganda askeche duto mi gilwore gikete diere.
Kane jodolo madongo oseromo gi jodongo mi gichano gima negidwaro timo, negimiyo askeche pesa mangʼeny,
Askeche nokawo Yesu motero e laru mar od ruoth (tiende ni Paratori) kama ne ji romee, mine giluongo oganda mar askeche duto irgi.
Nikech oganda maduongʼ nochokore molwore, nodonjo ei yie mi obetie, ka ji duto to ochungʼ oko e dho nam.
Eka jodolo madongo gi jodong oganda nochokore e dala jadolo maduongʼ, mane nyinge Kaifas,
Kuom mano ji mangʼeny nochokore mopongʼo ot mane entie maonge kama ilwaroe kata mana kede, koda ka dhoot oko, to Yesu nopuonjogi Wach.
Kane omedo dhi nyime koa kanyo, nodhi nyaka ei sinagogi,
Negidhi Kapernaum, to kane Sabato ochopo, Yesu nodonjo e sinagogi mi ochako puonjo.
To kanyono ei sinagogi ne nitie ngʼat moro mane nigi jachien marach. Ngʼatni noywak matek kowacho niya,
Joma sand nokeyo nikech wach nek Stefano nodhi Foinike, Saipras nyaka Antiokia, ka gilando Injili ne jo-Yahudi kende.
To jomoko kuomgi mane oa Saipras kod Kurene, nodhi Antiokia ma gichako wuoyo gi jo-Yunani bende, ka ginyisogi Injili ma wuoyo kuom Ruoth Yesu.
Wachni nolandore mochopo e it kanisa mane ni Jerusalem, omiyo negioro Barnaba e dala Antiokia.

Humbe nolandore e piny Siria duto, kendo ji nokelone joma ne tuo gi kit tuoche mayoreyore gi joma ne nigi rem mapek gi joma ne nigi jochiende gi joma ne chunygi yudhore kod joma ne nigi athany, mi nochangogi.
(Ma ne en kweno mokwongo mane otimore ka Kwirinio ne en ruodh Siria.)
Jogi noor gi baruwa mondiki kama: Wan joote gi jodongo, ma wan oweteu kuom Ruoth, Ne un joma ok jo-Yahudi moyie man Antiokia gi Siria kod Kilikia: Wamosou,
Omiyo pogruok nobedo e kind ji nikech wach Yesu.
Wechegi nomedo kelo pogruok e kind jo-Yahudi.
Jowetena, asayou e nying Ruodhwa Yesu Kristo, mondo un duto uwinjru ngʼato gi ngʼato. Kik pogruok moro amora bedi e kindu, to beduru kuriworu maonge pogruok, ka un gi dwaro achiel kod paro achiel.
Kik uluor jogo manego ringruok to ok nyal nego chuny. To ngʼama onego uluor en Jal manyalo tieko chuny kaachiel gi ringruok e gehena.
“Awachonu osiepena, kik uluor jogo manego ringruok to bangʼe onge gima ginyalo medo timo.
Eka negipenje niya, “Mano notimre kanye, Ruoth?” Nodwokogi niya, “Kama ringruok motho nitie, ema achudhe chokore.”
Osechungonwa tungʼ mar warruok marwa, e od jatichne Daudi,
warruok ae lwet wasikwa, kendo ae lwet jogo duto mamon kodwa,
kendo imi joge ngʼeyo wach mar warruok kuom weruok mar richogi,
Achiel kuomgi nomiyo pesa moromo talanta abich, to machielo nomiyo talanta ariyo, kendo machielo talanta achiel; komiyo moro ka moro kuomgi pesa maromre gi nyalone. Eka nodhi e wuodhe.
Ngʼama nomi talanta abich nodhi sano sano moketo pesane e tich, kendo noyudo talanta abich mamoko kaka ohande.
Ngʼat mane nigi talanta abich nokelo talanta abich mamoko ewi mane omiye, kendo nowachone ruodhe ni, ‘Ruoth, ne imiya talanta abich, to neye, aseloso abich mamoko e wiye.’
Owacho bende kamachielo niya, “In Jadolo nyaka chiengʼ koluwo kit dolo mar Melkizedek.”
Bende Nyasaye nokete jadolo maduongʼ koluwo kit dolo mar Melkizedek.
kama Yesu ma nosetelonwa nosedonjoe. Osedoko jadolo maduongʼ manyaka chiengʼ, koluwo kit dolo mar Melkizedek.
to jolupne nokawe mokete e okapu, eka gilore piny kokalo e otuchi moro manie kor ohinga mar dala.
To ne atony, kane oketa ei osera, mi olora piny kakadho e otuchi manie kor ohinga.
Yie ema nomiyo ohinga mag Jeriko opodho piny, bangʼ ka jo-Israel nosewuotho ka lwore kuom ndalo abiriyo.
Kendo kik upar e kindu uwegi ni, ‘Wan gi Ibrahim kaka wuonwa.’ Awachonu ni kata mana kuom kitegi Nyasaye nyalo loko nyithind Ibrahim.
Nyaguru olemo manyiso ni uselokoru uweyo richo. Kendo kik upar e kindu uwegi ni, ‘Wan gi Ibrahim kaka wuonwa.’ Nimar awachonu ni kata mana kitegi Nyasaye nyalo loko nyithind Ibrahim.
To ji duto mane orwake, mi oyie kuome, nomiyogi teko mar doko nyithind Nyasaye,
Kuom mano, beduru malongʼo chuth mana kaka Wuonu manie polo longʼo chuth.
Yesu nodwoke niya, “Kidwaro doko malongʼo chuth to dhiyo ius gigi duto mondo imi joma odhier eka inibed gi mwandu e polo. Bangʼ timo kamano to bi mondo iluwa.”
Kik koro ulu kit ngima pinyni, to lokreuru ka parou doko manyien pile, eka unubed gi nyalo mar pimo kendo ngʼeyo dwach Nyasaye, ma en dwache maber, mowinjore kendo malongʼo chuth.
Ka uhero mana joma oherou kende, to pok mane muyudo? Donge kata josol osuru bende timo mano?
Kane oyudo Yesu chiemo e od Mathayo, josol osuru mangʼeny kod joricho mangʼeny nobiro mochiemo kode kaachiel gi jopuonjrene bende.
Kane jo-Farisai oneno mano, negipenjo jopuonjrene niya, “Angʼo momiyo japuonju chiemo gi josol osuru kod joricho?”
Jomoko nobiro kokelone ja-athany ka ji angʼwen otingʼe.
Kane Yesu ochopo, to noyudo ka Lazaro osetieko ndalo angʼwen e bur.

Kane jolweny oseguro Yesu, negikawo lepe mi gipogogi nyadingʼwen, bangʼe gipogore moro ka moro, kargi ji angʼwen. Lawe mar kandho kende ema ne giweyo. En ne oonge gi wangʼ usi, to notwangʼe machalre, chakre malo nyaka piny.
Paulo nowuotho mochopo Derbe gi Lustra, kama japuonjre moro nodakie miluongo ni Timotheo. Min Timotheo ne ja-Yahudi moyie kuom Yesu, to wuon-gi ne ja-Yunani.
Jowete nooro Paulo e dho nam ma ok odeko, ka Sila gi Timotheo to jodong Berea.
Joma ne odhi gi Paulo notere nyaka Athene, bangʼe negidok Berea mi ginyiso Sila gi Timotheo yo mane ginyalo chopogo ir Paulo mapiyo.
to ne pod aonge gi kwe e chunya nikech ne ok ayudo owadwa Tito kuno. Omiyo ne agoyo oriti ne jogo, mi adhi Makedonia.
To Nyasaye, ma jiwo joma chunygi onyosore, nojiwowa kane Tito obiro irwa,
Wechegi duto osejiwowa. Kaachiel gi jip mane wayudo koa kuomwa wawegi, moloyo to ne wamor kane waneno mor mane Tito nigo, nikech dhial mane umiye.
Eka negichopo kama iluongo ni Golgotha (tiende ni “Hanga Wich”).
Koro ne gitero Yesu kama iluongo ni Golgotha (tiende ni “Hanga Wich”).
Kane gichopo kama iluongo ni kar Hanga Wich, negigure kanyo, kaachiel gi joketho, ka ngʼato achiel nitie e bathe korachwich, to ngʼat machielo e bathe koracham.
Eka Herode noluongo ajuokego lingʼ-lingʼ, kendo ne ononogi, mi neginyise kinde nogono mane sulwe onenore.
Eka gima Nyasaye nomiyo janabi Jeremia owacho nochopo kare:
Eka Yesu nobiro koa e piny Galili nyaka e aora Jordan mondo Johana obatise.
“To joge nosin kode kendo negioro joote modhiyo ire mondo giwach ni, ‘Ok wadwar ngʼatni mondo obed ruodhwa.’
Eka negichako donjone kagiwacho niya, “Waseyudo ngʼatni kokelo tulo e pinywa. Okwedo golo osuru ni Kaisar kendo owacho owuon ni en Kristo, ma Ruoth.”
to nowachonegi niya, “Ne ukelo ngʼatni ira kaka jal mamiyo ji goyo koko ka gidagi, winjo chik. Asenone e nyimu to ok aseyudo gima dimi odonjne.
Dhakono nodwoke niya, “Mano en adier Ruoth, to kata guogi bende chamo ngʼinjo molwar piny koa e mesa mar ruodhgi.”
Dhakono nodwoke kowacho niya, “Mano en adier, Ruoth, to kata mana guogi man e bwo mesa bende chamo ngʼinjo ma nyithindo olwaro piny.”
kendo nogombo chamo ngʼinjo molwar e bwo mesa jamokono. Kata mana guogi bende ne biro minangʼ adhondene.
“An abatisou gi pi mondo omi ulokru uwe richou. To ngʼato biro bangʼa ma oloya gi duongʼ, ma kata akande ok awinjora tingʼo. En obiro batisou gi Roho Maler kod mach.
An abatisou gi pi, to en obiro batisou gi Roho Maler.”
Johana nodwokogi duto niya, “An abatisou gi pi. To ngʼato moro biro bangʼa ma oloya gi duongʼ, ma ok awinjora gonyo tond wuochene. En obiro batisou gi Roho Maler kod mach.
“Unune malit un jopuonj chik gi jo-Farisai mawuondoregi! Uloro pinyruodh polo mondo kik ji odonje. Un uwegi ok udonji, to joma temo mondo odonji bende ugengʼonegi. [
“Malit ochomou, un jopuonj chik gi jo-Farisai mawuondoregi! Uwuotho alanda, kungʼado piny gi nembe mondo ulokie kata ngʼato achiel, to koselokore to umiyo obedo koth Gehena moloyou nyadiriyo.

“Unune malit un jopuonj chik gi jo-Farisai mawuondoregi! Uchiwo achiel kuom apar mar gik ma milimili kaka kado, apoth kod onyulo. To ok usedewo gik madongo moloyo ma chik dwaro, kaka adiera gi kech kod yie. Owinjore ne utim gik ma achien-go ka ok uweyo mak utimo mokwongogo.
Ji duto nochau nikech an, to ngʼat ma ochungʼ motegno nyaka giko ema noresi.

to kinda kelo kido maber to kido maber kelo geno.

mondo kik obed gima ongʼere ne ji ni itweyo chiemo, to Wuonu ma ok ne kende ema ongʼe. Eka Wuonu maneno gima otim lingʼ-lingʼ nomiyi pokni.
To kane oneno jo-Farisai gi jo-Sadukai ka biro kama ne obatisoe ji, nowachonegi niya, “Un koth thuondegi! En ngʼa mane onyisou mondo uring utony ne mirima mager mabiro?
Nimar awachonu ni ka ok ber maru oyombo mano mar jo-Farisai gi mar jopuonj chik to ok unudonji e pinyruodh polo ngangʼ.

Bangʼe nokelo wiye koketo e san kendo nomi nyakono, mane otingʼe otere ne min mare.
Odhiambono, ka piny noseyuso, ji nokelo ne Yesu jotuo duto kaachiel gi joma nigi jochiende.

Paulo bende ikneuru farase mondo obi oidhi otere nyaka ir ruoth Feliks, ma ok gimoro otime e yo.”
An Klaudio Lusio, amosi ahinya in ruoth Feliks.
Wamor kodi, moluor Feliks, nikech ber duto misekelonwa, osemiyo wadak maber kuonde duto kendo e yore duto.
to ngʼeuru ni ngʼat ma kamano wuondore kende owuon bende onge gima ongʼeyo. Ngʼat ma kamano kasore gi mino wach kendo gigoyo mbaka manono makelo nyiego, gi dhawo, gi kuoth, kod chich maricho;

Nikech wan bende chon ne wan joma ofuwo ma ok winj wach kendo wasumbini mag kit gombo gi mor mayoreyore mag ringruok. Ngimawa mapile nopongʼ gi ichlit gi nyiego; ka ji mon kodwa kendo wan bende onge winjruok e kindwa.
Koso uparo ni muma wacho kayiem ni chuny Nyasaye moketo mondo odag eiwa nigi nyiego mager.
Filipo gi Bartholomayo; Thoma gi Mathayo ma jasol osuru; Jakobo wuod Alfayo, gi Thadayo;
Noyudo Herode osemako Johana mi otweye nikech wach Herodia ma chi owadgi ma nyinge Filipo,
gi Andrea, Filipo, Bartholomayo, Mathayo; gi Thoma, Jakobo wuod Alfayo, Thadayo, Simon ma ja-Zilote,
Nikech chuny ema gik maricho kaka; paro maricho, nek, terruok, chode, kuo, hango wach, gi ketho nying ji wuokie.
Nikech chuny dhano ema richo duto wuokie kaka: paro maricho, chode, kuo, nek, terruok,
To e ndalono ja-kiragi moro ma nyinge Barabas, ne ni e od twech, kaachiel gi jojiemo mamoko manotwe kuom wach nek kod pingo loch.
Mogik owetena, oritiuru. Beduru joma kare, winjuru wechena, beduru gi paro achiel, kendo beduru gi kwe. Eka Nyasach hera kod kwe nobed kodu.
An gi geno kuom Ruoth ni ok ubi yie rwako paro moro mopogore moa kuom ngʼat machielo. To ngʼatno mosewitou gi puonj mobamno nyaka Nyasaye bi kume, kata bed ni en ngʼama nade.
to kare beduru gi paro achiel, gihera achiel kod chuny achiel mondo umi chunya opongʼ gi mor.

“Los weche piyo piyo gi ngʼama odonjoni madwa teri e od bura. Tim kamano kapod un kode e yo, nono to onyalo keti e lwet jangʼad bura to jangʼad bura nyalo keti e lwet askari, kendo inyalo boli e od twech.
mi nongʼad wi Johana ka en e od twech.
“To nodagi. Kar timo kamano to noa kanyo mi oloso wach mondo orwak ngʼatno e od twech nyaka chop ochul gowino.
Nodwoko niya, “Yien moro amora ma Wuonwa manie polo ok opidho ibiro pudh oko gi tiendene.

“Winjuru ngero machielo. Ne nitie wuon puodho moro mane opidho mzabibu e puothe. Nochiele gi ohinga, mi okunyo bugo mibiyoe olemo mochiek e iye, kendo ogero ne osuch ngʼicho. Eka ne oketo puothe mar mzabibuno e lwet jopur moko, bangʼe nowuok odhi e wuoth moro mabor.

Bangʼ mano Yesu nochako wuoyo kodgi gi ngeche mopogore opogore kama: “Ngʼat moro ne opidho mzabibu e puothe. Nochiele gi ohinga, mi okunyo bugo mibiyoe olemo mochiek, kendo ogero ne osuch ngʼicho. Eka ne oketo puothe mar mzabibuno e lwet jopur moko bangʼe nowuok odhi e wuoth moro mabor.
Beduru mamor kendo moil, nikech poku duongʼ e polo, nimar jonabi mane okwongonu bende negisando mana kamano.”
To awachonu adier ni ka oyude to obedo mamor kuom rombo achielno, moloyo kuom piero ochiko gochiko mane ok olal.
“Beduru mamor e ndalono kendo chikreuru ka uil, nikech poku duongʼ e polo. Nimar mano e kaka kweregi notimo ne jonabi.
To kodhi mane ochwo kuonde motimo lwanda ochungʼ kar ngʼama winjo wach kendo rwake sano gi mor.
“Pinyruodh polo chalo gi mwandu mopandi e puodho, ma ngʼat moro nonwangʼo kendo nopando, eka noa kanyo kopongʼ gi mor kendo nodhi mouso gige duto mane en-go modwogo ongʼiewogo puodhono.
“Ruodhe nodwoke ni, ‘Isetimo maber ahinya. In jatich maber kendo ma ja-adiera! Isebedo ja-adiera gi gik matin nono omiyo koro abiro keti jarit gik mangʼeny. Bi idonji e mor mar ruodhi!’
To malaika nowachone niya, “Kik iluor Maria, nikech Nyasaye osetimoni ngʼwono.
To nyathino nodongo kendo nobedo motegno; nopongʼ kod rieko, kendo ngʼwono mar Nyasaye ne ni kuome.
To Yesu nomedo dongo kobedo gi rieko kendo e ringruok, ka en gi ngʼwono gi Nyasaye kod ji.
Agombo nenou ahinya mondo apognue mich moko mag chuny mondo ategugo,

Mich mar Nyasaye ok chal gi timo richo. Nikech ka ji mangʼeny notho nikech timo richo mar ngʼat achiel, to nobedo maber manade ka ngʼwono mar Nyasaye kod mich manobiro kuom ngʼwono mar ngʼat achielno, ma en Yesu Kristo, nochiw mogundho ni ji mangʼeny.

To bende mich Nyasaye opogore gi gima richo mar ngʼat achiel nokelo. Bura nobiro nikech richo mar ngʼato achielno mokele kum, to richo mar ji mangʼeny nokelo ngʼwono mane omiyo ji duto obedoe e winjruok gi Nyasaye.
Odheru mare mar piedho cham ni e lwete, kendo obiro yweyo maler kare mar dino cham, kochoko ngano mage okano e dero, to mihudhi to owangʼo gi mach ma ok nyal negi.”
Nomulo lwete mi midhusi noweye, kendo noa malo mochako miyogi chiemo.
to ne nitie ngʼato kanyo ma lwete notal. Negipenjo Yesu, ka gidwaro yo ma digiyudgo ketho kuome, niya, “Bende chik oyie mondo ochang ngʼato chiengʼ Sabato?”
“Kik umi guogi gima ler; bende kik udir ne anguro kite magu ma nengogi tek. Kutimo kamano to ginyalo nyonogi piny e bwo tiendegi mi gilokre kodu kendo gikidhu matindo tindo.
To mochwalore matin koa kama negintie, kweth maduongʼ mar anguro moko ne kwayo.
Jochiendego nosayo Yesu kawacho niya, “Kigolowa kuom ji ariyogi to orwa wadonji ei kweth mag anguro.”
Eka Petro nowachone niya, “Fedha gi dhahabu aongego, to gima an-go ema amiyi. E nying Yesu Kristo ja-Nazareth, chungi iwuothi.”
Pok agombo fedha kata dhahabu kata law ngʼato.
ne nitie kendo mar misango molos gi dhahabu miwangʼoe ubani kod Sandug Muma mowir gi dhahabu gi ludh Harun mane chako loth, kod kite mopa mondikie singruok.

Un nyithind wuonu ma Satan kendo dwach wuonuno ema uhero timo. Ne en janek nyaka aa chakruok, kendo ok odwar adiera nikech adiera onge kuome. Koriambo to otimo gima ongʼiyogo, nimar en ja-miriambo, kendo en e wuon miriambo duto.
Kata obedo ni ok ungʼeye, anto angʼeye. Ka anyalo wacho ni ok angʼeye, to anyalo bedo ja-miriambo mana ka un, to angʼeye adier kendo pile angʼeyo wachne.
Ooyo, ok kamano kata matin! Nyasaye nyaka bed ja-adiera, to ji duto jo-miriambo, mana kaka ondiki niya, “Mondo ibedi kare ka iwuoyo kendo ilochi ka ingʼadona bura.”
Negidwoke niya, “Gin mag Kaisar.” Eka nowachonegi niya, “Miuru Kaisar gige Kaisar, to miuru Nyasaye gige Nyasaye.”
Eka Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Miuru Kaisar gige Kaisar, to miuru Nyasaye gige Nyasaye.” Jogo ne dhogi omoko.
Nowachonegi niya, “Udwoko kare, koro miuru Kaisar gige Kaisar, to miuru Nyasaye gige Nyasaye.”
Yesu nodwokogi niya, “Doguru mondo udwok wach ne Johana gik muwinjo kendo uneno:
To nodwokogi niya, “Tiengʼ ma timbene richo kendo mamono manyo ranyisi mar hono! To ok bi miye moro amora makmana ranyisi mar janabi Jona.
Nodwokogi niya, “Un osemiu rieko mar ngʼeyo tiend gik mopondo mag pinyruodh polo, to gin ok osemigi.
kendo negichano mondo gimak Yesu e yo moro malingʼ-lingʼ mondo ginege.
mondo ojare, mi ngʼudh olawo kuome kendo chwade mi nyaka ginege. To bangʼ ndalo adek obiro chier.”
Omiyo negimake mi ginege eka bangʼe to gidire oko mar puoth mzabibu.
E kindeno ja-Yahudi moro monywol Aleksandria, ma nyinge Apolo, nobiro Efeso. Ne en gi ngʼeyo matut e puonj mag Muma.
Kane Apolo ni Korintho, Paulo nowuotho e gwenge mamalo, nyaka nochopo Efeso. Kuno noyude jopuonjre moko,

Tiend gima awacho chal kama: Ngʼat moro kuomu wacho niya, “An ngʼat Paulo,” to ngʼat machielo to wacho niya, “An ngʼat Apolo,” machielo bende oramo niya, “An ngʼat Kefa,” to moro wacho niya, “An ngʼat Kristo.”
Joote noduogo onyiso Yesu gik moko duto mane gisetimo kendo puonjo.
Kane okinyi ochopo, noluongo jopuonjre ire kendo noyiero apar gariyo kuomgi, mane owalo obedo joote:
Ka joote noduogo neginyiso Yesu gima negisetimo. Eka nokawogi modhi kodgi ka gin kendgi giwegi e dala miluongo ni Bethsaida,
Bangʼ ndalo manok, ruoth Agripa kod Bernike nobiro Kaisaria mondo omos Festo.
Eka Agripa nowachone Festo niya, “Daher mondo awinje weche ngʼatno an bende.” Nodwoke niya, “Kiny niwinje.”

Kinyne Agripa kod Bernike nobiro gi dhialruok maduongʼ ka gidonjo e od bura. Negidonjo kaachiel gi jodong jolweny madongo kod jodong dalano mamoko mogen. Eka Festo nogolo chik mondo okel Paulo e nyimgi, mi nokele.
Nomulo lwete mi midhusi noweye, kendo noa malo mochako miyogi chiemo.
To apoya nono, dhako moro mane osebedo ka iye chwer kuom higni apar gariyo nopore gi yo katoke kendo nomulo riak lawe.
Eka nomulo wengegi kowacho niya, “Biro timorenu kuom yie ma un-go,”
To ngʼat mane oyudo talanta achiel nowuok odhi mokunyo bur ei lowo, kendo oyiko pesa ruodhe kanyo.
mopenjogi niya, “Angʼo mubiro miya ka achiwe e lwetu?” Omiyo ne gikwanone pesa mamingli mag fedha piero adek.
Ka Judas, ngʼat mane ondhoge oneno ka osengʼadne Yesu buch tho, luoro nomake mi nodwoko pesa mamingli mag fedha piero adek ne jodolo madongo gi jodongo,

Eka ne aneno Nyarombo machalo ka gima ne osenegi kochungo e dier kom duongʼ, kolwore gi gik mangima angʼwen kod jodongo. Ne en gi tunge abiriyo gi wenge abiriyo ma gin Roho abiriyo mag Nyasaye moseor e piny mangima.

E sa mane okawoe kitabuno gik mangima angʼwen ka gi Jodongo piero ariyo gangʼwen-go ne opodho auma e nyim Nyarombo. Moro ka moro kuomgi ne nigi nyatiti kod tewni mag dhahabu ma ubani opongʼo. Tewni mag ubanigo ochungʼ kar lemo mar jomaler.
Ne giwer gi dwol maduongʼ niya: “Duongʼ obed ni Nyarombo manonegi, mondo oyud loch gi mwandu, gi rieko gi luor, gi duongʼ kod pak.”
Donge nodonjo e od Nyasaye, kendo en kaachiel gi joma ne ni kode, negichamo makati ma nosepwodhi moket tenge, ma chik ne ok oyienegi mondo gitim, makmana jodolo kende
To negidwoke niya, “Wan gima wan-go ka en mana makati abich gi rech ariyo kende.”
Eka nogolo chik mondo ji obed piny e lum. Bangʼe nokawo makati abichgo gi rech ariyogo, nongʼiyo polo malo, kogoyo erokamano. Nongʼingo makatigo mi nomiyo jopuonjre kendo jopuonjre nomiyogi ji.
Kama wantiereni nitie jo-Parthia, Media, Elam, Mesopotamia, Judea, Kapadokia, Ponto, Asia,

Kata kamano, jomoko nochako kedo kode. Jogi ne gin jokanyo mar oganda mane iluongo ni sinagogi mar wasumbini mogony. Ne gin jo-Yahudi modak Kurene, gi Aleksandria kod gwenge mag Kilikia kod Asia. Jogi nochako mino wach gi Stefano,
Kaka Roho Maler nosegengʼogi ni kik giyal Injili e piny Asia, Paulo gi lange nowuotho e gwengʼ Frugia gi Galatia.
Eka Herode noluongo ajuokego lingʼ-lingʼ, kendo ne ononogi, mi neginyise kinde nogono mane sulwe onenore.
Kane gisewinjo wach ruoth, negichako wuodhgi mi gidhi, kendo sulwe mane oyudo giseneno yo wuok chiengʼ notelonigi nyaka nochopo mi ochungʼ ewi kama ne nyathi nitie.
“Gikanyono bangʼ chandruok maduongʼ mag ndalono, “ ‘wangʼ chiengʼ noimre, kendo dwe ok norieny; sulwe nolwar koa e polo, kendo chwech mag polo noyiengni.’
Nimar mana kaka mil polo ji duto neno chakre wuok chiengʼ nyaka podho chiengʼ, e kaka dwok Wuod Dhano bende nobedi.
Kite ne chalo gi mil polo, kendo lepe ne rachar ka pe.
Nodwoko niya, “Ne aneno Satan kalor aa e polo mana ka mil polo.

Jowetena, ok adwar ni ubed kukia, ni asedwaro kuom ndalo mathoth mondo abi iru, to timo kamano osetama nyaka kawuononi, mondo an bende ati tich maber e dieru mana kaka asetimo e dier joma ok jo-Yahudi.
Jowetena, gima chunya dwaro kendo alamoe Nyasaye ne jo-Israel, en ni mondo giyud warruok.
Emomiyo, jowetena, ajiwou kuom ngʼwono mar Nyasaye, mondo uchiw ringreu kaka misango mangima maler kendo ma Nyasaye morgo, nikech mano e yor lemo makare.
Ma e remba mar singruok, mochwer ne ji mangʼeny mondo okel warruok kuom richo.
Nodhi e piny duto molworo Jordan, koyalo batiso mar weyo richo mondo mi owenegi richo.
Petro nodwokogi niya, “Weuru richo kendo obatisu ngʼato ka ngʼato, e nying Yesu Kristo, mondo owenu richou. Ka mano otimore, to ubiro nwangʼo Roho Maler kaka mich.
Jomoko nokelone ja-athany, konindo e pien. Kane Yesu oneno yie ma jogo ne nigo, nowachone ja-athanyno niya,“Wuoda, bed gi kwe e chunyi, richoni oweni.”
Ere mayot wacho, wacho ni, ‘Richoni oweni,’ koso wacho ni, ‘Aa malo mondo iwuothi?’
To koro, ne, odi oweni kodongʼ gunda.
Kane oyudo Galio en ruodh Akaya, jo-Yahudi noriwo ni Paulo mi negimake gitere e od bura,

Kane Apolo dwaro mondo odhi Akaya, jowete nojiwe mine gindiko baruwa ne jopuonjre man kuno mondo orwake maber. Kane ochopo kuno, nokelo konyruok mangʼeny ne joma noseyie kuom ngʼwono mar Ruoth Nyasaye.
Kane gigo duto osetimore, Paulo nongʼado e chunye mondo odhi Jerusalem, kokadho Makedonia gi Akaya. Nowacho e chunye niya, “Bangʼ dhi Jerusalem, to nyaka alim Rumi bende.”
Kuom mano, Johana nowuok e thim koyalo ni mondo ji oyud batiso kaka ranyisi ni giselokore gidwogo ir Nyasaye kendo oweyonegi richogi.

Ruoth Herode nowinjo wechegi, nikech nying Yesu koro noselandore mongʼere malach. Jomoko ne wacho kuom Yesu niya, “Johana Ja-batiso osechier oa kuom joma otho, kendo mano emomiyo teko mar timo honni ni e ngimane.”
Yesu nowachonegi niya, “Ok ungʼeyo gima ukwayo. Bende unyalo madho kikombe ma amadho kata yudo batiso machal gi mitisago?”
E ndalono ne gin gi ngʼat motwe ma achach mane iluongo ni Barabas.
Omiyo ka oganda nosechokore kaachiel, Pilato nopenjogi niya, “En ngʼat mane mudwaro mondo agonynu: Barabas koso Yesu miluongo ni Kristo?”
To jodolo madongo gi jodongo mag oganda nojiwo oganda mondo Barabas ema gikwa ogonynegi to Yesu to mondo onegi.
Kamano bende, e kaka Josef ma Ja-Lawi modak Saipras, mane joote ochako ni Barnaba (ma tiende ni “Ngʼat ma jiwo ji”),
To Barnaba nokawe motere ir joote. Nonyisogi kaka Saulo noseromo gi Ruoth kane oyudo en e wuodhe, kaka Ruoth nosewuoyo kode, kendo kaka Saulo noseyalo gi chir kuom nying Yesu e Damaski.
Wachni nolandore mochopo e it kanisa mane ni Jerusalem, omiyo negioro Barnaba e dala Antiokia.
Yesu nodhi e piny Galili duto, kopuonjo e sinagokegi, koyalo Injili mar pinyruoth kendo kochango kit tuoche gi midekre duto e dier ji.
Pinyruoth mari obi, dwaroni mondo otimre e piny kaka timore e polo.
To mokwongo, dwaruru pinyruoth Nyasaye kod timne makare eka gigi duto bende nomiu kaachiel gi mago.
Omiyo noweyogi, mowuok odhi e dala maduongʼ mar Bethania, kuma ne oninde otienono.
Kane oyudo Yesu ni Bethania e dala ngʼat moro miluongo ni Simon ja-dhoho,
Kane gichiegni chopo Jerusalem, ka gin e miech Bethfage kod Bethania manie Got Zeituni, Yesu nooro jopuonjrene ariyo
Bangʼ kane osenywol Yesu e dala mar Bethlehem e piny Judea, e ndalo loch Ruoth Herode, Joma Riek moko moa yo wuok chiengʼ nobiro Jerusalem,
Negidwoke niya, “E Bethlehem manie piny Judea, nikech janabi nondiko kama:
“ ‘To in, Bethlehem, manie piny Juda, ok itin ngangʼ e dier jotelo mag Juda; nikech kuomi ema jatelo mabiro kwayo joga ma jo-Israel biro ae.’”
Kane oyudo Pilato obet e kom jongʼad bura, chiege nokowone wach niya, “Walri iaye wach ngʼat maonge kethono, nimar wachne nochanda ahinya kawuono e lek mane aleko kuome.”
Kane Pilato owinjo mano, nogolo Yesu oko kendo nobet piny e kome mar ngʼado bura kama iluongo ni Laru motingʼore malo mar kidi (miluongo gi dho jo-Hibrania ni Gabatha).
Kane oyudo Galio en ruodh Akaya, jo-Yahudi noriwo ni Paulo mi negimake gitere e od bura,
To kuom chier mar joma otho, donge usesomo e kitap Musa kama ondikie wach bungu maliel, kaka Nyasaye nowachone niya, ‘An Nyasach Ibrahim, Nyasach Isaka kendo Nyasach Jakobo?’
Petro nodhi nyime kawacho niya, “Ondik e Kitap Zaburi kama: “ ‘Mad miechgi dongʼ gunda; ngʼato angʼata kik yiene dag e iye,’ kendo ondik niya, “ ‘Mad ngʼat machielo kaw tije.’

To Nyasaye nogolo pache kuomgi moweyogi mondo gilam chwech mag polo kaka nyisechegi, mana kaka ondiki e kitap jonabi niya, “ ‘Yaye jo-Israel, bende ne ukelona misengini kata chiwo moro amora kuom higni piero angʼwen mane un e thim?
Kuom mano jopuonj chik moko nowacho kendgi giwegi niya, “Ngʼatni yanyo Nyasaye!”
Awachonu adier ni richo kod yanyo Nyasaye ma dhano osetimo nowenegi.
To ngʼato angʼata ma yanyo Roho Maler ok nowene richone ngangʼ, nikech oseketho ketho mochwere.”
Emomiyo awachonu ni richo gi ayany moyanygo Nyasaye duto nowe ne ji, to ngʼato angʼata mowuoyo marach kuom Roho Maler ok nowene richone.
Angʼeyo chandruokni kod dhierni to kata kamano in jamoko. Bende angʼeyo ayany ma joma wuondore ni jo-Yahudi yanyigo to gin mana joma lamo Satan.
Ondiek malichno nomi dhok mar wacho weche mag sungruok kod ayany, kendo ne oyiene bedo gi loch kuom dweche piero angʼwen gariyo.
Gimomiyo awuoyo kamano kodgi gi ngeche en ni mondo: “Kik ginee kata obedo ni gineno; kik gingʼe tiend wach kata obedo ni giwinjo.
Un to ogwedh wengeu nikech gineno, itu bende nikech giwinjo wach.
Ji nohum kane gineno ka momni wuoyo, pudhe ngima, rongʼonde wuotho, kendo muofni neno, kendo negipako Nyasach Israel.
Magi e weche Nehemia wuod Hakalia: E dwe mar Kislev e higa mar piero ariyo, kane pod antiere kama ochiel gi ohinga motegno mar Susa,
E kindeno ruoth Ahasuerus norito loch Kodak e dala maduongʼ mochiel motegno mar Susa,
Ka ndalogo noserumo, ruoth notimo sawo ni ji duto mane odak e dala maduongʼ mochiel motegno mar Susa. Sawono notim e siwandha mar dala ruoth kendo nokawo ndalo abiriyo.
Ruoth onego ngʼe nine wadhi e gwengʼ mar Juda, e hekalu mar Nyasaye maduongʼ. Ji gedo gi kite madongo kendo giketo bepe e kore. Tich tiyore e yo modimbore kendo odhi nyime mapiyo e bwo telo margi.
Ma e dwoko mane gimiyowa: Wan jotich mar Nyasach polo kod piny, kendo wagero hekalu manyien mane oger higni mangʼeny mokalo, mano mane ruoth maduongʼ mar Israel ogero kendo otieko.

Bende nogolo koa e hekalu mar Babulon gige dhahabu gi fedha mar od Nyasaye, gigo mane Nebukadneza okawo koa e hekalu man Jerusalem kendo okelo e hekalu man Babulon. Bangʼe Ruoth Sairas nomiyogi ngʼat ma nyinge Sheshbaza, mane osewalo jatelo,

Noa kanyo modhi e piny gode ma yo wuok chiengʼ mar Bethel kendo nogero hembe e kind Bethel man yo podho chiengʼ to gi Ai man yo wuok chiengʼ. Kanyo nogeroe kendo mar misango ne Jehova Nyasaye kendo nolamo Jehova Nyasaye kanyo.
Nodhi nyime kod wuoth koa Negev kobuoro e yo nyaka nochopo Bethel, kumane okwongo geroe hembe e kind Bethel kod Ai,
Nochako kanyo ni Bethel to kinde mokwongo nying dalano niluongo ni Luz.

Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo gichalo joma orundore e nyim jo-Israel, mine giloyogi gi loch maduongʼ e Gibeon. Jo-Israel nolawogi ka giluwo yo madhi Beth Horon mi ginegogi ma gichopo kodgi nyaka Azeka kod Makeda.

E kinde mane giringo e nyim jo-Israel e yo moa Beth Horon kadhi Azeka, Jehova Nyasaye nolwaro pe madongo kuomgi koa e polo kendo thothgi nomedo tho nikech peno nonego ji mangʼeny moloyo mago mane jo-Israel onego gi ligangla.
koridore yo podho chiengʼ nyaka e tongʼ jo-Jaflet mochopo nyaka e holo mar Beth Horon kendo nyaka Gezer, mogik e nam.
Kuom mano Rael notho kendo nokunye e yo madhi Efrath (ma tiende ni Bethlehem).
Kane aduogo aa Padan, nabuok malich ka Rael minu otho e piny Kanaan kane pok wachopo Efrath. Kuom mano ne aike e bath yo madhi Efrath” (ma tiende ni Bethlehem).
Pinyno notingʼo Katath, Nahalal, Shimron, Idala kod Bethlehem. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge apar gariyo.
E Isakar kod Asher, Manase ne nitie bende kod Beth Shan, Ibleam kod jo-Dor, Endor, Tanak kod Megido, kaachiel gi jogo mane odak machiegni kodgi, ngʼat mar adek e kwan-no ne en Nafoth.

Joka Josef to nodwoko niya, “Piny godeno ok oromowa, kendo jo-Kanaan duto modak e pawno nigi geche mag lweny ma tiendgi otimo nyinyo, kendo mago modak Beth Shan gi mier molwore kaachiel gi holo mar Jezreel bende nigi gechego.”
To Manase ne ok oriembo jo-Beth Shan kata Tanak kata Dor kata Ibleam kata Megido kod alwora mar kuonde dak-gi, nimar jo-Kanaan noramo ni nyaka gidag e pinyno.
