Yawuot Nowa mane owuok e yie ne gin: Shem, Ham kod Jafeth. (Ham ne wuon Kanaan.)
Ham wuon Kanaan noneno dug wuon kendo nodhi mowachone owetene ariyo mane ni oko.
nowacho niya, “Okwongʼ Kanaan! Enobed misumba, e bwo wasumbini mag owetene.”

Eka enobare gi e bwombe, to ok nopoge chuth, kendo bangʼe jadolo nowangʼe ewi kendo mar misango, kokete ewi yien manie mach. Ma en misango miwangʼo pep, ma en misango miwangʼo gi mach, madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar ni Jehova Nyasaye.
Bwomb kerubi achiel mokwongo ne romo fut aboro kendo bwombe machielo ne romo fut aboro kamano bende bwombene duto ne romo fut apar gauchiel.
Noketo kerubigo ei ot matin mar hekalu maiye ka bwombegi oyarore. Bwomb kerubi achiel nomulo kor ot konchiel, ka bwombe machielo nemulo kor ot komachielo, kendo bwombegi nemulore e chuny ot.
Abiro keti jatend od ruoth kendo joga duto biro winjo chikni kendo kom duongʼ mar ruoth ema nobed maduongʼ moloyi.”
Nyithindo duto makayo ma yawuowi mag Misri biro tho, kochakore gi wuod Farao makayo mobet e kom duongʼ nyaka wuod nyako ma jatich makayo ma jarego, kaachiel gi nyithind jamni mokwong nywol.

E dier otieno tir Jehova Nyasaye nonego nyithindo ma yawuowi makayo duto mag jo-Misri, kochakore gi kach ruoth Farao mane ni e kom duongʼ nyaka kach joma ni e od twech, kaachiel gi nyithindo makayo duto mag jamni.
Ngeche mag Solomon: Wuowi mariek kelo mor ni wuon mare, to wuowi mofuwo miyo min mare chuny lit.
Ngʼat mofuwo yudo mor e timbe maricho, to ngʼat man-gi winjo bedo mamor kuom rieko.
Ngʼato ka ngʼato mariek timo gik moko kuom ngʼeyo, to ngʼat mofuwo nyiso mana fupe.
Abram koro nosebedo ja-mwandu ahinya mar jamni gi fedha kod dhahabu.
Nonyiso Sara bende niya, “Asemiyo owadu shekel mar fedha maromo alufu achiel mondo obed ranyisi ne jou duto ni ionge gi ketho; nikech ok isetimo gimoro amora marach.”
“Winja ruodha; nengo lowono oromo kilo angʼwen gi nus mar fedha. To en angʼo mathagowa; ik ngʼati.”
Kendo nikech Jehova Nyasaye noloro iye mane ok onyal nywol, nyieke ne osiko mana kajare mondo owangʼ iye.
Isetimo richo moloyo ji duto mane odak kapok idak. Iseloso ne in iwuon nyiseche mamoko, nyiseche mag chuma; isemiyo iya owangʼ mi idhira ka ngʼeyi.
Ahab bende noloso siro mar Ashera kendo notimo mangʼeny mamoko mondo ochwanygo Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, kendo owangʼ iye moloyo ruodhi duto mag Israel mane nitiere motelone.
Samson nodhi Timna kaachiel gi wuon-gi kod min-gi. Kane gichiegni chopo e puoth mzabibu mar Timna, apoya nono nyathi sibuor nowuok karuto kochome tir.
“Bende dinyal dwaro chiemo ni sibuor madhako kendo ipidh sibuoche modenyo,
Gichalo sibuor ma nigi kech mar mako le, mana ka sibuor maduongʼ mopondo kokichore.
Nyaka gicham chiwogo mane otimnegigo pwodhruok kiwalogi kaka jodolo. To onge ngʼat machielo moyiene chamo chiemono nikech gin gik mopwodhi.

Harun nochiw misango mar pwodho tunge kendono dichiel e higa. Chiwo mar higa ka higa mar pwodhruok nyaka tim gi remb misango mar golo richo ni tienge duto mabiro. Kendono nobed maler moloyo ni Jehova Nyasaye.”
Kaw pesa mar pwodhruokno kuom jo-Israel kendo kete e tich mar Hemb Romo. Enobed Rapar ni jo-Israel e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ka utimogo pwodhruok ni ngimau.”
“ ‘Kik ikaw asoya kuom ngʼatno moneko, nikech owinjore gi tho. Nyaka ngʼatno negi.
“ ‘Kik ikaw asoya kuom ngʼato angʼata moringo odhi e dala mar tony koparo ni inyalo weye mondo odog e lope owuon kapok jadolo maduongʼ otho.

Eri achungʼ ka. Hulieuru e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kod ngʼate mowir ketho ma asetimo. Rwadh ngʼa masekawo? Punda ngʼa masekawo? Ngʼatno ma asethiro? Asekawo asoya koa kuom ngʼa mondo odin wangʼa? Ka dipo ni asetimo achiel kuom gigi, to aikora mar loso.”
‘Kane wuora chiegni tho, nomiyo asingorane ni abiro yike e bur mane okunyo e piny Kanaan. Kuom mano yie adhi aike eka abiro duogo.’ ”
“Ka ngʼato oelo dho bur kata okunyo moro kendo oweyo dhoge nono mi rwadh pur kata punda onyumoree,
wer kuom soko mane rawera matin okunyo, mano mane joka ruoth okunyo; joka ruoth molony e chike kendo man-gi odunga.” Eka negiwuok e thimno ka gidhi Matana,
Omiyo Ruth nohulo e puodho nyaka odhiambo. Eka bangʼe notengʼo cham mar shairi mane osechoko, kendo ne oromo debe achiel.
Heka apar mar mzabibu nogol mana olemo karaya achiel kende, kendo kodhi moromo gorogoro nonyag cham maromo debe kende.”
Tiuru gi ratil makare gi gorogoro makare kod debe makare.
Bangʼ kane oseriembo Adam oko, ne oketo kerubi gi ligangla mamil koni gi koni yo wuok chiengʼ mar Puodho Mar Eden mondo orit yo mochomo yadh ngima.
Kendo e giko mar raumno los kido mar malaika ariyo miluongo ni kerubi gi dhahabu mothedhi.
Los kido mar malaika mar kerubi achiel e giko raumno kendo malaika mar ariyo e giko komachielo; bende los kido mar malaika mar kerubigo e gimoro achiel gi raumno, e giko raumgo.
Yawuot Reuben ne gin: Hanok, Palu, Hezron kod Karmi.
Magi e jotelo mag anywolagi: Yawuot Reuben ma kach Israel ne gin: Hanok, Palu, Hezron kod Karmi. Mago e jo-Reuben.
kokadho kuom Hezron, ne gin joka Hezron; kokadho kuom Karmi, ne gin joka Karmi.
Ruodh Kedesh, ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Jokneam man Karmel, ngʼato achiel,
Mier mamoko ne gin: Maon, Karmel, Zif, Juta,
Alamelek, Amad kod Mishal. To yo podho chiengʼ, tongʼ-gi nochopo Karmel gi Shihor Libnath.
Kuom ndalo abiriyo thowi moro amora kik yud e uteu, kendo ngʼato angʼata mochamo gimoro amora moketie thowi nyaka ngʼad kare oko kuom oganda jo-Israel, bed ni en japiny moro kata ja-Israel.
Ngʼato angʼata manolos ubani e yo machal kamano mondo owinj tik mamit ma aa kuome nyaka ngʼad kare oko kuom ogandane.”
“ ‘Rituru Sabato nikech enobednu odiechiengʼ maler. Ngʼato angʼata ma ok orito odiechiengno nyaka negi bende ngʼato angʼata motiyo chiengʼ Sabato nyaka ngʼad kare oko kuom ogandane.
Jehova Nyasaye nooro jo-Babulon, jo-Aram, jo-Moab kod jo-Amon mondo omonj ruoth Jehoyakim. Ne oorogi mondo otiek Juda, kaluwore gi wach mane Jehova Nyasaye owacho kokalo kuom jotichne ma jonabi.

Bangʼ mano ohinga mar dala maduongʼno nomuki kendo jolweny duto noringo ka tony gotieno ka gikalo e rangach man e kind ohinga ariyo man but puoth ruoth, kata obedo ni jo-Babulon nolworo dala maduongʼno kamano. Negiringo ka gichomo Araba,
to jolwenj Babulon nolawo ruoth mojuke e pewe Jeriko. Jolwenje duto noringo oweye moke,
Jehova Nyasaye ne omiya kite ariyo ma ondiki gi lwet Nyasaye. Kuomgi ne ondiki e chike duto mane Jehova Nyasaye owachonu koa e mach mawuok e got, e odiechieng chokruok.
Ka ok urito weche duto manie chikni ma ondiki e kitabuni kendo ka ok uchiwo luor ne nyinge man-gi teko ma en Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu,
Jehova Nyasaye nokel kuomu kit tuoche duto ma ok ondiki e kitabuni mar chik nyaka chop tieku chuth.
Yawuot Javan ne gin: Elisha, Tarshish, jo-Kitim kod jo-Rodan.
Yiedhi madongo mathoth nobi koa e dho nam mar Kitim; gibiro mako Ashur kod Eber, to kata gin bende ibiro tiekgi.”
Yawuot Javan ne gin: Elisha, Tarshish, jo-Kitim kod jo-Rodan.
Sirni ariyo, agulni ariyo machalo tawo moketi ewi sirni; thiwni ariyo mane okedgo gik machalo agulni ariyo machalo tawo moketi ewi sirni;
gik mongʼinore mia angʼwen mag thiwni laini ariyo, moluwore (laini ariyo mag thiwni oketi e laini ariyo mag gik mongʼinore mane okedgo gik machalo agulni molos kaka tawo ewi sirni);
Sirni ariyo, agulni ariyo machalo tawo moketi ewi sirni; thiwni ariyo mane okedgo gik machalo tawo moketi ewi sirni;
To Laban ne nigi nyiri ariyo: nyako maduongʼ ne nyinge Lea kendo nyako matin ne nyinge Rael.
Lea ne nigi wangʼ ma ok nenre maber, to Rael ne nigi chia kendo jaber.
To kane ochopo odhiambo, Laban nokawo nyare ma Lea mi omiyo Jakobo mondo obed chiege.
Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Ogendini ariyo ni e iyi, kendo ogendini ariyogo biro pogore; oganda moro biro bedo motegno moloyo machielo kendo wuowi maduongʼ noti ne wuowi matin.”
Angʼo momiyo ogendini chano timo marach kendo ji chano jiemo kayiem nono?
We chokruoge mag ogendini olwori koni gi koni. Ngʼad negi bura gie kom loch mari man malo;
Beduru motangʼ kendo neuru ni wiu ok owil gi gik museneno gi wangʼu kendo kik uwegi gia e chunyu ka pod ungima. Puonjuru nyithindu kod nyikwau wechegi.
To ka udwaro Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kanyo, to unuyude ka umanye gi chunyu duto kod ngimau duto.
Chike mamiyou kawuono onego bed e chunyu.
Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Kaw gik madum mangʼwe ngʼar kaka duogo, sare, mieny kod ubani maler, kendo pekgi nyaka bed maromre,
Ka ngʼato okelone Jehova Nyasaye chiwo mar cham, to nyaka obed mogo mayom. Onego ool mo kuom mogono kendo ochwo ubani kuome,

eka otere ne yawuot Harun ma jodolo. Jadolo nokaw mogo mayom moru gi sanja achiel kaachiel gi ubani duto kendo nowangʼe kaka pok mar rapar ewi kendo mar misango, ma en misango miwangʼo pep, madum tik mangʼwe ngʼar ne ma Jehova Nyasaye.
Rebeka ne nigi owadgi miluongo ni Laban, kendo Laban noringo matek ka dhi ir ngʼatno mane ni e sokono.
Laban kod Bethuel nodwoke niya, “Ma-oa kuom Jehova Nyasaye ok wanyal wachoni gimoro amora.
kendo Isaka ne ja-higni piero angʼwen kane okendo Rebeka nyar Bethuel ja-Aram mane odak e piny Padan Aram, kendo ma nyamin Laban.
Negiwuok Rimon Perez mi gibworo Libna.
Negiwuok Libna mi gibworo Risa.
Eka Joshua kod jo-Israel duto mane ni kode nodhi Libna koa Makeda mi omonje.
Negiwacho e kindgi giwegi niya, “Biuru walosuru matafare kendo wawangʼ-gi mochiek maber.” Negitiyo gi matafare kar kite kendo lowo kar simiti.
Negimiyo ngimagi odoko matek gi tije achuna mag nyono lowo mar matafare; e tijegi duto jo-Misri noketogi gi tich mapek mar wasumbini.
“Kik uchak umi jo-Israel lum magilosogo matafare; to nyaka une ni giomo lum kendgi giwegi.

Wuogi e kambi kendo iwuoth kichomo bungu man e gode mag jo-Amor, dhi e miech ji duto mokiewo gi Araba, jogo modak e gode, jogo modak e tie gode man yo podho chiengʼ, jogo modak Negev kod mago modak e dho nam, kaachiel gi jogo modak e piny Kanaan kod Lebanon, nyaka chop e aora maduongʼ mar Yufrate.
We angʼadi adhi ane piny maber loka Jordan piny gode kod Lebanon.”
Kamoro amora ma unyono, nobed maru, tongʼ maru noyarre koa e thim mar Lebanon kokalo Aora mar Yufrate nyaka nam man yo podho chiengʼ.
Harun nokendo Elisheba nyar Aminadab ma bende nyamin Nashon, kendo nonywolone Nadab, Abihu, Eliazar kod Ithamar.
“Luong Harun owadu kaachiel gi yawuote ma gin Nadab, Abihu, Eliazar kod Ithamar kowuok kuom jo-Israel mondo gitina kaka jodolo.
Magi e kar romb gik moko duto mane otigo kigero Hemb Romo, ma en Hema mar singruok kaka nokwan-gi gi chik mane Musa ogolo ne jo-Lawi kotelnegi gi Ithamar wuod Harun jadolo.
“Ka iholo pesa ni achiel kuom joga ma jachan mantie e dieru, to kik uchal gi ji mamoko ma holo ji pesa kendo kik ukaw ohala kuomgi.
Joma timbegi richo holo ji gik moko to ok chul, to joma kare to chiwo gi ngʼwono;
Ngʼama ngʼwon ma holo ji gige gi chuny maler biro neno ber ngʼat matiyo tijene gi adiera.
Ma e nonro mar Tera. Tera nonywolo Abram, Nahor kod Haran. Kendo Haran nonywolo Lut.
Tera nokawo Abram wuode, gi Lut nyakware ma ka wuode Haran kod Sarai, chi Abram mi giwuok Ur e piny Kaldea ka gidhi Kanaan. To kane gichopo Haran, negidak kanyo.
Omiyo Abram nowuok kaka Jehova Nyasaye nosenyise kendo Lut nodhi kode. Abram ne ja-higni piero abiriyo gabich kane owuok Haran.
Nochako omako ich, kendo ochako onywolo wuowi. Nowacho niya, “Koro chwora biro padore kuoma nikech asenywolone yawuowi adek.” Omiyo nochake ni Lawi.
Bangʼ ndalo adek kane pod gin kod rem, yawuot Jakobo ariyo, Simeon kod Lawi mowete Dina, nokawo gigegi mag lweny mi gidonjo e dala jogo apoya kendo ginego joma chwo duto.

Eka Jakobo nowacho ne Simeon gi Lawi niya, “Usekelona chandruok maduongʼ ka umiya nying marach e kind jo-Kanaan kod jo-Perizi, ma weg pinyni. Wan ji manok, kendo kagiriworenwa mondo giked kodwa e lweny, to an kod oda ibiro tieka.”
Eka Jehova Nyasaye ne mirima omako gi Musa mowachone niya, “Donge owadu Harun ma ja-Lawi nitie? Angʼeyo ni onyalo wuoyo maber. Osechako wuoth obiro romoni bende chunye biro bedo mamor ka oneni.
Magi e kar romb gik moko duto mane otigo kigero Hemb Romo, ma en Hema mar singruok kaka nokwan-gi gi chik mane Musa ogolo ne jo-Lawi kotelnegi gi Ithamar wuod Harun jadolo.
Jo-Lawi nigi thuolo kinde duto mar waro utegi manie miechgi.
Kuom mano ogandano nongʼur ne Musa kawacho niya, “Wabiro modho angʼo?”
E thim kanyo oganda jo-Israel duto nongʼur ne Musa gi Harun.
To kata kamano ji ne riyo mar pi oloyo kanyo, kendo ji nongʼur ni Musa. Negiwachone niya, “En angʼo momiyo nigolowa Misri mondo nyithindwa kaachiel gi jambwa otho?”
Ngʼat ma jasunga nyalo dwaro rieko to ok oyud gimoro, ngʼeyo tiend wach to biro mayot ne ngʼat ma ongʼeyo pogo tiend weche.
Ngʼat ma jasunga dagi puonj, ok odwar mondo ongʼadne rieko gi jomariek.
Chwad jasunga mondo joma ngʼeyogi tin opuonjre; kwer ngʼat man-gi rieko, to obiro medo fwenyo tiend weche.
Pok mowinjore jodolo kaw kuom misango mar rwath kod rombo ma ji ochiwo gin lemo mar bat, ring lemb kod chino.
Noyudo chogo manyien mar lemb punda, nokawe kendo nonego ji alufu achiel.
Eka Samson nowacho niya, “Gi chogo mar lemb punda aselokogi punde mangʼeny. Gi chok lemb punda asenego ji alufu achiel.”
We ayudnue chiemo moro matin mondo ucham omednu teko eka udhi nyime gi wuodhu mosekelou ir misumbauni.” Negidwoke niya, “Mano ber, tim kamano.”
Kinyne gokinyi mangʼich Ibrahim nokawo chiemo kod puga mar pi kendo nomiyo Hagar. Noketonegi e goke kendo ogole odhi gi wuode. Hagar nowuok modhi kendo nobayo abaya e thim mar Bersheba.
Eka nomiyo Jakobo wuode chiemo molos mamit kod kuon mane osetedo.
mondo girit odiechiengʼ gotieno, kendo gipog ler koa kuom mudho. Nyasaye noneno ni mano ber.
Kendo koth nochwe e piny ndalo piero angʼwen odiechiengʼ gotieno.
Gotieno Abram nopogo jotichnego e migepe mondo omonj ruodhigo kendo negiriembogi mi gilawogi nyaka Hoba, ma yo nyandwat mar Damaski.
Omiyo Adoni-Zedek ruodh Jerusalem nokwayo Hoham, ruodh Hebron, Piram ruodh Jarmuth, Jafia ruodh Lakish kod Debir ruodh Eglon niya,
Eka ruodhi abich mar jo-Amor; ruodhi ma Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lakish to gi Eglon noriwo jolwenjgi kaachiel. Negidhi kod jolweny mag-gi mi gimonjo Gibeon kendo gikedo kodgi.
Omiyo negigolo ruodhi abichgo oko mi gikelogi, ne gin ruodh Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lakish kod Eglon.
Nyisa yoreni, yaye Jehova Nyasaye, puonja mondo aluwgi;
telna gi adierani, kendo puonja, nikech in Nyasaye ma Jawarna, kendo genona ni kuomi odiechiengʼ duto.
Kane ahulo yorena to ne idwoka; puonja chikeni.
Enok nonywolo Irad: Kendo Irad ema ne wuon Mehujael, kendo Mehujael nonywolo Methushael kendo Methushael nonywolo Lamek.
Lamek nokendo mon ariyo, achiel ne nyinge Ada to machielo Zila.
Lamek nowachone monde ariyo-ka niya, “Ada kod Zila, winjauru, un monda winjuru wechena. Asenego ngʼato, nikech nogoya, wuowi matin nikech nohinya.
Ka masira oneko apoya, to pek ma ngʼat makare oyudo ok obadhe.
Joma kare neno masira to pod gimor amora, to joma pok otimo gimoro amora marach jarogi, kagiwacho niya,
An to ananyieru bangʼe ka un e chandruok; Anajaru ajara ka masira oloyou,

Neuru ni onge dichwo kata dhako, anywola kata dhoot moro e dieru kawuono ma chunye lokore weyo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa kadhi lamo nyiseche mag jopinjego; bende neuru ni onge yath manyago olemo makech mar richo.
Emomiyo, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego ma Nyasach Israel, wacho: “Ne, anami jogi cham chiemo makech kendo modh pi sum.
Emomiyo, ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Maratego wacho kuom jonabi: “Anami gicham chiemo makech kendo modh pi motimo sum, nikech koa kuom jonabi mag Jerusalem kia Nyasaye oselandore e piny ngima.”
Chiengʼno Daudi noringo Saulo mi odhi ir Akish ruoth Gath.
To jotich Akish nowachone niya, “Donge ngʼatni e Daudi ma ruodh pinygi? Donge en ema gimielne ka giwer ni: “ ‘Saulo osenego ji alufe, to Daudi onego alufe gi alufe’?”
Wechegi nodonjo e chuny Daudi mi nomiyo oluoro Akish ruoth Gath ahinya.
“Ka dine bed ni inyalo pimo chandruok ma an-go, kata pimo masira duto momaka e ratil,
to Nyasaye mondo opima e ratil madier kendo obiro yudo ni aonge ketho,
Joma nipiny gin mana muya nono; joma ni malo gin mana miriambo; ka opimgi e ratil, to gin nono; gin duto gin mana muya nono.
nimar ngʼanyo chal gi richo mar jwok, to tok teko chalo gi richo mar lamo nyiseche manono. Nikech isedagi wach Jehova Nyasaye En bende osedagi ni kik ibed ruoth.”
To Samuel nowachone niya, “Ok anyal dok kodi. Isedagi luwo wach Jehova Nyasaye, kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye bende osedagi ni kik ibed ruodh Israel!”
“Nikech jogi osedagi, pi mamol mamuol kawuok Shilo, kendo gi mor mana gi Rezin kod wuod Remalia,
kendo kanyo ema Ibrahim nowachonegi niya, “Sara en nyaminwa.” Eka Abimelek ruodh Gerar nooro joote moomone Sara kendo nokawe kaka chiege.
To Nyasaye nofwenyore ne Abimelek e lek gotieno kendo owachone niya, “Dine ber ka itho nikech dhako ma ikawono; en chi ngʼato.”
To ne oyudo Abimelek pok oriwore kode. Eka nowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye bende dineg joma onge ketho?
Holniu mabeyo opongʼ gi geche mag lweny, kendo joidh farese osechielo rangeye mag dala maduongʼ.

Kokalo kuom jooteni usegango weche mag ayany kuom Ruoth Nyasaye. Bende usewacho niya, ‘Gi gechena mangʼeny mag lweny, aseidho gode maboyo mag Lebanon mi achopo ewi got mabor moloyo. Asetongʼo yiendene mag sida maboyo kendo mabeyo. Asechopo nyaka e chuny bungu ma iye mogik kuma yien odiche.
Anaor joma tiekou, ngʼato ka ngʼato gi gige lweny, kendo ginitongʼ sirniu mabeyo mag sida mi giwitgi ei mach.

To kata kamano waikore mar manore gi gige lweny kendo dhi gi jo-Israel wetewa e piny mane osingnegi. To mokwongo nyaka wager ne mondwa gi nyithindwa mier madongo mochiel motegno mondo ogengʼ-gi kuom wasigu.
Omiyo Joshua kod jo-Israel notiekogi chuth makmana joma tin ema nodongʼ e miechgi madongo mochiel kod ohinga.
Bangʼe nodwok tongʼno chien nyaka Rama modhi nyaka e dala maduongʼ mar Turo mochiel gohinga, mogomo kochiko Hosa koluwo dho nam e gwengʼ mar Akzib,
Ruodh Tanak, ngʼato achiel, Ruodh Megido, ngʼato achiel,
E Isakar kod Asher, Manase ne nitie bende kod Beth Shan, Ibleam kod jo-Dor, Endor, Tanak kod Megido, kaachiel gi jogo mane odak machiegni kodgi, ngʼat mar adek e kwan-no ne en Nafoth.
To Manase ne ok oriembo jo-Beth Shan kata Tanak kata Dor kata Ibleam kata Megido kod alwora mar kuonde dak-gi, nimar jo-Kanaan noramo ni nyaka gidag e pinyno.
“Kaw kitabu kendo indikie weche duto ma asewacho kuom Israel gi Juda kod ogendini mamoko duto kochakore kinde mane achako wuoyo kodi e ndalo loch Josia nyaka sani.
Omiyo Jeremia noluongo Baruk wuod Neria, kendo Jeremia ne wachone to ondiko weche duto mane Jehova Nyasaye osewachone, Baruk nondikogi e kitabu.
jotelogi duto nooro Jehudi wuod Nethania, ma wuod Shelemia, wuod Kushi, mondo owach ne Baruk niya, “Kel kitabu ma isesomone ji kendo ibi.” Omiyo Baruk wuod Neria nodhi irgi gi kitabuno e lwete.
Kane giyiero nyiseche manyien, lweny nochakore e dhorangeye mag dala maduongʼ, kata mana okumba kod tongʼ ne ok oyudie kind jolwenj jo-Israel alufu piero angʼwen.
“Yor Nyasaye en yo malongʼo; wach Jehova Nyasaye onge ketho. En okumba ni jogo duto mopondo kuome.
Bende nochwogo okumbni matindo mia adek mobaw gi dhahabu, okumba ka okumba nobaw gi dhahabu ma pekne romo kilo ariyo. Magi duto ruoth noketo e ode manogero e Bungu mag Lebanon.
Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye noyudo Hagar machiegni gi soko e thim; ne en soko manie bath yo madhi Shur.
Kinyne gokinyi mangʼich Ibrahim nokawo chiemo kod puga mar pi kendo nomiyo Hagar. Noketonegi e goke kendo ogole odhi gi wuode. Hagar nowuok modhi kendo nobayo abaya e thim mar Bersheba.
Nyasaye ne ni kod wuowino kane odongo kendo nodak e thim mobedo jadwar molony.
ochano richo kod miriambo ei chunye, kinde duto okelo miero.
Ngʼat ma iye wangʼ piyo medo miero, to ngʼat ma terore mos kweyo dhawo.
Ngʼat ma timbene richo kelo mana miero, to jakwoth pogo osiepe moherore.
to e higa mar adek mar lochne noloso sawo ne jodonge gi jotije duto gi jotend lweny man Pasia gi Media gi joka ruoth, gi jodongo duto mag pinje bende ne nitie.

bende ne gin joma ruoth ogeno ahinya mane bet machiegni kode kaka Karshena, Shetha, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena gi Memukan, mane gin jodongo abiriyo mag Pasia gi Media mane nyalo donjo ir ruoth e sa asaya bende ne gin joma oluor kendo ogen e pinyruoth.
Kata mana kawuononi mond jodong Pasia gi Media ma owinjo tim ma mikachi otimo biro mana timo ne jodong ruoth tim machal gi mano. Achaya gi ich wangʼ biro dhi nyime maonge gikone.
Ketura nonywolone Ibrahim, Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak kod Shua.
Midian nonywolo Efa, Efer, Hanok, Abida kod Elda. Magi duto ne gin nyikwa Ketura.
Kane Husham otho, Hadad wuod Bedad, mane oloyo jo-Midian e piny jo-Moab nobedo ruoth kare. Dalane maduongʼ niluongo ni Avith.
Jo-Kiriath Jearim nobiro mokawo Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye. Ne gitere e od Abinadab mane ni e got, kendo negiwalo Eliazar ma wuode mondo orit Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye.
Eka Jesse noluongo Abinadab kendo nokete okadho e nyim Samuel. Samuel to nowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ok oyiero kata ngʼatni.”
Yawuot Jesse adek madongo noluwo Saulo e lweny. Wuowi maduongʼ ne en Eliab, mar ariyo ne Abinadab, to mar adek ne en Shama.
Eka Melkizedek ruodh Salem nokelo makati gi divai. Ne en jadolo mar Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo,
kendo nogwedho Abram kowacho niya, “Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo, Jachwech polo kod piny ogwedhi, in Abram.
Kendo ogwedh Nying Nyasaye Man Malo Moloyo mane oketo wasiki e lweti.” Eka Abram nomiye achiel kuom apar mar gik moko duto.
Nyako maduongʼ nonywolo wuowi, kendo nochake ni Moab, en e kwar jo-Moab ma kawuono.
Kane Husham otho, Hadad wuod Bedad, mane oloyo jo-Midian e piny jo-Moab nobedo ruoth kare. Dalane maduongʼ niluongo ni Avith.
Jodong Edom kibaji biro goyo, bende jotend Moab biro tetni, to jo-Kanaan chunygi biro nyosore;
“Donge ma e kit tweyo chiemo ma aseyiero: ni ugony tonde mag timbe maricho gi mag jok, mondo uwe joma otwe obed thuolo kendo utur jok duto?
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye nowachona: “Los jok gi tol kod lodi moriw kendo ikete e ngʼuti.
Eka janabi Hanania nogolo jok e ngʼut janabi Jeremia kendo oture,
Singruokna manyaka iriti, in kaachiel gi nyikwayi ema: Ngʼato ka ngʼata madichwo e kindu nyaka ter nyangu.
Kuom tienge mabiro ngʼato angʼata madichwo monywol e uteu kata ongʼiew gi pesa ma ok kothu nyaka ter nyangu, e odiechiengʼ mar aboro bangʼ nywolne.
Nyaka tergi nyangu bedni onywolgi e uteu kata ongʼiewogi gi pesa. Singruokna man kuom ringreu nyaka bed mosiko.
Piny notetni kendo oyiengni, mise mag polo noyiengni; negitetni nikech nokecho.
Kude mag nam kod mise mag piny noelore, kane Jehova Nyasaye okwerogi kokudho gi much ume.
Piny notetni kendo oyiengni; kendo mise mag gode notetni; ne gikirni nikech ne okecho.
Bangʼ tho Ibrahim, Nyasaye nogwedho wuode Isaka, mane kindeno odak Beer-Lahai-Roi.
Isaka nochako oyawo sokni mane osekuny e ndalo Ibrahim wuon mare, mane jo-Filistia odino bangʼ tho Ibrahim, kendo nochakogi nying mane oyudo wuon-gi Ibrahim osechakogi chon.
Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo gi Musa bangʼ tho yawuot Harun ariyo ka gibiro e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.

Eka ukaw oboke mag raywechi ulute remo mar chiayono manie karaya kendo ukir moko ewi sirni mag dhoudi, to moko ukir e sirni mag dhoutu koni gi koni. Kik ngʼato angʼata kuomu wuog oko mar dhoot nyaka okinyi.
Ka Jehova Nyasaye biro wuotho e piny Misri duto mondo oneg jo-Misri, to obiro neno remo ewi reru kod e bath dhoutu kendo nokal dhoudigo, ok noyie ne janek mondo odonj e uteu mondo onegu.
Ndikgiuru ewi dhoutu kendo e rangeyeu.
Kuom mano negimiyo Jakobo nyiseche mag pinje mamoko mane gin-go kod stadi mane ni e itgi kendo Jakobo noyikogi e tiend yiend ober man Shekem.
Malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nobiro mobet e tiend yiend ober moro mantiere Ofra mane mar Joash ma ja-Abiezer, kama wuod Gideon ne dinoe ngano mondo kik jo-Midian yude.

Gideon nodhi, moyangʼo nyadiel kendo otedo, bangʼe nokawo mogo madirom kilo piero ariyo gariyo mi olosogo makati ma ok oketie thowi koketo ringʼo e adita kod kate e tawo, nokelogi oko kendo ochiwogi ne Jehova Nyasaye e tiend yiend ober.
Oholibama, Ela, Pinon,
Saulo gi jo-Israel to nochokore mine gibworo e Holo mar Ela kendo negichanore mondo girad gi jo-Filistia.
Gin gi Saulo gi jo-Israel duto e holo mar Ela, ka gikedo gi jo-Filistia.”
Kane Jakobo onenogi, nowacho niya, “Ma en kambi mar Nyasaye!” Kuom mano nochako kanyo ni Mahanaim (tiende ni kembni ariyo).
Kuom mano mich Jakobo noter motelo, ka en to nodongʼ ei kambi.
Odhiambono, aluru nobiro moimo kambi kendo gokinyi ne nitie thoo momoko koluoro kambi.
Kane Jakobo onenogi, nowacho niya, “Ma en kambi mar Nyasaye!” Kuom mano nochako kanyo ni Mahanaim (tiende ni kembni ariyo).
kendo chakre Heshbon nyaka Ramath Mizpa gi Betonim, kendo kochakore Mahanaim nyaka piny Debir;
Pinygi nochakore Mahanaim, mokwako piny Og ruodh Bashan duto kod kuonde dak duto mag Jair man Bashan, to gi mier matindo piero auchiel,

Kinyne nyako maduongʼ ne owacho ne nyako matin niya, “Otieno mokadho ne ariwora gi wuonwa. Omiyo we wamiye kongʼo kendo kawuono mi omer mondo idhi iriwri kode kendo wanywol nyithindo mondo kik ogandawa lal.”
Kendo kinyne Jehova Nyasaye notimo kamano. Jamni duto mag jo-Misri notho, to onge jamb ja-Israel kata achiel mane otho.
Kinyne, Musa nobet e kome mondo obed jangʼad bura ne ogandano, kendo negichungʼ ka gilwore chakre okinyi nyaka odhiambo.
Esta nochako ohombo ruoth mopodho e tiende koywak. Ne okwaye mondo oketh chenro marach mane Haman ja-Agag oseloso, mondo otimne jo-Yahudi.
To ka wach marachno nochopo ne ruoth, noketo mondo ondik chike moko mamiyo chenro maricho mane Haman ochano ne jo-Yahudi odog ne en owuon, kendo ni oliergi e yath, en kaachiel gi yawuote.
Oketho chenro mar joma paro timo timbe mamono mondo omi gik ma giparogo kik timre.
Los ratege ariyo mag dhahabu kendo ichomgi e riak tonde ariyo mag gok yo ka nyime mar law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod machiegni gi kama oriwego but nungone.
Eka negiloso ratege ariyo mag dhahabu mi gichomogi e riak tonde ariyo mag gok yo ka nyime mar law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod machiegni gi kama oriwego but nungone.
Chakre e nungone kadhi malo naneno kochalo gi mula maliet molut e mach kendo chakre e nungone kadhi piny nochalo gi mach kendo ler mangʼangʼni nolwore.
Kane Jakobo owinjo wach ni Josef wuode obiro nene, nochukore mobet e kitandane.
Kendo Saulo nooro jogo mondo odogi one Daudi mowachonegi niya, “Keleuru ira ka utingʼe e kitandane mondo omi anege.”
Negidonjo e ot kane oyudo onindo e kitandane e ode kor nindo. Bangʼ kane gisechwowe ma ginege, negingʼado wiye oko. Negikawo wiye ma gidhigo kendo negiwuotho otieno duto ka giluwo yor Araba.
Tedna ringʼo mamit mana kaka ahero cha kendo ikelna mondo acham mondo mi amiyi gwethna kapok atho.”
‘Kelna ring le kendo ilosna mamit mondo acham mondo agwedhi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kapok atho.’
Dhiyo e kweth mag jamni kendo ikelna nyidiek ariyo mopugno, mondo mi atedne wuonu ringʼo mamit kaka ohero-cha.
Eka Musa noweyo Farao mi gidhi oko mar dala. Noyaro bade ni Jehova Nyasaye, mi mor polo kod pe norumo kendo koth bende ne ok ochwe e piny.
Kane Farao oneno ka koth, pe gi mor polo orumo, to nomedo timo richo. Nomedo bedo gi chuny matek en kaachiel gi jodonge.
to abiro oro koth e pinyu e ndalo mowinjore e ndalo oro kod ndalo chwiri, mondo uyud cham, gi mzabibu kod mo.
koa e dhood Asher, ne en Sethur wuod Mikael;
Owetene abiriyo kaluwore gi anywolagi ne gin: Mikael, Meshulam, Sheba, Jorai, Jakan, Zia kod Eber.
Magi ema ne yawuot Abihail wuod Huri, ma wuod Jaroa, wuod Gilead, wuod Mikael, wuod Jeshishai, wuod Jado, wuod Buz.
Koro ngʼatni ma nyinge ne Mika neni gikare mar lemo, kendo noloso law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod kod nyisechegi kendo noketo achiel kuom yawuote kaka jadolo.
nowuok Bethlehem mondo omany kama onyalo dakie. Kane pod odhi nyime gi wuoth, nodhi e od Mika mantiere e piny gode mag Efraim.
Mika nopenje niya, “Ia kanye?” Nodwoke niya, “An ja-Lawi moa Bethlehem man Juda, kendo amanyo kama anyalo dakie.”

Ruodh Israel nodwoko Jehoshafat niya, “Pod nitie ngʼato achiel manyalo penjonwa Jehova Nyasaye wach, to ok adware nikech ok okor gimoro amora maber kuoma, to kinde duto mana gik maricho. Nyinge en Mikaya wuod Imla.” Jehoshafat nodwoko niya, “Ruoth ok onego iwach kamano.”
Omiyo ruodh Israel noluongo achiel kuom jodonge mowachone niya, “Dhi piyo iom Mikaya wuod Imla.”
Jaote mane odhi luongo Mikaya nowachone niya “Jonabi duto osekoro wach achiel machalre, kagiwacho ni gima ber biro timore ni ruoth. In bende yie ikor wach maber kaka gisekorono.”
Yawuot Saulo ne gin Jonathan, Ishvi, gi Malki-Shua. Nying nyare maduongʼ ne en Merab to nyako ma chogo ne nyinge Mikal.
Koro Mikal nyar Saulo nohero Daudi, omiyo kane ginyiso Saulo wachno, to Saulo nobedo mamor.
Daudi gi joge nodhi monego jo-Filistia mia ariyo. Nokelo ringregi (ma en pien duongʼ-gi) kendo nochiwo kar kwan-ka duto mondo omi obed or ruoth. Eka Saulo nomiye Mikal nyare mi okendo.
Bende noloso rachungi apar mag mula minyalo dhir; ka moro ka moro romo fut auchiel gi nus e bor madhi malo to lachne to romo fut abich.
Rachungi ka rachungi ne nigi tiende angʼwen mag mula, man kod chumbe mag mula molworore kendo moro ka moro ewi rachungi angʼwen-go nokete karaya molosi e kido mar maua koni gi kocha.
Tiende angʼwen-go ne nitie e bwo bepego kendo kama tielogo ne lworore notudi e rachungi.
Kendo noneno nyikwa Efraim nyaka tiengʼ mar adek. Bende noneno nyithind Makir wuod Manase kinywolo mokwanogi ka nyithinde.
Nyikwa Manase ne gin: koa kuom Makir, joka Makir (Makir ne en wuod Gilead); koa kuom Gilead, joka Gilead.
Nyi Zelofehad wuod Hefer, ma wuod Gilead, ma wuod Makir, ma wuod Manase, ne gin joka Manase wuod Josef. Nyirigo ne gin Mala, Nowa, Hogla, Milka kod Tirza. Negisudo machiegni gi
Omiyo Abram nopudho hembene mi odhi odak but yiende madongo mag Mamre ei Hebron, kamane ogeroe kendo mar misango ne Jehova Nyasaye.
Ngʼat achiel mane oyudo otony nobiro kendo onyiso Abram ja-Hibrania wachni. E ndalogo Abram nodak e tiend yiende madongo mag Mamre ja-Amor mane omin Eshkol kod Aner, osiepe Abram.
Jehova Nyasaye nofwenyore ne Ibrahim machiegni kod yiende madongo mag Mamre kane obet e dho hembe kar odiechiengʼ tir.

Saulo noyiero ji alufu adek kuom jo-Israel; to kuom joma noyierogo ji alufu ariyo ne ni kode Mikmash gi pinje gode mag Bethel, to ji alufu achiel ne nigi Jonathan e gwengʼ Gibea e piny Benjamin. To ji duto modongʼ nonyiso nodog miechgi.

Jo-Filistia nochokore mar kedo gi jo-Israel, ka gin gi geche alufu adek, gi geche mag farese alufu auchiel, gi jolweny mathoth ka kwoyo man e dho nam. Negiwuok mi gidhi gibworo Mikmash man yo wuok chiengʼ mar Beth Aven.
Samuel nopenje niya, “Angʼo misetimoni?” Saulo nodwoke niya, “Kane aneno ka ji ke to in bende pok ibiro e sa mane oketi, to jo-Filistia bende chokore Mikmash,
Debora, ma japit Rebeka notho kendo noyike e tiend yiend ober machiegni gi Bethel. Kuom mano nochak kanyo ni Allon Bakuth.
nimar yiende sida duto maboyo moriere man Lebanon kendo yiende mag ober duto man Bashan,

Kata bedni achiel kuom apar mar jogi nodongʼ e piny, to gin bende notiekgi pep. To mana kaka yiende mag ngʼowu kod yiend ober motongʼ mowe osiki loth, kamano e kaka jo-Nyasaye mabiro dongʼ e piny nochal gosikino.”
To kata kamano ne ok ongʼiewo puothe jodolo nikech negiyudo pokgi mapile pile koa kuom Farao kendo ne gin gi chiemo moromogi kuom pok mane Farao miyogi. Mano ema omiyo jodolo ne ok ouso puothegi.
E higani ka ngʼato ongʼiewo lop wadgi to kik wuond moro bedie kindgi.
Ka ngʼato oyie mi wadgi ongʼiewo ode mar dak manie dala mochiel motegno gi ohinga, to oyiene mana mar ware ka higa achiel pok orumo nyaka ne ngʼiewe. Higano mangima en gi thuolo mar ware.
Emomiyo ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye wacho: “Anaket rachwany e nyim jogi. Wuone kod yawuowi nochwanyre kuomgi; jogo modak mokiewo kodgi kod osiepe nolal nono.”

Bende, ka ngʼat makare oweyo timbene mabeyo motimo richo, kendo ka aketo rachwany e nyime, to enotho. To nikech ne ok ikwere, enotho nikech richone owuon. Gik mabeyo mosetimo ok nopar, to rembe to naketi e wiyi.
“Wuod dhano, jogi oseketo nyisechegi ma giloso giwegi e chunjegi kendo giseketo rachwany mamiyo ji podho e nyimgi. Bende owinjore koro ayienegi mondo gipenja wach adier?
Eka Daudi nodak e dala mochiel gi ohinga moluonge ni Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi. Nogere kolwore gi ohinga motegno gi yo ka iye.
Magi e chenro mar tich achuna mane Ruoth Solomon ondiko mondo ogergo hekalu ni Jehova Nyasaye, gi dala ruoth, gi kuonde ohula, kod ohinga mar Jerusalem, gi mier madongo mag Hazor gi Megido kod Gezer.
Bangʼ kane nyar Farao osewuok e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi modhi e dala mane Solomon ogerone, eka Solomon nogero ohinga molworo ode.
Ruodhi abichgi duto noriwo jolwenjgi ne kedo e Holo mar Sidim (miluongo ni Nam chumbi).
To chi Lut nolokore mongʼiyo chien, kendo nolokore siro mar chumbi.
To chiwo duto mag cham mondo ituonie chumbi. Kik iwe mak ituone chumbi e misengini magi duto mag mogo kaka nisingori ni Nyasachi; mano emomiyo chumbi nyaka tuonie misengini duto mutimo.
Watangʼuru, nono to gibiro medore ahinya kendo bedo maratego, ma ka lweny owuok ginyalo dok ne wasikwa mondo giked kodwa, mi giring gia e pinywa.”

Kane Farao oweyo ogandano odhi, Nyasaye ne ok oweyogi giluwo yo mangʼado e piny jo-Filistia, kata obedo ni yorno ne ngʼado machiegni. Nimar Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Ka jogi oromo gi lweny, to ginyalo loko pachgi mi gidog e piny Misri.”
Kane Joshua owinjo koko mane ji goyo nowacho ne Musa niya, “Mahu mar lweny wuok e kambi.”
Saulo notemo chwowe gi tongʼ mondo oriwe gi kor ot, to Daudi nolengʼe mi tongʼ nochwowo kor ot. Otienono Daudi notony maber modhi.
To Abiathar wuod Ahimelek ma wuod Ahitub notony moringo odhi ir Daudi.
kendo moro ma moro nonego jadhape. Gikanyono jo-Aram noringo ka jo-Israel lawogi. To Ben-Hadad ruodh jo-Aram notony koidho farase kod joidh faresene mamoko.
“ ‘Kik ichiw nyathini moro amora ni nyasaye manono miluongo ni Molek, nimar ok onego iketh nying Nyasaye. An e Jehova Nyasaye.

Nyis jo-Israel ni: Ja-Israel moro amora kata jadak moro amora manie dieru manochiw nyathine moro amora ni nyiseche manono miluongo ni Molek, nyaka negi. Oganda jo-Israel duto mondo ogoye gi kite nyaka otho.
Anabed jasik ngʼatno kendo anangʼad nyinge oko kuom ogandane; kuom chiwo nyathine ni nyasaye manono miluongo ni Molek, osedwanyo kama ler mar lemo, kendo osechayo nyinga maler.
Abram kod Nahor nokendo. Nying chi Abram ne Sarai kendo nying chi Nahor ne Milka; mane nyar Haran; wuon Milka kod Iska.
Bangʼ kinde moko, Ibrahim noyudo wach niya, “Milka bende koro osenywolone owadu Nahor yawuowi ma gin:
Bethuel nonywolo Rebeka. Yawuowi aborogo ema Milka nonywolone Nahor owadgi Ibrahim.
Vashti mikach ruoth bende ne oloso sawo ne mon modak e dala ruoth Ahasuerus.
mondo okel Vashti ma mikache ire ka orwako osimbo mar mikach ruoth, kendo mondo onyis ji to gi jotelo kaka ojaber, nikech nober neno.
To ka joote notero wach ma ruoth nochiko, Vashti ma mikach ruoth notamore dhi. Eka ruoth nobedo makwiny kendo iye nowangʼ ahinya.
Gimoro amora ma Nyasach polo osechano, we otime gi chia ne hekalu mar Nyasach polo. En angʼo momiyo mirima dibed kuom pinyruoth gi yawuote?
“Bangʼ lochni, pinyruoth moro machielo nobi, ma lochne ok nobed maduongʼ ka mari. Bangʼ mano pinyruoth molos gi nyinyo nobed gi loch ewi piny duto.
Mogik, pinyruoth mar angʼwen matek ka chuma nobi, nikech chuma toyo kendo rego gimoro amora, to kaka chuma toyo gik moko matindo tindo, e kaka en bende obiro rego kendo toyo pinyruodhi mamoko duto.
Kendo Daudi nongʼeyo ni Jehova Nyasaye osegure kaka ruodh Israel kendo ni osetingʼ pinyruodhe malo nikech joge Israel.
E higa mar piero adek gabich mar loch Asa, Baasha ruodh Israel nodhi kedo kod Juda kendo nochielo Rama motegno mondo ogengʼ ni ngʼato angʼata kik wuogi kata donji e piny Asa ruodh Juda.

E higa mokwongo mar loch Sairas ruodh Pasia, mondo ochop singo mar wach Jehova Nyasaye mane Jeremia okoro, Jehova Nyasaye nowuoyo gi chuny Sairas ruodh Pasia mondo ogol lendo e pinye duto koketo e ndiko kama:
wuod Mikael, wuod Baseya, wuod Malkija,
Adaya wuod Jeroham, wuod Pashur, wuod Malkija kod Maasai wuod Adiel, wuod Jazera, wuod Meshulam, wuod Meshilemith, wuod Imer.
mar abich ne Malkija, to mar auchiel ne Mijamin,
koa kuom joka Zebulun, kaw Eliab wuod Helon.
Dhood Zebulun noluwogi. Jatend dhood Zebulun ne en Eliab wuod Helon.
Eliab wuod Helon, ma jatend jo-Zebulun nokelo misango mare e odiechiengʼ mar adek.
kendo enokwan chakre higni mane ouse lopeno, kendo chulo ngʼatno pesa moromo gi higni ma pod odongʼ nyaka chop higa mar mor, eka koro oyiene kawo lopno obed mare kendo.
To ka ok onyal waro lopeno, to lopno nosik e lwet ngʼat mane ongʼiewocha nyaka chop higa mar piero abich. To kochopo higa mar morno to nowe lowo odogni wuon mare machon, kendo wuon-gi nokawe.
Ka ngʼato oyie mi wadgi ongʼiewo ode mar dak manie dala mochiel motegno gi ohinga, to oyiene mana mar ware ka higa achiel pok orumo nyaka ne ngʼiewe. Higano mangima en gi thuolo mar ware.
Magi ema ne jotelo mar anywolagi: Efer, Ishi, Eliel Azriel, Jeremia, Hodavia kod Jadiel. Ne gin jolweny mathuondi kendo marahuma kendo jotend anywolagi.
wuod Elkana, wuod Jeroham, wuod Eliel, wuod Toa,
Elienai, Zilethai, Eliel,
Omiyo Abram nopudho hembene mi odhi odak but yiende madongo mag Mamre ei Hebron, kamane ogeroe kendo mar misango ne Jehova Nyasaye.
Ngʼat achiel mane oyudo otony nobiro kendo onyiso Abram ja-Hibrania wachni. E ndalogo Abram nodak e tiend yiende madongo mag Mamre ja-Amor mane omin Eshkol kod Aner, osiepe Abram.
Ok abi kawo gimoro to mana ma joga osechamo kod pok ma joga kaka Aner, Eshkol kod Mamre onego oyudi. Onego giyud pokgi.”
Oganda jo-Israel noluongo makatino ni manna nikech nochalo gi kodhi matindo tindo marachere, kendo ne en gi ndhandhu machal gi kek moted gi mor kich.
Kuom mano Musa nonyiso Harun kama, “Kaw manna madirom ngʼato achiel chamo mondo iket e agulu. Bangʼe kete e nyim Jehova Nyasaye mondo okane ne tienge mabiro.”
Jo-Israel nochamo manna kuom higni piero angʼwen nyaka negichopo e piny mane ji odakie, negichamo manna nyaka negichopo e tongʼ mar piny Kanaan.
kata kamano achiya mar pi ne wuok koa ei lowo kendo ne omiyo piny duto obedo mangʼich.
Eka Jehova Nyasaye nochweyo dhano gi lowo kendo nokudho muya mar ngima ei ume, mi dhano nobedo mangima.
Eka Jehova Nyasaye noketo kit yien duto mondo onyagi ewi lowo, ne gin yiende malombo wangʼ kendo mag chiemo. E dier puodho ne nitie yath machiwo ngima kendo yath mamiyo ngʼato ngʼeyo ber gi rach.
Ja-Zora moro, ma nyinge Manoa, moa e anywola joka Dan, ne en gi dhako ma migumba kendo nobedo maonge nyathi.
Eka Manoa nolamo Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Yaye Ruoth Nyasaye, akwayi, mad iwe ngʼat Nyasaye mane ioro irwa obi kendo opuonjwa kaka wanyalo rito wuowini.”
Nyasaye nowinjo Manoa, kendo malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye noduogo ir dhako sa ma ne en e puodho; to Manoa chwore ne ok ni kode.
“Los rachungi mar taya gi dhahabu maler kendo ithedh tiende gi kore gi kikombege machalo maua gi thiepege kod obokege obed gimoro achiel kode.
Bedene auchiel noa e bath rachungi tayano, ka adek nitie e bathe konchiel kendo adek nitie komachielo.
Kikombe adek molos kaka maupe mag oyungu gi thiepene kod obokene nobed e bade achiel kendo adek e bade maluwe kendo bedene auchielgo nochwogore kawuok e rachungi taya.
Eka Menahem wuod Gadi nowuok koa Tirza modhi nyaka Samaria. Nomonjo Shalum wuod Jabesh ei Samaria monege kendo nobedo ruoth kare.
E ndalono Menahem nowuok koa Tirza mondo modhi monjo Tifsa gi ji duto mane nitie e dala maduongʼ gi mier mokiewo kode nimar nodagi yawo rangeyene. Noriembo Tifsa mobaro iye mon ma yach duto.
E higa mar piero adek gochiko mar loch Azaria ruodh Juda, Menahem wuod Gadi nobedo ruoth Israel, kendo nobedo ruoth Samaria kuom higni apar.
Josef nochako wuode makayo ni Manase kendo nowacho niya, “Ma en nikech Nyasaye osemiyo wiya owil gi chandruokna duto kod jood wuora duto.”
Asenath nyar Potifera, jadolo mar On nonywolone Josef Manase kod Efraim e piny Misri.
Bangʼ kinde moko Josef nowinjo wach ni wuon mare tuo, kuom mano nokawo yawuote ariyo Manase kod Efraim mondo odhi onene.

Koro Elija ja-Tishbi moa Tishbe e piny Gilead nonyiso Ahab niya, “Mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye mangima, ma Nyasach Israel matiyone nitie, tho kata koth ok nobedi kuom higni manok nyaka chop achak awach kendo.”
Elija nowachone niya, “Kik ibed maluor dhi dala kendo tim kaka isewacho. To mokwongo losna kuon matin kuom gima in-go mondo ikelna eka ilos gimoro ni in kaachiel gi wuodi
Nodhi motimo kaka Elija nowachone. Kamano ne nitie chiemo pile ka pile ne Elija gi dhakono kod joode.
Adoniram to notelo ni joma tiyo tich achuna, Jehoshafat wuod Ahilud ne jandiko;
Ahishar ma jatend od ruoth; Adoniram wuod Abda ma jatend tij achune.

Noorogi mondo gi dhi Lebanon dwe ka dwe ka gitiyo e migawo mar ji alufu apar (10,000) e dwe, omiyo negitieko dwe achiel Lebanon to dweche ariyo gitieko dala. Adoniram ema ne otelo e tich lwedo matek mar achunano.
Ne nitie ngʼat moro mane odak Ramathaim Zuf e piny gode mag Efraim. Ngʼatno ne nyinge Elkana wuod Jeroham ma wuod Elihu wuod Tohu, wuod Zuf ma ja-Efraim.

Joka Manase mane odok ir Daudi koa ir Saulo mane odhi Ziklag ne gin: Adna, Jozabad, Jediael, Mikael, Jozabad, Elihu kod Zilethai mane jotend jolweny alufu achiel (1,000) kuom joka Manase moro ka moro.
Yawuot Shemaya ne gin, Othni, Refael, Obed kod Elzabad; Elihu kod Semakia ma wedene bende ne joma niginyalo.
Yawuot Nearia ne gin: Elioenai, Hizkia kod Azrikam; giduto ne gin yawuowi adek.
Yawuot Elioenai ne gin: Hodavia, Eliashib, Pelaya, Akub, Johanan, Delaya kod Anani, giduto gin yawuowi abiriyo.
to gi Elioenai, Jakoba, Jeshohaya, Asaya, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaya,
“Kik ulos nyiseche mothedhi mag mula mondo ulam.
“ ‘Kik uluw bangʼ nyiseche manono, kendo kik ubed gi nyiseche mothedhi mag nyinyo. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Lor piny piyo piyo ia e got, nikech jogi mane igolo oa e piny Misri oselokore jo-mibadhi. Giseweyo mapiyo gik mane achikogi, kendo giseloso nyiseche mag kido.”
Tarik apar gabiriyo mar dwe mar ariyo noyudo ka Nowa ja-higni mia auchiel kendo sokni duto manie nam mangʼongo manie bwo piny nomuoch kendo dirisni mag polo noyawore.
Koro sokni manie bwo lowo kod dirise mag ataro moa e polo nolor, kendo koth moa e polo nochok.
Ahab nosewacho ne Obadia niya, “Dhi e piny duto e sokni kod holo duto. Dipo ka wayudo lum mondo farese kod kenje obed mangima mondo kik waneg chiachwa moro amora.”
Jatichne ma nyako ma nyinge Reuma bende nonywolone yawuowi, ma gin: Teba, Gaham, Tahash kod Maaka.
Makmana jo-Israel ne ok oriembo jo-Geshur gi jo-Maaka, omiyo pod gidak e dier jo-Israel nyaka chil kawuono.
mar ariyo ne en Kileab wuod Abigael ma dhako mane chwore otho mane jaod Nabal ja-Karmel; mar adek ne en Abisalom wuod Maaka nyar Talmai ruodh Geshur;
“Ka ngʼato otimo richo kendo ok obedo ja-ratiro e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ka owuondo nyawadgi kuom gima osingne kata gima owene mondo oriti kata gima okwal,
“Wachne jo-Israel kama: ‘Ka dichwo kata dhako okwinyo wadgi e yo moro amora kendo obedo ngʼama ok ja-ratiro ne Jehova Nyasaye, ngʼatno oketho
“Wuo gi jo-Israel kendo iwachnegi kama: ‘Ka chi ngʼato ok obedo ja-adiera kendo ok obedo ja-ratiro
Kom duongʼno ne nigi raidhi mag kuonde minyono auchiel kendo yo kangʼeye ne nigi wich molworore. Bethene ariyo ne nigi bede miyienge bat, ka kido mar sibuor molosi ochungʼ e bath moro ka moro.
Negigolo lepgi piyo piyo ma gipedho ewi raidhi mondo Jehu owuothie. Eka negigoyo turumbete ka gigoyo koko niya, “Jehu en ruoth!”
Eka janabi Isaya noluongo Jehova Nyasaye kendo Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo tipo odok chien ondamo apar e kar raidhi mar Ahaz.
To Abram nowacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, en angʼo ma dimiya to pod asiko ka aonge nyathi kendo jacham mwanduna en mana Eliezer ja-Damaski?”
to machielo nochako ni Eliezer nimar nowacho niya, “Nyasach wuonwa ema ne jakonyna, ne oresa kane Farao dwaro nega gi ligangla.”
Yawuot Beker ne gin: Zemira, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abija, Anathoth kod Alemeth. Magi duto ne gin yawuot Beker.
Ada nonywolone Esau Elifaz, to Basemath nonywolo Reuel,
Magi e nying yawuot Esau: Elifaz wuod Esau mane Ada onywolone, kod Reuel wuod Esau mane Basemath onywolone.
Elifaz nonywolo: Teman, Omar, Zefo, Gatam kod Kenaz.
kaachiel gi jowetene ma jolupne e tich, mane gin: Zekaria, Jaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Uni, Eliab, Benaya, Maseya, Matithia, Elifelehu, Mikneya, Obed-Edom kod Jeyel ma jorit rangeye.
Zekaria, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Uni, Eliab, Maseya kod Benaya nonego go nyatiti kaluwore gi chenro wer miluongo ni alamoth,

E higa mar abiriyo Jehoyada nonyiso tekone. Ne otimo winjruok kod jotend migepe mag jolweny mia achiel magin Azaria wuod Jeroham gi Ishmael wuod Jehohanan gi Azaria wuod Obed gi Maseya wuod Adaya kaachiel gi Elishafat wuod Zikri.

Jonathan wuod Saulo ne nigi wuowi mane tiendene ariyo duto ongʼol. Ne en ja-higni abich kane wach Saulo gi Jonathan obiro koa Jezreel. Japite ne okawe mi oringo, kane orikni mondo owuogi nyathi nogore piny mobet rangʼol. Nyinge ne en Mefibosheth.
Kane Mefibosheth wuod Jonathan, ma wuod Saulo, obiro ir Daudi, nokulore piny komiye duongʼ. Daudi noluonge niya, “Mefibosheth!” Nodwoke niya, Ee, en an jatichni.

In gi yawuoti kod jotiji ubiro purone kendo ukel cham mondo nyakwar ruodhi obed gi chiemo to Mefibosheth, nyakwar ruodhi, to biro chiemo e mesana pile.” Ziba ne nigi yawuowi apar gabich gi jotich piero ariyo.
Elishama, Eliada kod Elifelet.
Elifelet wuod Ahasbai ja-Maaka gi Eliam wuod Ahithofel ja-Gilon,
Bende ne nitiere Ibhar, Elishua, Elifelet,
Mano ema omiyo nyaka chil kawuono jodolo mag Dagon kata mana ngʼama donjo e hekalu mar Dagon e Ashdod ok nyon ndiri.

To duongʼ mar Nyasaye mar Israel nodar oa ewi kerubi kama ne osebetie, mi ohuyo modhi obet ewi kama idonjogo ei hekalu. Bangʼe Jehova Nyasaye noluongo ngʼat mane orwako law mayom-cha, mane otingʼo gir ndiko e bathe,
Duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye nodum oa ewi kerubi modhi nyaka kama idonjogo e hekalu. Bor polo nopongʼo hekalu, kendo laru nopongʼ gi ler mar duongʼ mar Jehova Nyasaye.
Kata obedo ni gimor mana ka pi mogingore, to ka akwerogi to giniring ma gidhi mabor, mana machal gi mihudhwe mipiedho e gode ma yamo tero, kata ka yamo mar kalausi.
To jowasiki mangʼeny nochal gi buru mayom, kendo oganda mager nochal gi mihudhwe ma yamo tero. Apoya nono, ka diemo wangʼ,
Emomiyo ginichal mana kaka ongʼwengʼo mokinyi, bende kaka thoo mar okinyi malal nono ka nyango owuok, bende kaka mihudhwe ma yamo keyo kar dino, bende kaka iro mawuok e dirisa.
Mukuru kendegi mag misengini, touru kitegi mopa milamo kendo tongʼuru sirnigi mag Ashera.
Kik ulos kido moro amora mopa kata chungo siro moro milamo bende kidi moro amora mopa kik yud e pinyu kukulorune kulame. An e Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu.
Ma e gima onego utimnegi: Mukuru kendegi mag misengini, touru kitegi mopa milamo, tongʼuru sirnigi mag Ashera kendo wangʼuru kido mag-gi milamo e mach.
Nowacho ni: “Jehova Nyasaye en lwandana, en ohingana kendo en e jaresna;
Jehova Nyasaye en lwandana, en kar pondo mara kendo en jawarna; Nyasacha en lwandana ma apondo kuome. En okumbana, en tungʼ mar warruokna, kendo en ohingana.
Kaka in lwandana kendo ohingana, telna kendo itaya nikech nyingi.
Jehova Nyasaye nonyiso Musa niya, “Bi ira ewi got mondo ibed ka kendo anamiyi kite mopa masendikoe chike kod buche mondo ipuonj oganda.”
“Wachne jo-Israel ni, ‘Magi e chike mabiro mako ngʼato ka odonjo e richo ka ok ongʼeyo kendo otimo gima chik Jehova Nyasaye okwero:
Magi e chike mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo Musa ewi Got Sinai ne jo-Israel.
Notamre pogonegi kata mana bieche owuon bangʼ nywol, nimar oparo mondo ochamgi lingʼ-lingʼ e ndalo ma wasiku nogonu agengʼa ka masira olworo miechu madongo.
“Ma e gima Senakerib ruodh Asuria wacho: En kama nade miketoe genoni, momiyo isiko Jerusalem ka ogoni agengʼa?
Pak obed ni Jehova Nyasaye, nikech ne onyisa herane maduongʼ, kane an e dala ma wasigu ogoyona agengʼa.
Daudi nowachone jotend jo-Lawi mondo oyier jowetegi kaka jower mondo ower wende mag mor ka gigoyo thumbe machalo orutu, nyatiti gi ongengʼo.
To jogo thum ma Heman, Asaf kod Ethan nonego go ongengʼo mar mula,
Kamano jo-Israel nokelo Sandug Muma mar singruok mar Jehova Nyasaye ka gigoyo sigalagala gi tunge im, gi turumbete kod ongengʼo kendo ka gigoyo orutu kod nyatiti.

Lewni manyaka gitwangʼ e magi: law akor, law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod, kandho, law akor mogor, kilemba mar wich kod okanda. Nyaka gilos lewni mowal mag dologi ne owadu Harun kod yawuote mondo gitina kaka jodolo.
Twe gima ondikie wechego gi tol marambulu e kilemba mar jadolo gi yo ka nyime.
“Twangʼ law kandho mar law mayom mar katana kendo ilos kilemba gi law mayom mar katana. Okanda to mondo ogor gi ngʼama olony.
Bende kanyo nochak ni Mizpa (tiende ni kar ngʼicho), nikech Laban nowacho niya, “Mad Jehova Nyasaye bed jarit e kinda kodi ka wan mabor.

Nooro wach bende ni jo-Kanaan man yo wuok chiengʼ kod podho chiengʼ, kaachiel gi jo-Amor, jo-Hiti, jo-Perizi, kod jo-Jebus mantiere e piny gode; kendo ni jo-Hivi modak e tiend got Hermon e gwenge mag Mizpa.
Ka jo-Amon noluongi mondo oik gige lweny mag-gi kendo gichokre Gilead, jo-Israel to nochokore Mizpa.

Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo gichalo joma orundore e nyim jo-Israel, mine giloyogi gi loch maduongʼ e Gibeon. Jo-Israel nolawogi ka giluwo yo madhi Beth Horon mi ginegogi ma gichopo kodgi nyaka Azeka kod Makeda.
Koro ruodhi abichgo noringo kendo gipondo e rogo mantiere Makeda.
Kane owach ne Joshua ni ruodhi abichgo nopondo e rogo mar Makeda,
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ibiro kelogi mi gidonji kendo ibiro miyo gibedi ewi godi mar girkeni, ma en kama ne iloso kaka kar dakni, kendo kama ler mar lemo mane iloso gi lweti, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye.
“Bangʼ mano gigerna kama ler mar lemo kendo anadag kodgi.

Bangʼ mae to dhakono nyaka rit kuom ndalo piero adek gadek, mondo pwodhe kuom rembe. E kindeno ok oyiene mulo gimoro amora mowal ni Jehova Nyasaye, kata donjo e kama ler mar lemo, nyaka ndalone mag pwodhruok rum.
kendo kama nokwongo geroe kendo mar misango. Kanyo Abram nolamoe Jehova Nyasaye.
Kinyne gokinyi, Ibrahim nomondo kama ne ochungʼie nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
Luoro nomake mi owacho niya, “Ma kama lich manade! Nyaka bedni ma en od Nyasaye; ma en dhoranga polo.”
Nimar in ema in gi soko mar pi mar ngima; kuom lerni ema wanenoe ler.
Dho ngʼat makare en soko mar ngima, to timbe mahundu opongʼo dho ngʼat marach.
Puonj mar ngʼat mariek en soko mar ngima ma reso ngʼato e obadho mag tho.
Eka noketo ketego ei karaya kama ne jamnigo modhoe, mondo omi ka jamnigo modho to gineno ketego ei pi. E kindego ema thuondi ne luwogie,
Eka nokawo ludhe mi oyiero kite mapoth abich ei aora kendo noketogi e ofukune mar kwath mi otingʼo orujre e lwete kendo osudo machiegni gi ja-Filistiano.

Omiyo, ne adoko jakwadh rombe mane oiki ne yengʼo, to moloyo, rombe mago mane isando. Eka nakawo ludhe ariyo, ma achiel kuomgi nachako ni Ngʼwono, to machielo nachako ni Riwruok, kendo nadoko jakwadh rombego.
Kuom tienge mabiro ngʼato angʼata madichwo monywol e uteu kata ongʼiew gi pesa ma ok kothu nyaka ter nyangu, e odiechiengʼ mar aboro bangʼ nywolne.
Nyaka tergi nyangu bedni onywolgi e uteu kata ongʼiewogi gi pesa. Singruokna man kuom ringreu nyaka bed mosiko.
E odiechiengno Ibrahim nokawo wuode Ishmael kod jogo duto machwo monywol e ode kata mane ongʼiewo gi pesa, kendo noterogi nyangu, mana kaka Nyasaye nonyise.
Uzia nogero kuonde maboyo mag ngʼicho Jerusalem e Dhorangach miluongo ni Ranga Kama Ohinga Ogomogo gi Ranga Holo kod e giko ohinga kendo nogerogi motegno.
Ezer wuod Jeshua, ma jatend Mizpa, nochako ogero migawo machielo e dir jo-Binnui kama omanyore gi yo ma idho kochomo kar keno mar gige lweny man kama ohinga ogomogo.
Baruk wuod Zabai bende nochiwore mochako gero migawo moro chakre kama ohinga ogomogo nyaka dhood Eliashib ma jadolo maduongʼ.
Kendo e giko mar raumno los kido mar malaika ariyo miluongo ni kerubi gi dhahabu mothedhi.
Eka noloso kido mar malaika ariyo miluongo ni kerubi gi dhahabu mothedhi.
Ma e kaka rachung taya nolosi: Nolose gi dhahabu mothedhi chakre e bwoye nyaka wiye malo. Rachung taya nolosi mana kaka ranyisi mane Jehova Nyasaye osenyiso Musa.
Yawuot Elioenai ne gin: Hodavia, Eliashib, Pelaya, Akub, Johanan, Delaya kod Anani, giduto gin yawuowi abiriyo.
mar apar gachiel ne Eliashib, to mar apar gariyo ne Jakim,

Eka Ezra noa e nyim od Nyasaye mi odhi e agoch Jehohanan wuod Eliashib. E sa mane en kanyo, ne ok ochamo chiemo kendo ne ok omodho pi, nikech nodhi nyime kokuyo kuom bedo maonge ratiro mar joma noa e twech.
Magi e joma chwo mane okaw koa kuom yawuot Josef: koa kuom Efraim, kaw Elishama wuod Amihud; koa kuom Manase, kaw Gamaliel wuod Pedazur;
Koa yo podho chiengʼ nobedie migepe mag Efraim kaluwore gi rangʼiny moketi. Jatend dhoodno ne en Elishama wuod Amihud.
Elishama wuod Amihud, ma jatend joka Efraim nokelo misango mare e odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo.
Keila, Akzib kod Maresha. Giduto ne gin mier gi gwenge maromo ochiko.
Yawuot Kaleb owadgi Jeramel ne gin: Mesha mane wuode makayo mane wuon Zif to gi wuode Maresha mane en wuon Hebron.
Yawuot Shela wuod Juda ne gin: Er ma wuon Leka, Laada ma wuon Maresha kod jo-anywola maloso lewni Beth Ashbea;
Kane ochopo kamoro, nobworo gotieno nikech chiengʼ nosepodho. Nonindo kanyo moteno wiye gi kidi moro mane okwanyo kanyo.
Kinyne gokinyi mangʼich Jakobo nokawo kidi mane otenogo wiye kendo nochunge ka siro mi oolo mo e wiye.
Eka Mikal nokawo gima opa mopiele e kitanda, moume gi law, bangʼe oketo yie diek moko e wiye.
Bende wir Jehu wuod Nimshi obed ruodh Israel, kendo iwir Elisha wuod Shafat ma ja-Abel Mehola mondo okaw kari kaka janabi.
Jehu biro nego ngʼato angʼata motony e ligangla mar Hazael kendo Elisha biro nego ngʼato angʼata motony e ligangla Jehu.
Omiyo Elija nowuok kanyo modhi oyudo Elisha wuod shafat. Nopuro gi rwedhi motwe e jok apar gariyo kendo en owuon ema nochwado rwedhi machien. Elija nodhi machiegni kendo nobolo lawe mar abola kuome.
“Oganda duto mar Jehova Nyasaye wacho kama: Ere gima omiyo uketho winjruok maru gi Nyasach Israel? Ere gima omiyo ungʼanyo ni Jehova Nyasaye mi ugero kendo mar misango ni un uwegi e yor wangʼ teko?
Uwacho ni un gi rieko kod teko mangʼeny mar lweny, to gik ma uwacho onge tiendgi. En ngʼa ma uketo genou kuome, mamiyo ungʼanyo uweya?
To ka Sanbalat ma ja-Horon, Tobia ma jatend jo-Amon kod Geshem ma ja-Arabu nowinjo wach gedoni, ne gijarowa kendo buonowa ka gipenjo niya, “Angʼo ma utimoni? Dibed ni ungʼanyo ne ruoth?”
ka gin kanyakla gi Zerubabel, Jeshua, Nehemia, Seraya, Relaya, Modekai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum kod Baana.
Jotendgi ne gin Zerubabel, Jeshua, Nehemia, Azaria, Ramia, Nahamani, Modekai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, kod Baana.
E dala mochiel mar Susa ne nitie ja-Yahudi moro ma ja-dhood Benjamin ma nyinge Modekai wuod Jair, ma wuod Shimei, wuod Kish,
Ne awachonu kamano to ne ok unyal winjo. Ne ungʼanyo ne Jehova Nyasaye mi ok uluwo chikene, kendo gi wich teko maru ne uwuotho ka udhi e piny mar gode.
Paruru wachni kendo kik wiu wil kaka ne ujimbo mirimb Jehova Nyasaye e thim. Kochakore chiengʼ mane uwuok Misri ma uchopo ka, usebedo mana ka ungʼanyo ne Jehova Nyasaye.
Kendo kane Jehova Nyasaye ogolou Kadesh Barnea nowacho niya, “Dhiuru mondo ukaw piny ma asemiyou.” To ne ungʼanyo ne chike mag Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, ne ok ugeno kuome kata miye luor.
Eka Miriam janabi madhako ma nyamin Harun, nokawo oyieke e lwete kendo mon duto noluwo bangʼe ka gin gi oyieke kendo ka gimiel.
Miriam nowernegi niya, “Weruru ni Jehova Nyasaye, nimar otingʼe malo ahinya. Oseimo faras gi jaithne ei nam.”
Miriam kod Harun nochako wuoyo marach kuom Musa nikech jaode ma nyar jo-Kush, nimar ne onywomo nyar Kush.
Josef noiko gache kendo oikore mar dhi Goshen mondo odhi oromne wuon-gi Israel. Kane Josef ochopo ire, nokwako wuon-gi kendo oywak kuom kinde malach.
Kaka Barak ne sudo machiegni, Jehova Nyasaye nogoyo Sisera, jolweny mage kod gechene gi kihondko kendo Sisera nojwangʼo gache mi oringo gi tiende.
“Min Sisera ne ngʼicho gie dirisa; kaywak kama: ‘Angʼo momiyo gache odeko kapok obiro? Angʼo momiyo mor mar gechene ok winjre?’
Gin joma kelo chandruok kendo timo timbe maricho; kendo chunygi opongʼ gi miriambo kinde duto.”
“Kapo ni asewuotho e yor miriambo kata ka tienda osereto kadhi wuondo ngʼato,
Itieko joma wacho miriambo; Jehova Nyasaye ok mor gi joma dwaro chwero remo, kod jo-miriambo.
Yawuot Lawi ne gin: Gershon, Kohath kod Merari.
Magi e nying joka Lawi kaluwore gi anywolagi: Gershon, Kohath gi Merari. (Lawi nodak kuom higni mia achiel gi piero adek gabiriyo.)
Yawuot Merari ne gin: Mali kod Mushi. Magi ema ne dhout jo-Lawi kaluwore gi anywolagi.
Nyasacha e lwandana, kuome ema apondoe, kendo en e okumbana kendo en e teko mar warruokna. En e ohingana, kar pondana, kendo jawarna en ema oresa kuom jo-mahundu.
Jehova Nyasaye en lwandana, en kar pondo mara kendo en jawarna; Nyasacha en lwandana ma apondo kuome. En okumbana, en tungʼ mar warruokna, kendo en ohingana.
Anto abiro wer kuom tekoni abiro wero herani gokinyi; nikech in e ohingana, in e kar pondona e kinde mag thagruok.

Timbeu maricho biro kelonu kum; wech mane uweyago ema biro kelonu kum. Nonuru kendo ubiro ngʼeyo malongʼo, kaka en gima rach kendo lit ne un uwegi, ka ujwangʼo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu, kendo ubedo maonge kode gi luor kata matin,” Ruoth Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, owacho kamano.
Ne amiyo Israel maonge gi yie baruwa mar weruok kendo mi ariembe nikech timbene duto mag chode. Kata kamano ne aneno ka nyamin-gi ma Juda maonge ratiro ne ok oluor; en bende nodhi kendo ochodo.
Jehova Nyasaye nowachona niya, “Israel maonge gi yie ler moloyo Juda ma ok ja-adiera.
Ijamuomri ka pi aora, to ok inibed gi duongʼ, nikech isedonjori, gi kitanda wuonu ma ichido.
“ ‘Kitanda moro amora ma ngʼatni onindoe kata moro amora ma ngʼatni obetie ka dende chwer bedo mogak.
Kata bed ni en kitanda, kata bed ni en gima nyocha obete, to ngʼato angʼata manomul gigi, en bende nobed mogak nyaka odhiambo.
Ger Hemb Romoni gi gigene duto machalre mana gi kido ma abiro nyisi.
“Los Hemb Romo gi pasia apar mar law mayom momin man-gi rangi marambulu gi maralik kod marakwaro ka ogorie kido mar malaika mar kerubi gi jagoro molony.
Eka ilosi ramaki piero abich mag dhahabu kendo ti kodgi kuom riwo pasia ariyogo kanyakla mondo omi Hemb Romo obed gimoro achiel.
Nyisgi ni ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho: Abiro tieko ngeroni, kendo ji ok nochak ogoe kendo e piny Israel. Wachnegi ni, ‘Ndalo okayo machiegni ma fweny duto biro timoree.’
“Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon an Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ni ok unuchak ugo ngeroni e piny Israel.
Eka nawacho niya, “Yaye Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto, giwuoyo kuoma kagiwacho ni, ‘Donge owuoyonwa mana gi ngeche?’ ”
E higa mar apar gaboro mar lochne, ruoth Josia nooro jagoro ma en Shafan wuod Azalia, ma wuod Meshulam, e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kowacho niya,
Yawuot Pedaya ne gin: Zerubabel kod Shimei. Yawuot Zerubabel ne gin: Meshulam kod Hanania, to Shelomith ne nyamin-gi.
Owetene abiriyo kaluwore gi anywolagi ne gin: Mikael, Meshulam, Sheba, Jorai, Jakan, Zia kod Eber.
Kendo noketogi e od twech kama jatend askeche mar od twech notweyoe Josef.
Jatend askeche noketogi e lwet Josef mondo oritgi. Bangʼ kane gisebedo e od twech kuom kinde moko,
Chiengʼ moro kane iyi owangʼ kod wan ma jotichni, kendo ne irwakowa e od twech kaachiel gi jatend joted makati e od jatend askeche.
Kawuru pesa moromo rundo nyadiriyo, nikech nyaka uduoki pesa mane oket ei ogundeu. Nyalo bedo ni mano nobothnigi.
Kuom mano jogo nokawo mich kod pesa moromo rundo nyadiriyo, kod Benjamin bende. Negireto mapiyo nono ka gidhi Misri kendo negidhi ir Josef.
Chiengʼ mar auchiel nyaka gitedi gima gichoko, mano nyaka bed marom nyadiriyo kuom gima gisebedo ka gichoko odiechienge moko odiechiengʼ kodiechiengʼ.
Nyathino nodongo kendo nowe dhoth, kendo chiengʼ mane Isaka oweyoe dhoth Ibrahim notimo nyasi maduongʼ.
Kuom mano Isaka nolosonegi nyasi mi gichiemo kendo gimetho.
Kuom mano Laban noloso nyasi kendo nogwelo ji duto mae pinyno.

Kane chiengʼ pod ok opodho e odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo, jo-dalano nowachone niya, “En angʼo mamit moloyo mor kich? En angʼo maratego moloyo sibuor?” Samson nowachonegi niya, “Kane ok upuro gi nyarocha, to dine ok uyudo tiend ngeroni.”
Gibeyo moloyo dhahabu, moloyo dhahabu malerie moloyo; gimit moloyo mor kich moa e pedni.
Weche mag mor chalo gi mor kich gimit ne chuny kendo gikelo ngima ni choke.

Kane pod gin e lwanda maduongʼ man Gibeon, Amasa nobiro romo kodgi. Joab norwako lepe mag lweny kendo notweyo okanda e nungone mosoyoe ligangla man e olalo. Kane osudo nyime, ligangla nolwar koa e olalo.

Koro in iwuon ingʼeyo gima Joab wuod Zeruya notimona, gima notimo ni jotend lweny ariyo mag Israel, Abner wuod Ner gi Amasa wuod Jetha. Ne onegogi, kochwero rembgi e ndalo kwe mana ka ndalo mag lweny kendo remono nomienogo okandane mane otweyo e nungone kod wuochene manie tiendene.
Negidwoke niya, “Norwako law ma rayier, kendo notweyo okanda mar pien e nungone.” Eka ruoth nowacho niya, “Mano ne en Elija ja-Tishbi.”
Ne oketo Matania, ma owadgi Jehoyakin mondo obed ruoth kare kendo noloko nyinge ni Zedekia.
Bakbakar, Heresh, Galal kod Matania wuod Mika, wuod Zikri, wuod Asaf,
Koa kuom yawuot Heman noyier: Bukia, Matania, Uziel, Shubael kod Jerimoth, bende noyier Hanania, Hanani, Eliatha, Gidalti kod Romamti-Ezer, bangʼe noyier Joshbekasha, Malothi, Hothir, kod Mahazioth.
Harun nokendo Elisheba nyar Aminadab ma bende nyamin Nashon, kendo nonywolone Nadab, Abihu, Eliazar kod Ithamar.
Eliazar wuod Harun nokendo achiel kuom nyi Putiel, kendo nonywolone Finehas.
“Luong Harun owadu kaachiel gi yawuote ma gin Nadab, Abihu, Eliazar kod Ithamar kowuok kuom jo-Israel mondo gitina kaka jodolo.
Ja-Lawi miluongo ni Matithia, wuod Shalum ja-Kora makayo, ema ne omi tij tedo makati mar chiwo.
kaachiel gi jowetene ma jolupne e tich, mane gin: Zekaria, Jaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Uni, Eliab, Benaya, Maseya, Matithia, Elifelehu, Mikneya, Obed-Edom kod Jeyel ma jorit rangeye.
to Matithia, Elifelehu, Mikneya, Obed-Edom, Jeyel kod Azazia to nonego go nyatiti kaluwore gi chenro miluongo ni sheminith.
mi Jehova Nyasaye owacho niya, “Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon, ni nikech isetimona ma kendo ok isetama e wuodi ma miderma,
Omiyo nyisgiuru ni Jehova Nyasaye owacho ni, ‘Akwongʼora gi nyinga awuon, ni abiro timonu mana gigo mane awinjo kuwacho:

‘Nyoro ne aneno remb Naboth gi remb yawuote kendo adiera abiro miyo gichul kuom chwero remo e puodho manie pap,’ Jehova Nyasaye owacho. Kaweuru kendo ubole e puodhono kaluwore gi wach Jehova Nyasaye.”
Piny motingʼo Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimra, Heshbon, Eleale, Sebam, Nebo kod Beon
kaachiel gi Nebo kod Baal Meon (nyingegi noduog oloki achien) kod Sibma. Mier madongo mane gigero negimiyo nying mamoko.
Negiwuok Almon Diblathaim mi gibworo e gode mag Abarim, man but Nebo.

E odiechiengʼ mar abiriyo mar dwe mar abich e higa mar apar gochiko mar loch Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon, Nebuzaradan jatend jolweny marito ruoth, ma en achiel kuom jodong ruodh Babulon nobiro Jerusalem.
Nebuzaradan jatend jolweny notero e twech joma nodongʼ e dala maduongʼno, kaachiel gi oganda mamoko kod joma noringo modhi ir ruodh Babulon mondo otony.
Nebuzaradan jatend lweny nomakogi duto mokelogi Ribla ir ruodh Babulon.
E ndalo loch Jehoyakim, Nebukadneza ruodh Babulon nomonjo piny kendo Jehoyakim nobedo e bwo lochne kuom higni adek. To bangʼe noloko pache mokwedo Nebukadneza.
E kindeno jodong Nebukadneza ruoth Babulon nodonjo e Jerusalem mokawe,
kendo Nebukadneza owuon nobiro nyaka dala maduongʼ ka jodonge olworo dala maduongʼno.
Bangʼ kinde moko wach nowuok momako puoth mzabibu mar Naboth ja-Jezreel, puoth mzabibuno ne nitie Jezreel, machiegni gi dala ruoth maduongʼ mar Ahab ma ruodh Samaria.

Ahab nowachone Naboth niya, “Yie akaw puothi mar mzabibu alok puoth alot nikech ochiegni gi dalana maduongʼ. To kar puodhono abiro miyi puoth mzabibu maber moloyo, to bende ka ihero to anachuli gimoro amora midwaro.”
To Naboth nodwoke niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ok dibed mamor kade amiyi puodho ma en mwandu kwerena.”
Nogole oko mowachone niya, “Rang polo malo kendo kwan sulwe ka dipo ni inyalo kwanogi.” Eka nowachone niya, “Omiyo mano e kaka nyikwayi nobedi.”
Tingʼ wangʼi ine okumbawa, yaye Nyasaye; rang ngʼati miwiro gi ngʼwono.
Rang batha korachwich; mondo ine kaonge ngʼama dewa. Aonge kar pondo; bende aonge ngʼama rito ngimana.
An to dabed nade? Wichkuot machal kama dater kanye? To in to? Dibed machal kaka achiel kuom joricho mofuwo e Israel. Kiyie to wuo gi ruoth; ok obi tamore mondo kik ikenda.”
To nodwoke niya, “Iwuoyo ka dhako mofuwo. Diwayie mana gi ber kende ma aa kuom Nyasaye to ok chandruok?” Kuom magi duto, Ayub ne ok otimo richo e gimoro amora mane owacho.
Ngʼat mofuwo wacho e chunye niya, “Nyasaye onge.” Gin joma okethore, timbegi richo mokalo tongʼ, onge kata ngʼato achiel matimo maber.
Ne iluonge ni Nabal to chiege ne iluongo ni Abigael. Ne en dhako mariek kendo ne ojaber, to chwore ne ja-dhood Kaleb, ne en ngʼama koch, jagwondo kendo ma timbene richo.
Kane Daudi ni e thim, nowinjo ni Nabal ngʼado yie rombe.
Omiyo nooro yawuowi apar mowachonegi niya, “Dhiuru Karmel ir Nabal mondo umosnago.
Nonyiso Sara bende niya, “Asemiyo owadu shekel mar fedha maromo alufu achiel mondo obed ranyisi ne jou duto ni ionge gi ketho; nikech ok isetimo gimoro amora marach.”
Jo-Israel nowuok Rameses kochomo Sukoth; ne gin ji madirom alufu mia auchiel ka ok okwan mon kod nyithindo.
To nyaka iyier joma niginyalo ma gin ji moluoro Nyasaye, joma ogen ma ok kaw asoya, kendo iketgi gibed jotend ji maromo alufu alufu, mia mia, piero abich abich, kod apar apar.
Jo-Israel duto machwo gi mamon mane chunygi oyie nokelo ni Jehova Nyasaye chiwo mar hera ne tich duto mane Jehova Nyasaye ochiko Musa mondo otim.
Musa nomiyogi chiwo duto mane jo-Israel osekelo kuom gero kama ler mar lemo, kendo ji nomedo kelo chiwo mar hera okinyi kokinyi.
“ ‘Ka misango motimo en mar kwongʼruok, chiwo mar hera, to misangono nyaka cham e odiechiengno mochiwe, to ka moro odongʼ to inyalo chame kinyne.
Wachne nyithind Israel kama: Ka dhako omako ich ma onywolo nyathi ma wuowi, to enobed mogak bangʼ ndalo abiriyo, machalre kaka obedo mogak e ndalone mar neno malo.

To ka onywolo nyathi ma nyako, to nobed mogak kuom ndalo apar gangʼwen, mana kaka obedo mogak e ndalone mar neno malo. Bangʼ mano to nyaka orit kuom ndalo piero auchiel gauchiel mondo opwodhe kuom rembe.
“ ‘Ka dhako ni e kindene mar neno malo, to dhakono nobed mogak nyaka otiek ndalo abiriyo, kendo ngʼato angʼata momule nobed mogak nyaka odhiambo.
Ka gweth kata kwongʼ-gi ma aseketo e nyimu obironu kendo uketogi e chunyu kamoro amora ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu nokewu e kind pinje,
to giniwach ni, ‘Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima, manogolo jo-Israel e piny ma yo nyandwat kendo koa e pinje duto kama ne oseriembogie.’ Nimar anadwog-gi e piny mane amiyo kweregi.”
Jehova Nyasaye wacho niya, “An awuon anachok romba modongʼ e pinje duto kuonde maseriembogie anadwog-gi legegi kama gibiro nyaa kendo kwan-gi nomedre.
Eka Jakobo nokwongʼore kawacho niya, “Ka Nyasaye nobed koda kendo norita e wuodhani ma adhiye kendo miya chiemo ma achamo kod lewni ma arwako,
Kaponi ngʼat mane osingoreno odhier ma ok nyal chulo nengo ma oketneno, to nokaw ngʼatni mondo otere e nyim jadolo, kendo jadolo noyiene mondo ochul mana gima nokwongʼore ni onyalo.
Kendo Jeftha nokwongʼore ne Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Ka inichiw jo-Amon e lweta,
“ ‘Ka misango motimo en mar kwongʼruok, chiwo mar hera, to misangono nyaka cham e odiechiengno mochiwe, to ka moro odongʼ to inyalo chame kinyne.
“ ‘E thuoloni duto ma en e bwo singruok mar bedo tenge, wiye ok noliel gi wembe. Enorite maler ne Jehova Nyasaye nyaka ndalone mag kwongʼruok norum; kendo enopidh yie wiye maboyo.

“ ‘Mano e chik momako ja-Nazir mosekwongʼore kaluwore gi pwodhruok mare kendo mano e misango manyaka otimne Jehova Nyasaye kaachiel gi gimoro monyalo chiwo. Nyaka ochop singo mar kwongʼruok mane ochiwo, kaluwore gi chik mar ja-Nazir.’ ”
Yawuot Kora ne gin: Asir, Elkana kod Abiasaf. Magi ema ne dhout joka Kora.
Ne nitie ngʼat moro mane odak Ramathaim Zuf e piny gode mag Efraim. Ngʼatno ne nyinge Elkana wuod Jeroham ma wuod Elihu wuod Tohu, wuod Zuf ma ja-Efraim.
Kane odiechiengʼ ochopo ma Elkana chiwoe misango, ne omiyo Penina gi yawuote kod nyige lemo mar ringʼo.
Jehova Nyasaye ne wuoyo gi Musa wangʼ gi wangʼ mana ka ngʼato ma wuoyo gi osiepne. Bangʼ mano Musa noduogo e kambi, to Joshua wuod Nun, ma en wuowi mane konye nodongʼ mana e Hema.
Joshua wuod Nun, mane jakony Musa chakre tin-ne, nowacho ne Musa niya, “Ruodha, kwergi!”
koa e dhood Efraim, ne en Hoshea wuod Nun;
Ka ipuro lowo, to ok obi nyagoni cham. Ibiro bedo ngʼat maonge kar dak mabayo abaya e piny.”
Kawuono iseriemba e lowo kendo ibiro pandona wangʼi; abiro bet ngʼat maonge kar dak mabayo abaya e piny kendo ngʼato angʼata moyuda nonega.”
To kik uneg-gi, yaye Ruoth ma okumbana nikech joga dipoka wigi owil. Mi giba abaya koni gi koni gi tekoni, kendo mi gidog piny.
Ketgi duto e lwet Harun gi yawuote kendo ofwagi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mifwayo.
Bangʼ ka isekawo agoko mar im mitimogo nyasi mar walo Harun, fwaye e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mifwayo kendo mano nobed lemo ma kori.
“Pwodh lemo mag im mane otimgo misango mar walo Harun kod yawuote ma gin agoko kaka misango mifwayo gi em mane ochiw.
Ngʼato angʼata ma ok opodho piny auma mondo olam kidono to ibiro dir e mach makakni.”
kendo ni ngʼato angʼata ma ok opodho piny auma mondo olam kidono to ibiro dir e mach makakni.

Ka uwinjo ywak mar tungʼ, asili, nyagweru, nyatiti, orutu kod kit thumbe mayoreyore, mi upodho piny auma kendo ulamo kido maseloso, to mano ber. To ka ok upodho piny auma mi ulame, to ibiro diru e mach makakni. Koso uparo ni nitie nyasaye moro manyalo resou e lweta?”
“Wuo kod jo-Israel kendo inyisgi kama: ‘Ka dichwo kata dhako dwaro chiwo singruok makende, ma en singruok makende ne Jehova Nyasaye kaka ja-Nazir,
“ ‘Koro mano e chik momi ja-Nazir ka kinde mokete tenge orumo kendo nyaka kele e dhoranga Hemb Romo.

Bangʼ mano jadolo noliergi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mifwayo; kaachiel gi agoko kod em mane olier nimar gin gik mopwodhi kendo gin mek jadolo. Bangʼ timo kamano, ja-Nazir koro nyalo mana madho divai.
Rwakne kilemba e wiye kendo itwene san mopamorecha e lela wangʼe kaka osimbo maler.
Negiloso gima opadore ka san gi dhahabu maler mondo obed osimbo maler mi gindiko kuome ni: Kama owal ne Jehova Nyasaye.
Eka nosidhone Harun kilemba e wiye, kendo oketone san mar dhahabu mopamore, ma en osimbo maler e nyim kilemba kaka ne Jehova Nyasaye ochike.
Nochake ni Nowa mi owacho niya, “Wuowini biro hoyowa kuom tich kendo kuom tich malit mar lwetwa mobet nikech lowo ma Jehova Nyasaye osekwongʼo.”
Bangʼ kane osenywol Nowa, Lamek nodak higni mia abich gi piero ochiko gi abich kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri moko.
Ka Nowa ne ja-higni mia abich nonywolo Shem, Ham kod Jafeth.
Kane Serug ja-higni piero adek, nonywolo Nahor.
Kendo bangʼ kane osenywolo Nahor, Serug nodak higni mia ariyo kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
Kane Nahor ja-higni piero ariyo gochiko nonywolo Tera.
Omiyo Isaka nodar kanyo modhi e Holo mar Gerar kendo nodak kanyo.
Jotich Isaka nokunyo holo kendo negiyudo soko man-gi pi machwer maliw.
Kane gichopo e Holo mar Eshkol, ne gitongʼo bad yath achiel motingʼo pumbi mar olemb mzabibu. Ji ariyo kuomgi notingʼe e luth kaachiel gi gik mongʼinore kod ngʼowu.
Nyithindo ma ibiro nywolo bangʼ-gi ema nobed magi; to kar chamo girkeni, nokwan-gi mana kaka joka Efraim kod Manase.
Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, ibiro kelogi mi gidonji kendo ibiro miyo gibedi ewi godi mar girkeni, ma en kama ne iloso kaka kar dakni, kendo kama ler mar lemo mane iloso gi lweti, yaye Ruoth Nyasaye.
Kata kamano, pod ok ikelowa e piny mopongʼ gi chak kod mor kich kata miyowa girkeni mag puothe kod puothe mag mzabibu. Ubiro lodho wenge jogi oko? Ngangʼ, ok wanabi!”
ka gin kanyakla gi Zerubabel, Jeshua, Nehemia, Seraya, Relaya, Modekai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum kod Baana.
Magi e weche Nehemia wuod Hakalia: E dwe mar Kislev e higa mar piero ariyo, kane pod antiere kama ochiel gi ohinga motegno mar Susa,
Nehemia wuod Azbuk, mane jatend dir gwengʼ Beth Zur, nogedo e dir Zalum mochopo nyaka kama omanyore gi liend Daudi mochopo nyaka yawo mokuny kod od jolweny.
Kuom mano, dichwo nowe wuon kod min kendo nopadre gi chiege; mi gidok ringruok achiel.
Adam nochako chiege ni Hawa nikech nobiro bedo min ji duto.
Kane odak e thim mar Paran, min mare noyudone nyako mokendo koa e piny Misri.
To thuol ne riek moloyo le duto mag bungu mane Jehova Nyasaye ochweyo. Omiyo nopenjo dhako niya, “Bende en adier ni Nyasaye nowacho ni, ‘Kik ucham olemb yien moro amora manie puodho?’ ”
Dhako nodwoko thuol niya, “Wanyalo chamo olembe mag yiende manie puodho duto,
Thuol nowacho ne dhako niya, “Adier ok unutho.
Nahash ja-Amon nodhi malo momonjo Jabesh Gilead. Eka joma chwo man Jabesh Gilead nowachone niya, “Tim winjruok kodwa to wabiro bedo wasumbini magi.”
To Nahash ja-Amon nodwoko niya, “Abiro timo winjruok kodu mana ka uyie ni agolo wengeu ma korachwich kuom ngʼato ka ngʼato mondo akuodgo wi Israel duto.”
“To kane uneno ka Nahash ruodh jo-Amon dwaro monjou, ne uwachona ni, ‘Nyaka wabed gi ruoth ma ritowa,’ kata obedo ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ne en ruodhu.
Zila bende nonywolo wuowi ma nyinge Jubal-Kain, mane jatheth chumbe duto mag mula kod nyinyo. Nyamin Tubal-Kain nyinge ne Naama.
“Chiwo manyaka ikaw kuomgi e magi: “dhahabu, fedha kod mula;
Eka ilos ramaki mag mula piero abich kendo iketgi e tonde mitweyogo hema mondo oriwgi kaka gimoro achiel.
Omiyo Harun norieyo lwete ewi pige mag Misri, kendo ogwende nowuok mopongʼo pinyno.
Negitimo mano kendo ka Harun norieyo bade mane otingʼogo luth mi ochwado buru ma e lowo, kikun nopor kuom ji kod jamni. Buru ma e piny Misri duto nolokore kikun.
Ka Musa norieyo ludhe kochomo polo, Jehova Nyasaye nooro mor polo gi pe kendo polo nomil koni gi koni, kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye noolo pe e piny Misri.
Daudi nopenjo Ahimelek ja-Hiti gi Abishai wuod Zeruya, mowadgi Joab niya, “Ngʼama biro dhi koda mwalo e kambi ir Saulo?” Abishai nowacho niya, “Abiro dhi kodi.”
Daudi gi Abishai nodhi ir jolweny gotieno, Saulo nonindo kanyo e kambi kochwoyo tonge piny yo ka wiye. Abner gi jolweny nonindo kolwore.
Abishai nowachone Daudi niya, “Kawuono Nyasaye oseketo jasiki e lweti. Koro yiena mondo achwowe dichiel gi tonga; ok abi chwowe diriyo.”
Ma e kaka ibiro gere: Borne en fut mia angʼwen gi piero abich, lachne en fut piero abiriyo gabich kendo tutne fut piero angʼwen gabich.
Ketne tado kiweyo thuolo mar fut achiel gi nus e kind tado kod kore. Ketne dhoot kendo ipog iye gorofa adek.
Pi noimo gode kendo omedo gingore moloyo fut piero ariyo
Zalmon ma ja-Ahohi, Maharai ma ja-Netofath,
Heled wuod Baana ma ja-Netofath, Ithai wuod Ribai mawuok Gibea e piny Benjamin,

Kane jatend jolweny duto kod jogi nowinjo ni ruodh Babulon oseyiero Gedalia kaka jatelo maduongʼ, negibiro ir Gedalia e dala miluongo ni Mizpa. Jogo ne gin Ishmael wuod Nethania, Johanan wuod Karea, Seraya wuod Tanhumeth ja-Netofath, Jazania ja-Maakath kod jogegi.
Nowuok kuno modhi e piny Asuria kuma nogeroe Nineve, Rehoboth-Ir, gi Kala,
kod Resen, dala maduongʼ, man e kind Nineve kod Kala.
Omiyo Senakerib ruodh Asuria noweyo lweny moloro kambi kendo nodok Nineve kuma nodakie.

Kendo Samuel nowachone jo-Israel duto niya, “Ka udwogo ir Jehova Nyasaye gi chunyu duto, to goluru nyiseche mag jopinje mamoko ma un-go kod mag Ashtoreth, to chiwreuru ni Jehova Nyasaye kendo en kende ema utine, mi noresu kogolou e lwet jo-Filistia.”
Rie lweti koa e polo nyaka piny, mondo ikonya, kendo igola, e pige ma tekregi ngʼeny, kendo e lwet jopinje mamoko,
Konya kendo gola e lwet jopinje mamoko, ma dhogi opongʼ gi miriambo kendo ma lwetgi ma korachwich opongʼ gi wuondruok.
Bende enoresi kuom dhako ma jachode, kuom dhako mabayo gi wechege maywayo ji,
mamiyo ibedo mabor gi dhako mandhaga kaachiel gi lep mayom mar dhako mabayo.
ginimi itangʼ ni dhako ma jachode, inibed mabor gi dhako mabayo kaachiel, kod wechene malombo ji.
Otingʼo bandera malo ne ogendini moa mabor, kendo ogoyo tungʼ koluongo jogo moa e tunge piny. Gibiro mapiyo piyo ka giringo matek.
Enochung bandera ne ogendini mi ochok jo-Israel mane oriembi e pinygi; kendo enochok jo-Juda kanyakla ka ogologi e tunge angʼwen mag piny.
Chunguru bandera ewi got motwo kendo gouru koko, gwelgiuru mondo gidonj e dhorangeye joma ogen.
Ka udak e lowo mubiro yudo e piny ma Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu dwaro miyou mondo ukaw kaka girkeni maru, to kik ngʼato kuomu keth kiewo mane kwereu oketo e kind ngʼato gi wadgi.

Jakobo nochungo siro mar kidi kanyono mane Nyasaye owuoyoe kode, kendo noolo ewi sirono misango miolo piny bende noolo misango mar mo ewi siro.
Kendo los sende, bakunde kaachiel gi agulnine kod tewnine mitiyogo kitimogo misengini miolo piny, to gigo duto nyaka losi gi dhahabu maler.

Ruodh Israel nogolo chik niya, “Kawuru Mikaya kendo utere ir Amon jatend dala maduongʼ kendo ir Joash wuod ruoth,
Manase notho moyweyo gi kwerene kendo ne oike e puoth joka ruoth, ma en puoth Uza, kendo Amon wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
Amon ne ja-higni piero ariyo gariyo kane obedo ruoth, kendo norito piny kodak Jerusalem kuom higni ariyo. Min mare ne nyinge Meshulemeth ma nyar Haruz, kendo noa Jotba.
Jakobo nochungo siro mar kidi kanyono mane Nyasaye owuoyoe kode, kendo noolo ewi sirono misango miolo piny bende noolo misango mar mo ewi siro.
Chiw nyarombo mokwongono gi mogo mayom moromo gorogoro achiel gi nus moruw gi mo mobi e olemb zeituni moromo lita achiel, kendo ichiw divai moromo lita achiel kaka misango miolo piny
Chiw nyarombo machielo godhiambo kendo ichiwe kaachiel gi chiwo mar cham kod misango miolo piny mana kaka chiwo mokwongo, ma en misango madungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar, miwangʼo pep ne Jehova Nyasaye.
chi owadgino nodhi ire e nyim jodongo mi olony wuochene achiel e tiende kendo ongʼudh olawo e wangʼe kowachone niya, “Ma e gima itimo ne ngʼat modagi rito dala owadgi mondo ochungi.”

E kinde machon e piny Israel, mondo ne gimoro owar ma mi ngʼat machielo, ne chuno ni ngʼato achiel kuom jogo nyaka lony wuochene kendo omi ngʼat machielo, mano ne miyo winjruogno ok nyal loki. Mano e yo mane igurogo gimoro amora mane iwilo gi chik e piny Israel.
Kuom mano, wat dhakono nowachone Boaz niya, “In, ema mondo ingʼiewe.” Kendo nolonyo wuochene.
Nying ngʼatno ne Elimelek, to nying chiege ne Naomi, kendo nying yawuote ariyogo ne gin Malon gi Kilion. Ne gin jo-Efrath moa Bethlehem e piny Juda. Kendo negidhi e piny Moab mi gidak kuno.
To koro Elimelek ma chwor Naomi notho, mi nodongʼ gi yawuote ariyo.
Eka Naomi nowachone mond yawuote ariyo niya, “Doguru, ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomu, nyaka ute mineu. Mad Jehova Nyasaye timnu ngʼwono, mana kaka usetimo ne chwou mosetho kendo ne an bende.
Yawuot Benjamin ne gin: Bela, Beker, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Mupim, Hupim kod Ard.
Nyikwa Bela kokalo kuom Ard gi Naaman ne gin: koa kuo Ard, joka Ard; koa kuom Naaman, joka Naaman.

Koro Naaman ne en jatend to jolweny mar ruodh Aram. Ne en ngʼat ma ruodhe ogeno kendo morgo, nikech kokalo kuome Jehova Nyasaye nomiyo jo-Aram oloyo lweny. Ne en jalweny molony kendo ma jachir, to kata kamano ne en ja-dhoho.
Jehova Nyasaye ne wuoyo gi Musa wangʼ gi wangʼ mana ka ngʼato ma wuoyo gi osiepne. Bangʼ mano Musa noduogo e kambi, to Joshua wuod Nun, ma en wuowi mane konye nodongʼ mana e Hema.
