Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
Kik yud ngʼato kuomu matimo misango gi wuode kata nyare e kendo, kata matimo timbe nyakalondo, kata jwok, kata loko dhoch kata ido,
Pinje ma ubiro kawo winjo rieko mag ajuoke nyakalondo, to un Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu ok oyienu timo kamano.
Koriwore gi jogo mane onegi e lweny, jo-Israel nonego bende Balaam wuod Beor, mane ja-nyakalondo.
Negichiwo yawuotgi kod nyigi kaka misango e mach. Negitimo timbe ajuoke kod mag nyakalondo ma gichiwore mar timo gik mamono e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, ma gimiye mirima.
Fweny ma gineno ok gin adier kendo gikoro weche mag miriambo. Giwacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye osewacho,” to Jehova Nyasaye to ok oorogi, kendo pod gin gi geno ni weche ma gikorogo biro timore.
emomiyo ok unuchak une fweny mag miriambo kendo kata koro mag wuondo ji ok unutim. Abiro reso joga e lwetu. Kendo ka atimo kamano eka unungʼe ni An e Jehova Nyasaye.’ ”
Keila, Akzib kod Maresha. Giduto ne gin mier gi gwenge maromo ochiko.
Kane owach ne Daudi niya, “Ne jo-Filistia kedo gi jo-Keila kendo giyako gik man e laru mar dino cham,”
nopenjo Jehova Nyasaye niya, “Bende owinjore adhi kendo amonj jo-Filistia-gi?” Jehova Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Dhiyo, mondo imonj jo-Filistia kendo ires Keila.”
“Chwoyo gi keyo, ngʼich kod liet, oro kod chwiri, odiechiengʼ kod otieno ok nobed maonge nyaka giko piny.”
Kuom higni ariyo kech osebedo e piny, kendo kuom higni abich mabiro pur kata keyo ok nobedie.
“Timuru nyasi mar Sawo mar Keyo mar cham mane ukwongo komo e puotheu. “Timuru nyasi mar Sawo mar Keyo e giko higa, ka uchoko chambu koa e puotheu.
kendo Oholibama nonywolo Jeush, Jalam kod Kora. Magi ema ne yawuot Esau, mane onywol Kanaan.
Yawuot Oholibama, chi Esau ma nyar Ana kendo nyakwar Zibeon mane onywolone Esau ne gin: Jeush, Jalam kod Kora.
Kora, Gatam kod Amalek magi e jodongo ma nyikwa Elifaz mane odak Edom; bende ne gin nyikwa Ada.

Kar winjo tik mangʼwe ngʼar to unuwinj mana tik madungʼ marach; kar bedo gi okanda to tol ema nutwerugo; kar bedo gi yie wich molos maber to bondo ema unudongʼ-go; kar bedo gi lewni mabeyo to unurwak mana pien gugru, kar bedo gi wangʼ man-gi chia to adhonde nopongʼ dendu.
To Ruoth Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego, ne oluongou odiechiengno mondo uywagi kendo udengi, ka upudho yie wiu kendo urwako pien gugru.
Gibiro rwakore gi piende gugru kendo midhiero biro pongʼo chunygi. Ginibed gi wichkuot, kendo ibiro liel yie wigi.
Yawuot Kora ne gin: Asir, Elkana kod Abiasaf. Magi ema ne dhout joka Kora.
Jo-Lawi mamoko mane okwan ne gin: joka Libni, joka Hebron, joka Mali, joka Mushi, joka Kora. (Kohath ne kwar Amram;

Shalum wuod Kore, ma wuod Ebiasaf, wuod Kora, to gi jorit rangeye kaachiel kode moa e anywolane, ma jokora, tijgi ne rito rangeye man gohinga mag Hema mana kaka wuonegi nosebedo katimo tijno mar rito rangach midonjogo e kar dak mar Jehova Nyasaye.
Kaw remb rwadhno moko kendo iwirie tunge kendo mar misango gi lith lweti to modongʼ to ipuk e bwo kendo mar misangono.

Harun nochiw misango mar pwodho tunge kendono dichiel e higa. Chiwo mar higa ka higa mar pwodhruok nyaka tim gi remb misango mar golo richo ni tienge duto mabiro. Kendono nobed maler moloyo ni Jehova Nyasaye.”

Bangʼ mano jadolono nomien remo moko e tunge kendo mar misango miwangʼoe ubani e nyim Jehova Nyasaye manie Hemb Romo. To remb rwadhno modongʼ nopuki e tiend kendo mitimoe misango miwangʼo pep manie dho Hemb Romo.
Kane Reuben odok e bugo mane owit e Josef kendo oyudo ni Josef onge kanyo, noyiecho lepe.
Eka Jakobo noyiecho lepe, morwako pien gugru kendo noywago Josef wuode kuom ndalo mangʼeny.
Joshua wuod Nun kod Kaleb wuod Jefune, ma gin achiel kuom joma ne odhi nono piny Kanaan, noyiecho lepgi
Mi gichal gi buya mayot-yot, yaye Nyasacha, mi gichal gi mihudhwe ma yamo tero.
Ka okudhogi gi muche to giner mi kalausi dhi kodgi ka mihudhwe, nikech gichalo gi kodhi mokom machiegni, ma tiendgi pok ochwowo lowo.

“En ngʼa mosejiwo ngʼat maa yo wuok chiengʼ, kaluonge kuom tim makare mondo otim tichne? Ochiwo ogendini e lwete kendo oloyo Ruodhi e nyime. Otiekogi gi liganglane ma gichal gi buru kendo okeyogi gi asere mana ka mihudhwe ma yamo tero.
To ne ok ginyal dewo kendo tokgi ne tek mana kaka kweregi mane ok oketo genogi kuom Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachgi.
“To kwerewa, nobedo jongʼayi kendo joma tokgi tek, mine ok giluoro chikegi.

Negitamore winji kendo ne ok giparo honni mane itimo e diergi. Tokgi nobedo matek kendo e ngʼanyo margino ne giyiero jatelo mondo gidog gibed wasumbini. To in Nyasaye maweyone ji richogi, ma jangʼwono kendo maneno ne ji lit, iyi bende ok wangʼ piyo kendo hera mari ogundho.
Omiyo koro sani kaw gigi mag lweny kaka atungʼ kod asere kendo idhi e thim ikelna ring le.
To in, kendo kaka ngʼama duongʼne owetene, amiyi lowo mane akawo kuom jo-Amor gi ligangla kod atungʼ.”
Ne amiyo kibaji omakogi ma giringo e nyimu, kaachiel gi ruodhi jo-Amor ariyo. Ne ok utimo ma gi liganglau uwegi kod atungʼ.
Lea nomako ich kendo nonywolo wuowi. Nowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye oseneno chandruokna, kendo koro chwora biro hera.” Omiyo nochake ni Reuben.
E ndalo kayo ngano, Reuben nodhi e puothe kendo noyudo olembe mag mandrake, mi nokelo ne Lea min mare. Rael nowacho ne Lea niya, “Kiyie to miya olemb mandrake ma wuodi Reuben okelonino.”
Kane oyudo Israel dak kuno, Reuben nodhi moterore gi Bilha jatich ma nyako mar wuon-gi mi Israel nowinjo wachno.
Nyasaye nogologi Misri; tekogi chalo gi teko jowi.
“Nyasaye nogologi Misri; kendo gin gi teko machalo mar jowi. Gikidho oganda jowasikgi kendo gituro chokegi matindo tindo; kendo gichwowogi gi aserni mag-gi.

Joka Josef nochal gi rwath makayo, tungene nochal mana ka tung jowi manie thim, ma obiro chuowogo ogendini moriembgi nyaka tunge piny duto. Tungego gin ji alufu apar mag Efraim kod ji alufu apar mag jo-Manase.

Neuru ni onge dichwo kata dhako, anywola kata dhoot moro e dieru kawuono ma chunye lokore weyo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachwa kadhi lamo nyiseche mag jopinjego; bende neuru ni onge yath manyago olemo makech mar richo.
Mzabibu margi wuok e mzabibu ma Sodom kendo wuok e puothe mag Gomora. Olembegi opongʼ gi kwiri kendo olembegi kech.
Obiro nyodho kwiri mag thuonde madongo; kendo leke thuond fu man-gi kwiri maricho biro nege.
Kendo Ibrahim nodak e piny jo-Filistia kuom kinde mangʼeny.
Kendo nomedo wacho niya, “Wan kod lum kod chiemb ngamia mangʼeny kaachiel gi ot ma unyalo nindoe.”
Ne en kod pith mag jamni kod pith mag dhok kod jotich mangʼeny mi nyiego nomako jo-Filistia kode.

(Og ruodh Bashan kende e ngʼama ne odongʼ e dier jomane otony kuom jo-Refai. Otandane ne olos gi nyinyo; borne ne oyombo fut apar gadek kendo lachne fut auchiel. Otandaneno pod ni Raba piny jo-Amon nyaka chil kawuono).
Piny Jazer, mier matindo duto mag Gilead kod nus mar jo-Amon mochopo Aroer machiegni gi Raba;
Mier mamoko ne gin: Kiriath Baal (tiende ni, Kiriath Jearim), kod Raba. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo ariyo.
Tongʼno nodhi nyime koa Shefam nyaka Ribla mantiere yo wuok chiengʼ mar Ain kendo nomed dhi nyaka kuonde moridore mantiere yo wuok chiengʼ mar Nam Kinereth.

Farao Neko noterogi e twech Ribla e piny Hamath mondo kik obed ruoth kodak Jerusalem kendo nochuno jo-Juda mondo ochiw osuru mar fedha ma pekne romo kilo alufu adek gi mia angʼwen kod dhahabu ma pekne romo kilo piero adek gangʼwen.
kendo gimako ruoth. Ne gitere Ribla ir ruodh Babulon, kendo kanyo ema nongʼadne buch twech.
Bethuel nonywolo Rebeka. Yawuowi aborogo ema Milka nonywolone Nahor owadgi Ibrahim.
Kane pok otieko lemo, Rebeka notucho kotingʼo dapige e goke. Ne en nyar Bethuel wuod Milka, mane chi Nahor owadgi Ibrahim.
Rebeka ne nigi owadgi miluongo ni Laban, kendo Laban noringo matek ka dhi ir ngʼatno mane ni e sokono.

Eka Eliakim wuod Hilkia, Shebna kod Joa nowachone Rabshake jatend lweny niya, “Yie iwuo gi jotichni gi dho jo-Aram, nimar wawinjo dhokno. We wuoyo kodwa gi dho jo-Hibrania nikech joma ni e ohinga nyalo winjo gik miwachonwa.”

To Rabshake jatend lweny nodwokogi niya, “Uparo ni un kod ruodhu kendu ema ne ruodha oora iru mondo awachnu wechegi, to ok ne joma obedo ei ohinga; bende ungʼeyo ni jogo kaachiel gi un biro bangʼo chiethgi kendo madho lachgi?”

Nyalo bedo ni Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi biro winjo weche duto mag Rabshake jatend lweny, ma jatende ma ruodh Asuria oseoro mondo oyany Nyasaye mangima, kendo obiro kwere kuom weche mane Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu osewinjo kowacho. Kuom mano, in Isaya, lamne ji mane otony ma pod ngima.”
Eka noparo lek mane oleko kuomgi kendo nowachonegi niya, “Un okwach kich! Kendo usebiro mondo une-ane kama pinywa nyapgodo.”
Waduto wan yawuot ngʼat achiel. Jotichgi gin joma kare, ma ok okwach kich.”
Josef nowachonegi niya, “En mana kaka ne awachonu: Un okwach kich!
Ludh duongʼ ok noa e lwet Juda kata odunga mar teko ok noa e tiende, nyaka wuon loch ma biro rito ogendini duto chopi kendo luor mar ogendini nobed kuome.
Kane Jakobo osetieko wacho wechegi ni yawuote kamano nodwoko tiende e kitanda, mi chunye nochot kendo noluwo kwerene.
Los ratege molworore angʼwen mag dhahabu ne mesano kendo twegi e konde angʼwen mag mesa kama tiende angʼwen-go nitie.

Nyis jo-Israel ni: Ja-Israel moro amora kata jadak moro amora manie dieru manochiw nyathine moro amora ni nyiseche manono miluongo ni Molek, nyaka negi. Oganda jo-Israel duto mondo ogoye gi kite nyaka otho.
Ngʼato angʼata kuomu madichwo kata madhako ma en ajuok nyakalondo kata ma ajwoga moro amora, to ugo gi kite nyaka otho. Giduto nyaka ugogi gi kite kendo rembgi nobedi e wigi giwegi.
“Gol ngʼat moseyanyano oko mar kambi. Ji duto mane nitie koyenyo mondo giket lwetgi e wiye kendo kanyakla mar jo-Israel duto okaw kite ochielego.”
to jadolo nyaka gol chik mondo ngʼat matuono okelne winy ariyo maler mangima michamo gi yiend sida, gi usi makwar kod bad owino.
Eka jadolo nokaw winyo ma pod ngima gi yiend sida, gi usi makwar kod bad owino, kendo lutogi duto e remb winyo mane osenegno.
Mondo jadolo opwodh odno, nyaka okaw winy ariyo, yiend sida moko gi usi makwar kod owino.
E sa mane gilwore mar abiriyo ka jodolo ne pod goyo turumbete matek, Joshua nochiko ji kawacho niya, “Koguru matek, nimar Jehova Nyasaye osemiyou dala maduongʼni!
Koguru gi mor ni Jehova Nyasaye, un piny duto, weruru kod ilo gi dwol mamit;
werneuru gi turumbete kod tung im maywak matek, koguru gi mor e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Ruoth.
Ibrahim notingʼo wangʼe malo kendo noneno ji adek machwo kochungʼ bute. Kane onenogi, noringo matek koa e dho hema mondo oromnegi kendo nopodho piny auma e nyimgi.
Eka noringo odhi e dipo kendo noyiero nyarwath mopugno kendo nomiyo jatich molose piyo.
Jatich Ibrahim noringo kadhi romone mi owachone niya, “Akwayi, yie imiyae pi mondo amodhi.”
Negikendo nyi Moab, ma achiel ne nyinge Orpa, to machielo Ruth. Kane gisedak kuno kuom kinde madirom higni apar,
Kane giwinjo ma, ne giywak kendo. Eka Orpa nogone wuon odgi oriti, to Ruth to notwere kode.
Ruth nodwoke niya “We chuna mondo aweyi kata apogra kodi. Kuma idhiyo ema an bende abiro dhiye, kendo kama idakie ema abiro dakie. Jogi ema nobed joga kendo Nyasachi ema nobed Nyasacha.
Omiyo ne giwuok kendo neginono pinyno kochakore Thim mar Zin nyaka Rehob, kagichomo Lebo Hamath.
Nodhi nyaka Abdon, Rehob, Hamon kod Kana, mochopo nyaka Sidon Maduongʼ.
Uma, Afek kod Rehob. Giduto ne gin mier matindo kod gwenge piero ariyo gariyo.
Eka notho moyweyo gi kwerene mi noyike e dala Daudi wuon-gi. Rehoboam wuode nobedo ruoth kare.
Rehoboam nodhi Shekem, nimar jo-Israel duto nodhi kuno mondo okete ruoth.
Omiyo negioro joote ir Jeroboam mi en kaachiel gi oganda duto mar Israel nodhi ir Rehoboam mi giwachone niya,
ka gin kanyakla gi Zerubabel, Jeshua, Nehemia, Seraya, Relaya, Modekai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum kod Baana.
Rehum ma jatend lweny kod Shimshai ma jagoro nondiko baruwa marach kuom Jerusalem ne Artaksases ma ruoth kama:
Rehum ma jatend lweny kod Shimshai ma jagoro, kanyakla gi jogo mamoko mane gitiyogo, ma gin jongʼad bura kod jotelo motelone joma oa Tripolis, Pasia, Erek, Babulon kod jo-Elam moa Susa,
Kendo nokadho e nyim Musa kohulo niya, Jehova Nyasaye, Jehova Nyasaye, ma jangʼwono kendo ma kecho ji, ahora mos bende agundho gihera kod adiera,
Nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu en Nyasaye ma jangʼwono ok enojwangʼu kata tiekou kata wiye wil kod singruok mane otimo gi kwereu kokwongʼore.

Ka udwogo ir Jehova Nyasaye eka joweteu gi nyithindu notimnegi ngʼwono mi nowegi giduogi e pinygi kod joma noterogi e twech nikech Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu en jangʼwono kendo en gihera maduongʼ omiyo ok noloknu ngʼeye ka udwogo ire.”
Eka Jakobo nopenjogi niya, “Ongima?” Negidwoke niya, “Ee, ongima, kendo mabiro gi rombe cha en Rael ma nyare.”
Kane pod oyudo owuoyo kodgi, Rael nochopo gi romb wuon-gi nikech en ema nokwayogi.
Kane Jakobo oneno Rael, nyar Laban ner mare kod romb Laban, nodhi mongʼielo kidi oko e dho soko kendo omiyo romb ner mare omodho.
Eka nyar Farao nodhi e aora Nael mondo olwokre, ka jotichne to ne wuotho e geng aora. Nyar Farao noneno oserano ka ni e kind odundu, mine ooro jatichne ma nyako mondo ogeme.

Chiengʼ mar abiriyo nyaka oliel yie dende duto kaka yie wiye, gi yie tike kod yie wangʼe, kaachiel gi yie dende mamoko duto. Bangʼe nyaka olwok lepe kendo olwokre gi pi, eka koro nobed ngʼama opwodhore chuth.
“ ‘Ka ngʼama dende chwer ongʼulo olawo kuom ngʼama ler, ngʼatni nyaka luok lepe kendo olwokre, kendo nobed mogak nyaka chop odhiambo.
Kendo dhawo nowuok e kind jakwadh Abram kod jokwadh Lut. E kindeno jo-Kanaan kod jo-Perizi ne pod odak e pinyno.
Lal pach joma timbegi richo, yaye Ruoth, mi lewgi moki e dandgi, nikech aneno ka mahundu gi dhawo opongʼo dala maduongʼ.
Ngʼat ma iye wangʼ piyo medo miero, to ngʼat ma terore mos kweyo dhawo.
Yaye Juda nyathina, ichalo nyathi sibuor, modwogo koa dwar. Obuto ka sibuor madhako monindo piny, maonge ngʼama nyalo chiewo.
Ogandani ger mana ka sibuor madhako; kendo gijuol ka sibuor madichwo, ma ok nyal nindo piny nyaka ocham gima onego momadh rembe.”
Gilidho ka ginindo piny mana ka sibuor madichwo, bende mana ka sibuor madhako maonge ngʼama nyalo chiewo? “Mad joma ogwedhi gwedhi to joma kwongʼi mondo okwongʼ!”
Eka Rebeka kod jotije ma nyiri noikore moidho ngamia-gi mi gidhi gi jatich Ibrahim. Kuom mano jatich Ibrahim nokawo Rebeka kendo gidhi.
Omiyo jotije Abisalom notimo ni Amnon kaka nosechikgi. Eka yawuot ruoth duto nochungʼ moidho kanjegi moringo.
Eka nodhi moidho gache mar lweny moringo odhi Jezreel nikech Joram ne ni kuno kendo Ahazia ruodh Juda bende noyudo ni kuno kaka wendone.
Joriemb geche gi Farese bende nodhi kode. Ne en gi oganda maduongʼ.
Eka ne oikne geche mar jolweny, bangʼe nokawo jolweny mage.
Nokawo geche mia auchiel mabeyo mag lweny, kod geche mamoko mag jo-Misri ka moro ka moro nigi jatend lweny.
Chiege ne nyinge Ahinoam nyar Ahimaz. Jatend jolweny ne Abner wuod Ner, Ner ne en owadgi wuon Saulo.
Wuon Saulo ma Kish gi wuon Abner ma wuon Ner ne yawuot Abiel.
Kane Saulo orango Daudi e sa mane odhi rado gi ja-Filistia, nopenjo Abner mane jatend jolweny niya, “Abner wuowini en wuod ngʼa?” Abner nodwoko niya “Yaye ruoth, akwongʼora e nyimi ni ok angʼeye.”
Mier mamoko ne gin: Gibeon, Rama, Beeroth,
ka ok okwan mier matindo mokiewo kodgi mochopo nyaka Baalath Beer (ma bende iluongo ni Rama e piny Negev). Magi e mier mane opog ne dhood Simeon kaluwore gi anywolagi.
Bangʼe nodwok tongʼno chien nyaka Rama modhi nyaka e dala maduongʼ mar Turo mochiel gohinga, mogomo kochiko Hosa koluwo dho nam e gwengʼ mar Akzib,
Twangʼ gik mongʼinore kaka olemo molos gi usi marambulu gi maralik kod makwar kendo ket gara mar dhahabu e kindgi
Gara mag dhahabugo kod gik mongʼinore kolemogo nobed kokikore molworo riak law.
Negiloso gik mongʼinore kaka olemo molos gi usi marambulu gi maralik, law momin mayom e riak lawno.
Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain kod Rimon. Giduto ne gin mier gi gwenge maromo piero ariyo gochiko.
Mier mamoko ne gin: Ain, Rimon, Ether kod Ashan. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge maromo angʼwen,
Bangʼe nodhi nyime gi yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka Gath Hefer kod Eth Kazin; bangʼe nowuok oko e Rimon mi ogomo yo Nea.
Omiyo negimedo kok matek mi gingʼolore gi ligangla kod tonge, kaka ne en timgi nyaka rembgi nomol.
joka Juda, mane otingʼo kuodi gi tonge ne gin ji alufu auchiel gi mia aboro (6,800) mane oikore ne lweny;
Noketo okumbini kod tonge e miechgi duto kendo nomiyo gibedo motegno. Kuom mano jo-Juda kod jo-Benjamin ne joge.
Kendo Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Piny mondo onywol gik mangima kaka kitgi obet: Jamni, kod gik moko duto mamol e lowo, kod le mag bungu, mana kaka kit moro ka moro obet.” Kendo nobet kamano.
Nyasaye noloso le mag bungu kaka kitgi obet; jamni kaka kitgi obet kendo gi gik mamol e lowo kaka kitgi obet. Nyasaye noneno ni mano ber.
Kuom mano Jehova Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Abiro nego dhano duto masechweyo e wangʼ piny kaachiel gi le kod gik mamol duto kod winy mafuyo e kor polo nimar dine ber ka dine ok achweyogi.”
Koa e dhood Gad nomi: Ramoth mantiere Gilead (ma en dala maduongʼ mar pondo ne ngʼatno miparo kuome ni oneko), gi Mahanaim,
Ruodh Israel nosenyiso jodonge niya, “Donge ungʼeyo ni Ramoth Gilead en marwa to onge gima watimo mondo wakawe kuom ruodh Aram?”
Omiyo nopenjo Jehoshafat, “Ibiro dhi konya kedo gi jo-Ramoth Gilead?” Jehoshafat nodwoko ruodh Israel niya, “Wan joka ngʼato achiel, joga gin jogi, faresena gin fareseni.”
Ne ituono joma ool pi modho kendo ne ipando chiemo ne joma odenyo,
nimar otieko riyo mar joma riyo oloyo kendo omiyo joma odenyo yiengʼ gi gik mabeyo.
nokelo joma odenyo mondo odag kuondego, kendo negigero dala kama neginyalo dakie.
Koro kech nomako pinyno kendo Abram nodhi Misri mondo odhi odag kuno kuom kinde matin nikech kech ne duongʼ.
Koro ne nitie kech maduongʼ e piny; bangʼ kech mokwongo mane obedo e ndalo Ibrahim kendo Isaka nodhi Gerar ir Abimelek ruodh jo-Filistia.
Dhok abiriyo maricho modhero mane obiro bangʼe nyiso higni abiriyo, kendo kamano e kaka wiye cham abiriyo motho ma yamb oro otwoyo; gin higni abiriyo mag kech.
To jokwath mag Gerar nolaro pig-no gi jokwadh Isaka kagiwacho niya, “Pigni en marwa.” Kuom mano Isaka nochako sokono ni Esek (tiende ni kar dhawo) nikech ne gilare kode
Jogi gin jokwath; gikwayo jamni, kendo gisebiro kod kwethgi kod dhogi kod gigegi duto.’
to nyaka uwachne ni, ‘Jotichgi osebedo jokwath chakre tindowa, mana kaka kwerewa notimo.’ Eka ibiro yienu mondo udag e gwengʼ Goshen, nikech jo-Misri ok ohero jokwath.”
Ada nonywolone Esau Elifaz, to Basemath nonywolo Reuel,
Magi e nying yawuot Esau: Elifaz wuod Esau mane Ada onywolone, kod Reuel wuod Esau mane Basemath onywolone.
Yawuot Reuel ne gin: Nahath, Zera, Shama kod Miza. Magi ema ne nyikwa Basemath chi Esau.
“Yaye Jehova Nyasaye, piny noyiengni, kendo polo nogingore, mi koth ochwe kane iwuok Seir e piny Edom.
Piny notetni kendo oyiengni, mise mag polo noyiengni; negitetni nikech nokecho.
piny noyiengni kendo polo noolo koth e piny, e nyim Nyasaye, Jal man Sinai, e nyim Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel.
to ngʼatno mane ogocho ok nomok e wachno ka machielono ochungo mi owuotho oko gi ludhe; to kata kamano, nyaka ochul ngʼat mohinyoreno kuom thuolone mokethore kendo one ni ochango chutho.
Ka bur omako ngʼato mi ochango,
en ema oweyoni richoni duto kendo ochango tuocheni duto,
E higa mar apar gangʼwen, Kedorlaomer kod ruodhi mane oriwore kode nodhi omonjo kendo oloyo jo-Refai man Ashteroth Karnaim, jo-Zuzim e Ham gi jo-Emi man Shave Kiriathaim,
jo-Hiti, jo-Perizi, jo-Refai,
Jo-Emi kod jo-Anak ji ne luongogiga ni jo-Refai, to jo-Moab to ne luongogi ni jo-Emi.
“ ‘Ka ngʼato ogoyo wadgi gi gima olos gi chuma, motho, to en janek; omiyo janekno nyaka negi.
Kata ka ngʼato nigi kidi e lwete manyalo nego ngʼato, mi ogoyogo wadgi motho, to en janek; omiyo janekno nyaka negi.
Kata ka ngʼato otingʼo gimoro molos gi yien e lwete, mi ogoyogo wadgi motho, en janek; omiyo janekno nyaka negi.
(E kindeno Jehova Nyasaye nochako oro Rezin ruodh Aram to gi Peka wuod Remalia mondo omonj jo-Juda.)
Eka Rezin ruodh Aram kod Peka wuod Remalia ruodh Israel nowuok dhi gore gi Jerusalem mi omako Ahaz, to ne ok ginyal loye.
E kindeno Rezin ruodh Aram ne odwogo Elath e lwet Aram koriembo jo-Juda. Bangʼe jo-Edom nodonjo Elath kendo gidak kuno nyaka chil kawuono.
Ne arwaki gi lewni mogorie gik mabeyo kendo ne arwakoni wuoche akada mayom. Ne arwakoni law mayom kendo ne aumi gi lewni ma nengogi tek.

Omiyo ne ilichori gi fedha kod dhahabu, kendo lepi nolosi gi usi mayom gi usi mapek ma nengone tek kod nanga mogorie gik mabeyo. Chiembi to ne mogo moreg mayom gi mor kich kod mor zeituni. Ne imedo bedo dhako ma jaber manomiyo ibedo ruoth madhako.
Kendo ne ikawo lepi mogorie gik mabeyo mi irwakonegi kendo ne iketo moya gi ubanina e nyimgi.
Eka Ibrahim nosudo machiegni kode kendo openjo niya, “Bende ditiek joma kare machal gi joma timbegi richo?
Eka Farao noluongo Musa gi Harun. Nowachonegi niya, “Koro aseketho. Jehova Nyasaye ni kare, to an kaachiel gi joga wasetimo richo.
Nochiwo siem ne kanyakla mar oganda niya, “Suduru mabor gi hembe jogo ma timbegi richo! Kik umul girgi moro amora, ka ok kamano to ubiro lal nono nikech richo mag-gi.”
Shem nonywolo: Elam, Ashur, Arfaksad, Lud kod Aram.
Aram nonywolo: Uz, Hul, Gether kod Meshek.
Uz wuowi makayo, Buz owadgi, Kemuel (wuon Aram),
Mana kaka bor polo rumo mi lal nono, e kaka ngʼat miyiko e liel ok duogi.
Giboyo moyombo polo, koro in to ditimie angʼo? Gitut moloyo bur liel; koro in to ditimie angʼo?
“Mad ne ipanda ei liel mondo ne abed maonge nyaka chop mirimbi rum, bangʼe to iket kinde ma ibiro parae kendo!
Ne en gi wuowi miluongo ni Saulo, ne en rawera ma jaber e kind jo-Israel bende ne en rabora ma ji moko ne rem mana e goke.
Chiengʼ moro punde mag Kish wuon Saulo nolal kendo Kish nowachone wuode ma Saulo niya, “Kaw achiel kuom jotich mondo udhigo udwar punde.”
Kane gichopo e gwenge mag Zuf, Saulo nowachone jatich mane ni kode niya, “Bi wadogi, dipo ka wuora oweyo paro punde kendo mochako mana parowa.”
Nyikwa Jehoyakin mane onywol ka en e twech ne gin: Shealtiel,

Bangʼe malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye nochiko Gad mondo onyis Daudi odhi malo kar dino cham ma Arauna ja-Jebus mondo oger kendo mar misango ni Jehova Nyasaye.

Nowuok kuno modhi e piny Asuria kuma nogeroe Nineve, Rehoboth-Ir, gi Kala,
Eka Pul ruodh Asuria nomonjo pinyno, mi Menahem nomiye fedha ma pekne romo kilo alufu mia adek mondo Pul okonyego jiwo lochne obed motegno.

Menahem nochuno joma ne nigi mwandu e Israel mondo ogol pesano. Ngʼato ka ngʼato kuomgi nyaka ne chiw pesa ma pekne romo nus kilo mar fedha mondo mi ruodh Asuria. Omiyo ruodh Asuria noa e pinyno modok thurgi.
nimar Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu modak e dieru en Nyasaye ma janyiego kendo mirimbe ochomou kendo obiro tiekou e wangʼ piny.
Kane un Horeb ne ujimbo mirimb Jehova Nyasaye mane iye owangʼ modwaro tiekou.
Ne aluoro mirima kod kum mager mar Jehova Nyasaye, nimar mirima nomake ahinya mar tiekou. To kata kamano nowinjo ywakna kendo.
Yawuot Reuel ne gin: Nahath, Zera, Shama kod Miza. Magi ema ne nyikwa Basemath chi Esau.
Yawuot Reuel wuod Esau ne gin: Jaduongʼ Nahath, Zera, Shama kod Miza. Magi e jodongo ma nyikwa Reuel mane odak Edom; bende ne gin nyikwa Basemath chi Esau.
Eka Jesse noketo Shama mondo okadhi, to Samuel nowacho niya, “Kata mana ngʼatni bende Jehova Nyasaye ok oyiero.”
E kindeno Hana nomako ich monywolo wuode. Nochake ni Samuel kowacho niya, “Nikech ne akwaye Jehova Nyasaye.”
Samuel to ne tiyo, e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ka en wuowi matin korwako law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod.
To Jehova Nyasaye ne mor gi Hana; kendo nomako ich monywolo yawuowi adek gi nyiri ariyo. To Samuel nodongo e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.
Kar chakruok Nyasaye nochweyo polo gi piny.
Nyasaye noluongo gima nopogo pigno ni “polo.” Piny noyuso kendo noru, ma en chiengʼ mar ariyo.
Kendo Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Pi manie bwo polo mondo ochokre kaachiel, kendo lowo motwo obedie.” Kendo notimore kamano.
Timuru machal kamano ni rwethu kod rombeu. Weuru gibed gi minegi kuom ndalo abiriyo, to chiengʼ mar aboro miyagiuru.
Chiengʼ mar aboro Musa noluongo Harun gi yawuote kaachiel gi jodong Israel.
Chiengʼ mar aboro, nyathino nyaka ter nyangu.
Nochako omako ich, monywolo wuowi moro. Nowacho niya, “Jehova Nyasaye osemiya wuowi machielo nimar nowinjo ka chwora ok ohera.” Omiyo nochake ni Simeon.
Bangʼ ndalo adek kane pod gin kod rem, yawuot Jakobo ariyo, Simeon kod Lawi mowete Dina, nokawo gigegi mag lweny mi gidonjo e dala jogo apoya kendo ginego joma chwo duto.

Eka Jakobo nowacho ne Simeon gi Lawi niya, “Usekelona chandruok maduongʼ ka umiya nying marach e kind jo-Kanaan kod jo-Perizi, ma weg pinyni. Wan ji manok, kendo kagiriworenwa mondo giked kodwa e lweny, to an kod oda ibiro tieka.”
Yawuot Gershon kaluwore gi dhoodgi ne gin: Libni kod Shimei.
Magi ema ne nying joka Gershon: Libni gi Shimei.
Ka ruoth Daudi nochimo Bahurim, ngʼat moro moa e dhoodgi Saulo nobiro koa kuno. Nyinge ne Shimei wuod Gera, nowuok kowacho weche mag kwongʼ.
To wach Nyasaye nobiro ne Shemaya ngʼat Nyasaye niya:
Shekania nonywolo Shemaya: Yawuot Shemaya ne gin: Hatush, Igal, Baria, Nearia kod Shafat. Giduto ne gin ji auchiel.
kod Ziza wuod Shifi, ma wuod Alon, ma wuod Jedaya, wuod Shimri, wuod Shemaya.

Nikech wach mane owacho kuluworegi wach Jehova Nyasaye kuom kendo mar misango man Bethel kendo kwongʼ mane okwongʼogo kuonde duto motingʼore malo mitimoe misango manie dala man Samaria biro chopo kare.”
Nongʼiewo gode mag Samaria gi Shemer gi fedha ma dirom kilo piero abiriyo kendo mogero dala maduongʼ e got, miluongo ni Samaria, kochake Shemer nying wuon godno.
Omri noyweyo gi kwerene mi noyike Samaria, kendo Ahab wuode nokawo lochne kaka ruoth.
Kane chiengʼ podho, Abram nogore e nindo matut kendo mudho mandiwa noime.
Kane chiengʼ osepodho kendo piny oyuso, tago mar mach madum iro kod chuk mach maliel nothinyore mi okadho e kind lemo mag gik manoyangʼ ka.
Kane ochopo kamoro, nobworo gotieno nikech chiengʼ nosepodho. Nonindo kanyo moteno wiye gi kidi moro mane okwanyo kanyo.
Dhakono nonywolo wuowi kendo nochake ni Samson. Nodongo kendo Jehova Nyasaye nogwedhe,
Samson nodhi Timna kendo noneno nyako ma pod tin ma nyar jo-Filistia.

Wuon-gi gi min-gi nodwoke niya, “Donge nitiere nyako modimbore kuom wedeni kata kuom jowa duto? Ochuno ni nyaka idhi ir jo-Filistia ma ok oter nyangu mondo iyude dhako?” To Samson nowachone wuon-gi niya, “Miya gouru. En ema owinjore koda.”
Pinje mokwongo mag pinyruodhe ne gin Babulon, Erek, Akad kod Kalne e piny Shinar.
Kane gidhi yo wuok chiengʼ, negiyudo pap moro e piny Shinar mine gidak kanyo.
E kindeno Amrafel ruodh Shinar, Ariok ruodh Elasar, Kedorlaomer ruodh Elam kod Tidal ruodh Goyim
To ka onyise kit richo ma osetimo, to nyaka okel nywok maonge songa mondo otimnego misango kuom ketho chik.
Nyis jo-Israel kama: ‘Kawuru nywok maonge songa mondo utimgo misango mar golo richo, to nyaroya gi nyarombo mahikgi achiel kendo maonge songa mondo uchiw kaka misango miwangʼo pep.
Eka Harun nokelo misango mane ji ochiwo. Nokawo nywok mane ibiro timgo misango mar golo richo ni oganda, noyangʼe kendo nopwodhogo richogi mana kaka notimo gi misango mokwongo.
kendo jo-Hori manie gode mag Seir, mane ochwe nyaka El-Paran machiegni gi piny motimo ongoro.
Jakobo nooro joote nyime ir owadgi Esau e piny Seir, gwengʼ mar Edom.
Kuom mano ruodha akwayi ni tel e nyim misumbani, to aluwi mos mos gi nyithindo kod jamni nyaka achop iri Seir.”

“Ka ngʼato oketho mi otimo richo mar oyiem kaluwore gi chike maler mag Jehova Nyasaye, to nyaka okel ne Jehova Nyasaye im maonge songa kendo man-gi nengo kaluwore gi rapim mar shekel mar kama ler mar lemo. En misango michiwo mar pwodhruok e ketho.

Nyaka ochul nengo mar gima ne ok ochiwo kaluwore gi chike maler, kendo bende omedi achiel kuom abich mar nengono kendo ochiwe duto ne jadolo, mabiro kawo imno kendo otimnego misango mar pwodhruok e ketho eka nowene richone.
En misango mar pwodhruok e ketho; nikech osetimo marach e nyim Jehova Nyasaye.”
Malaika ariyogo nochopo Sodom kar angʼich welo kendo Lut noyudo obet e dhoranga dalano. Kane onenogi, noa malo mondo mi opodho auma e nyimgi.
Efron ja-Hiti noyudo obet piny e kind jog-gi kendo nodwoko Ibrahim ka jo-Hiti duto ma nobiro e dhoranga dalano winjo.
nodoko mwandu mag Ibrahim e nyim jo-Hiti duto mane obiro kaka joneno e dhoranga dala.
(Tworo gi shairi nokethore chuth, nimar noyudo ka shairi oseketo wangʼe, to tworo nosethiewo.

“ ‘Ka ngʼato ochiwo ne Jehova Nyasaye bath lope moro, to nyaka nengone romre gi nengo kodhi ma inyalo chwo e puodhono. Nengo kodhi mar shairi midhi chwo e lowono nyaka rom abiriyo ma en shekel piero abich mar fedha.

to chworeno nyaka tere ir jadolo bed ni dhakono osedwanyore adier kata chwore chich mana kode kayiem. Bende nyaka oter chiwo mar achiel kuom apar mar efa mar mogo mar shairi e lo jaode. Ok onego ool mo kuome kata keto gima dungʼ tik mangʼwe ngʼar kuome, nikech en chiwo mar cham mar ketho chich, tiende ni en chiwo mifwenyogo adiera.
koa e dhood Simeon, ne en Shafat wuod Hori;
Bende wir Jehu wuod Nimshi obed ruodh Israel, kendo iwir Elisha wuod Shafat ma ja-Abel Mehola mondo okaw kari kaka janabi.
Omiyo Elija nowuok kanyo modhi oyudo Elisha wuod shafat. Nopuro gi rwedhi motwe e jok apar gariyo kendo en owuon ema nochwado rwedhi machien. Elija nodhi machiegni kendo nobolo lawe mar abola kuome.
mar angʼwen ne en Adonija wuod Hagith; mar abich ne en Shefatia wuod Abital;
mar abich ne en Shefatia wuod Abital; to mar auchiel ne en Ithream wuod chiege miluongo ni Egla.
Ibneia wuod Jeroham; Ela wuod Uzi, wuod Mikri kod Meshulam wuod Shefatia, wuod Reuel, wuod Ibnija.

Wuogi e kambi kendo iwuoth kichomo bungu man e gode mag jo-Amor, dhi e miech ji duto mokiewo gi Araba, jogo modak e gode, jogo modak e tie gode man yo podho chiengʼ, jogo modak Negev kod mago modak e dho nam, kaachiel gi jogo modak e piny Kanaan kod Lebanon, nyaka chop e aora maduongʼ mar Yufrate.

Omiyo Joshua nokawo gwengʼno duto kaachiel gi piny manie got ma en Negev, e tiend gode ma yo podho chiengʼ, to gi kuonde mag pewe kaachiel gi ruodhigi duto. Onge joma notony. Notieko jogo duto mangima, mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye, ma Nyasach Israel, nosechiko.
Omiyo Joshua nokawo pinyni duto; kaka, piny manie got, piny Negev duto, gwenge duto mag Goshen, tiend gode ma yo podho chiengʼ, Araba kod gode duto mag Israel kaachiel gi pewe mag
E higa mar apar gaboro mar lochne, ruoth Josia nooro jagoro ma en Shafan wuod Azalia, ma wuod Meshulam, e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kowacho niya,
Hilkia jadolo maduongʼ nowachone Shafan ma jagoro niya, “Aseyudo kitap chike e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye.” Nomiye mosome.
Eka Shafan ma jagoro nodhi ir ruoth mowachone niya, “Jodongi osechulo pesa mane nitiere e hekalu mar Jehova Nyasaye kendo gisechiwogi e lwet jotich kod jotend hekalu.”
Eka Jakobo noyiecho lepe, morwako pien gugru kendo noywago Josef wuode kuom ndalo mangʼeny.

Rizpa nyar Aiya nokawo pien gugru mopedho ewi lwanda mondo obedie, chakre ndalo keyo nyaka koth nochako chue ka goyo ringre jogo. To noriembo winy mafuyo godiechiengʼ kod le mawuotho gotieno mondo kik cham ringregi.
Jodonge nowachone niya, “Ne, wasewinjo ni ruodhi mag jo-Israel ngʼwon. Yie wadhi ir ruodh Israel ka watweyo pien gugru e nungowa kendo ka watweyo tonde e wiwa. Dipo ka okechi.”
Ngʼato angʼata moriwore gi joma osekwan nyaka chiw nus shekel kaluwore gi kweno mar shekel manie kama ler mar lemo, ma pekne romo kilo auchiel. Nus shekel mochiwo nobed mar Jehova Nyasaye.

fedhago ema nochok kane ngʼato ka ngʼato mane okwan ogolo nus shekel kaluwore gi rapim mar kama ler mar lemo nimar kar romb joma nokwan machwo mahikgi oromo piero ariyo kadhi nyime ne gin ji alufu mia auchiel gadek mia abich gi piero abich (603,550).

“Ka ngʼato oketho mi otimo richo mar oyiem kaluwore gi chike maler mag Jehova Nyasaye, to nyaka okel ne Jehova Nyasaye im maonge songa kendo man-gi nengo kaluwore gi rapim mar shekel mar kama ler mar lemo. En misango michiwo mar pwodhruok e ketho.
Kane Isaka osedak kuno kuom kinde mangʼeny, Abimelek ruodh jo-Filistia nongʼicho gie dirisa moneno ka Isaka gi Rebeka chiege jotugo.
“Min Sisera ne ngʼicho gie dirisa; kaywak kama: ‘Angʼo momiyo gache odeko kapok obiro? Angʼo momiyo mor mar gechene ok winjre?’

E kinde mane Sandug Muma mar Jehova Nyasaye donjo e Dala Maduongʼ mar Daudi, Mikal nyar Saulo nongʼicho gie dirisa. Kendo kane oneno Ruoth Daudi kachikore kendo miel aduwa e nyim Jehova Nyasaye, nochaye gi chunye.
Kik ibed gi wach e bura mar miriambo kendo kik umi ngʼat maonge ketho ngʼadne buch tho, nimar ok anangʼwon ne ngʼat ma bura oloyo.
kata gimoro amora mane okwongʼoree gi miriambo. Nyaka ochul gigo duto mi omedie achiel kuom abich mar nengogi kendo mondo ochiwgi duto ne wuon-gi chiengʼ mochiwoe misango mipwodhego e kethoneno.
“ ‘Kik ikwongʼri gi miriambo ni ngʼato gi nyinga nimar kitimo kamano to ichayo Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu. An e Jehova Nyasaye.
Mirima nomako Farao gi jotichge ariyogo, ma gin jotend jagam divai kod jatend joma tedo makati.
To nyaka iyier joma niginyalo ma gin ji moluoro Nyasaye, joma ogen ma ok kaw asoya, kendo iketgi gibed jotend ji maromo alufu alufu, mia mia, piero abich abich, kod apar apar.
Balaam nowachonegi niya, “Ninduru ka kawuono kendo abiro miyou dwoko ma Jehova Nyasaye omiya.” Omiyo jotend jo-Moab nobedo kode.
Nikech lwet Nyasachwa mar ngʼwono ne ni kuomwa, ne gikelonwa Sherebia, ngʼatno man-gi nyalo, koa e nyikwa Mali wuod Lawi, wuod Israel, kod yawuot Sherebia gi owetene, ji apar gaboro;
Eka ne awalo jodolo motelo apar gariyo, kanyakla gi Sherebia, Hashabia kod owetegi apar,
Jo-Lawi mane opuonjo ji chike ka jogo ochungʼ kanyo ne gin: Jeshua, Bani, Sherebia, Jamin, Akub, Shabethai, Hodia, Maseya, Kelita, Azaria, Jozabad, Hanan kod Peleya.
Nyasaye nomedo wachone Ibrahim niya, “Koro ok inichak iluong Sarai chiegi ni Sarai, to iniluonge ni Sara.
Ibrahim nopodho auma; monyiero kowacho e chunye niya, “Bende ngʼama ja-higni mia achiel nyalo nywolo wuowi? Bende Sara ma ja-higni piero ochiko nyalo nywolo nyathi?”
Eka Nyasaye nodwoke niya, “Ooyo, en mana Sara chiegi ema nonywolni wuowi, kendo iniluong nyinge ni Isaka. Anaket singruokna kode kaka singruok manyaka chiengʼ ne nyikwaye.
Nosidho ogut mula e wiye kendo norwako koti mar lweny mar mula ma pekne oromo kilo piero abich gi abiriyo,
Eka Saulo norwako Daudi gi lawe owuon. Norwakone koti mar lweny kendo nosidhone ogudu mar mula e wiye.
To ngʼat moro noywayo atungʼ mare modiro asere ma nochwowo ruodh Israel e kind law lweny mane orwako. Ruoth nonyiso jariemb gache niya, “Lok garini mondo igola ka, nimar ahinyora marach.”
Zadok wuod Ahitub gi Ahimelek wuod Abiathar ne jodolo; Seraya ne jagoro;
Jatend jolweny marito ruoth nomako Seraya jadolo maduongʼ, gi Zefania jadolo maluwe kod ji adek ma jorit dhoot hekalu moterogi e twech.

Kane jatend jolweny duto kod jogi nowinjo ni ruodh Babulon oseyiero Gedalia kaka jatelo maduongʼ, negibiro ir Gedalia e dala miluongo ni Mizpa. Jogo ne gin Ishmael wuod Nethania, Johanan wuod Karea, Seraya wuod Tanhumeth ja-Netofath, Jazania ja-Maakath kod jogegi.
Jo-Juda bende nokawo Gaza, Ashkelon kod Ekron, ka dala maduongʼ moro ka moro nigi gwengʼe.
Eka Roho mar Jehova Nyasaye nobiro kuome gi teko. Nodhi Ashkelon, monego ji piero adek ma omagi gigegi mi ochiwo kandhe ne jogo mane owacho tiend ngero. Nodhi e od wuon ka en gi mirima.
Magi e dhahabu molos ka buche mane jo-Filistia oorone Jehova Nyasaye ka misango mipwodhruokgo e ketho ka moro ka moro ochungʼ kar Ashdod, Gaza, Ashkelon, Gath kod Ekron.
To wangʼ ring rwadhno gi piene kaachiel gi wen oko mar kambi. En misango mar golo richo.
“ ‘Ringʼo morere e gimoro amora mogak, kik cham, to nyaka wangʼ e mach. To ringʼo mamoko modongʼ to inyalo cham gi ngʼato angʼata maler.

Eka Musa nowacho ne Harun kod yawuote ma Eliazar gi Ithamar niya, “Kik uwe wiu bed mogar, bende kik uyiech lepu, nono to ubiro tho kendo Jehova Nyasaye iye biro wangʼ gi ogandani duto. To wedeu kaachiel gi jo-Israel duto to nyalo ywago joma Jehova Nyasaye osetieko gi mach.
“ ‘Kata ka ngʼato omulo gimoro makwero, bed ni en le mar bungu motho kata gik mamol motho, ka ok ongʼeyo, mi ofwenye achien, to enodok jaketho.
“ ‘Kute duto mafuyo kendo mawuotho gi tiende angʼwen nobednu gik makwero.
To gik moko duto mafuyo kod mago man-gi tiende angʼwen, nobednu gik makwero.
Jo-Juda modongʼ biro chalo gi yath matero tiendene piny kendo nyago olemo e bedene.
tiendene olawore e lwendni, kendo kere e dier kama otimo kite.
Kata obedo ni tiendene towo kendo miyo osikene tho,
Ka Mahalalel ne ja-higni piero auchiel gabich, nonywolo Jared.
Ka Jared ne ja-higni mia achiel gi piero auchiel gariyo, nonywolo Enok.
Jared notho kane en ja-higni mia ochiko gi piero auchiel gariyo.
Ogwedh ngʼat ma kethone owene, kendo ma richone oseruchi.
Ogwedh ngʼatno ma Jehova Nyasaye ok kwan-ne richone, kendo ma wuondruok onge e chunye.
Ogwedh joma odak e odi; mosiko ka paki. Sela
Adam nobedoe achiel gi chiege, kendo chiege nonywolo wuowi mi nochake ni Seth, mowacho niya, “Nyasaye osemiya nyathi machielo kar Abel mane Kain onego.”
Seth bende nonywolo wuowi, kendo nochake ni Enosh. E ndalono ema ne ji ochako luongo nying Jehova Nyasaye.
Ka Adam nosedak kuom higni mia achiel gi piero adek, nonywolo wuowi machal kode, kendo nochake ni Seth.
Eka Lea nowacho niya, “Amor manade! Mon biro luonga ni jahawi.” Omiyo nochake ni Asher.
Yawuot Zilpa jatich Lea madhako ne gin: Gad kod Asher.
Yawuot Asher ne gin: Imna, Ishva, Ishvi kod Beria. Nyamin-gi ne en Sera. Yawuot Beria ne gin: Heber kod Malkiel.
Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Nowa niya, “Donj ei yie, in kaachiel gi joodi, nikech aseyudo ni in ngʼat makare e kind ogandani.
Kendo Nowa gi yawuote gi chiege kod mond yawuote nodonjo ei yie mondo otony ne pi mar ataro.
nobiro ir Nowa kendo nodonjo kodgi ei yie mana kaka Nyasaye nochike.
kendo asepongʼe gi Roho mar Nyasaye mondo obed gi lony, gi rieko, gi nyalo kod ngʼeyo tije duto mag lwedo;
kendo osepongʼe gi Roho mar Nyasaye, mondo obed gi lony, gi rieko, gi nyalo kod ngʼeyo tije duto mag lwedo;
Kuom mano Bezalel, Oholiab kod jotich duto molony mane Jehova Nyasaye omiyo rieko gi nyalo mar ngʼeyo kaka itiyo tich duto mar gero kama ler mar lemo nyaka ti mana kaka Jehova Nyasaye osechiko.”
Tongʼ pinyno nochopo nyaka Tabor, Shahazuma gi Beth Shemesh, mi ogik nyaka aora Jordan. Giduto ne gin mier kod gwenge apar gauchiel.

Noluongo Barak wuod Abinoam moa Kedesh man Naftali kendo owachone niya, “Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel, chiki ni, ‘Dhiyo, ikaw ji alufu apar mag Naftali kod Zebulun kendo itelnegi ka udhi e Got Tabor.
Kane ginyiso Sisera ni Barak wuod Abinoam nosedhi Got Tabor,

Otingʼo jachan malo kogolo e buru kendo otingʼo ngʼama odhier malo kogolo e ipidh yugi; omiyo gibedo kaachiel gi yawuot ruodhi bende omiyo gibedoe kombe moyiedhi. “Nimar mise mag piny gin mag Jehova Nyasaye, kanyo ema oserenjoe piny ngima.
Kude mag nam kod mise mag piny noelore, kane Jehova Nyasaye okwerogi kokudho gi much ume.
Un ji duto manie piny, beduru gi e nyime! Piny osegur motegno kendo ok noyienge.
Kendo nomedo wacho niya, “Wan kod lum kod chiemb ngamia mangʼeny kaachiel gi ot ma unyalo nindoe.”
Kuom mano ngʼatno nodonjo e ot kendo misike mane ngamia otingʼo nogol kuomgi. Nomigi lum kod chiembgi mi nokelo pi ne jatich Ibrahim kod joge mondo olwokgo tiendegi.
“Kik uchak umi jo-Israel lum magilosogo matafare; to nyaka une ni giomo lum kendgi giwegi.
Ger Hemb Romoni gi gigene duto machalre mana gi kido ma abiro nyisi.
Nyaka ine ni igerogi machal gi kido mane onyisi ewi got.
mondo kik ubed jo-mibadhi ka uloso nyisecheu uwegi, kata kido moro amora mochwe ka dichwo kata ka dhako,
Mukuru kendegi mag misengini, touru kitegi mopa milamo kendo tongʼuru sirnigi mag Ashera.
Ma e gima onego utimnegi: Mukuru kendegi mag misengini, touru kitegi mopa milamo, tongʼuru sirnigi mag Ashera kendo wangʼuru kido mag-gi milamo e mach.
Mukuru kendegi mag misango, touro kitegi ma gilamo kendo wangʼuru sirni mag-gi mag Ashera e mach; ngʼaduru matindo tindo kido mag nyisechegi kendo ugol nying-gi oko kuonde duto.
“ ‘Ka ochiwe ka gir goyo erokamano, to ochiwe kaachiel gi makati ma ok oketie thowi moted gi mo, kod chapat ma ok oketie thowi mowir gi mo, gi kek moted gi mogo mayom kendo modwal gi mo.
Bende enokel misango mar lalruok mar goyo erokamano kaachiel gi makati moted gi thowi.
Ring misango mar goyo erokamano nyaka cham mana odiechiengno mochiwe ma ok oriyo nyaka okinyi.
Kata kamano, jomoko kuomgi ne ok odewo wach Musa, negikano moko nyaka okinyi, to negiyudo ka kudni opongʼo chiemono kendo negichako dungʼ. Kuom mano Musa ne iye owangʼ kodgi.
to koro ere kaka dhano ma kudni akudani dichal e nyime?”
An to an mana kudni ma ok dhano, ngʼama ji duto jaro kendo ma ji ochayo.

Eka tongʼno nodhi nyime koluwo Jordan kendo nogigi e Nam Chumbi.

Tongʼno nodhi nyaka Debir koa e Holo mar Akor mi ogomo kochiko nyandwat nyaka Gilgal, mangʼiyore gi Pass mar Adumim mantiere yo milambo mar holono. Nodhi nyime koluwo dho aora mar En Shemesh mochopo nyaka En Rogel.
“Or jomoko odhi onon piny Kanaan, ma onego ami jo-Israel. Koa e dhoot ka dhoot manie oganda inior achiel kuom jotendgi.”
Magi e nying chwo mane Musa ooro mondo onon piny Kanaan. (Musa nomiyo Hoshea wuod Nun nying ni Joshua.)
Omiyo joma Musa ne oseoro mondo odhi onon pinyno, mi odwogo kendo omiyo oganda duto ma timbegi richogi ongʼur kode kaluwore gi wach marach mane gikelo kuom pinyno;
Ka gin gi larruok moro amora e kindgi, to ikelona kendo athego joma ochwanyorego mi anyisgi buche kod chike mag Nyasaye.
Puonjgi buche kod chike duto kendo nyisgi kaka onego gidagi kod tije monego gitim.
Jehova Nyasaye nonyiso Musa niya, “Bi ira ewi got mondo ibed ka kendo anamiyi kite mopa masendikoe chike kod buche mondo ipuonj oganda.”

Bangʼ kinde moko, nyar Shua ma chi Juda notho. Kane Juda osetieko weche mag liel, nodhi nyaka Timna ir joma ne lielo yie rombege kendo nodhi gi Hira ja-Adulam ma osiepne.
Kane owach ne Tamar ni kwar mare owuok dhi Timna ngʼado yie rombe,

nolonyo lawe mar chola oko, moumore gi suka mondo olok kite eka ne odhi mobet e dhorangach madonjo Enaim, mantie e yo madhi Timna. Nikech noneno ni kata obedo ni Shela koro osebedo ngʼama duongʼ, to ne ok omiyego mondo obed chwore.
Juda nokendone Er, wuode maduongʼ dhako kendo niluonge ni Tamar.

Eka Juda nowacho ne Tamar chi wuode niya, “Dhi dag e od wuonu kaka dhako ma chwore otho nyaka chop Shela wuoda bed maduongʼ.” Nikech noparo niya, “En bende onyalo tho mana kaka owetene.” Kuom mano Tamar nodhi odak gi wuon mare.
Kane owach ne Tamar ni kwar mare owuok dhi Timna ngʼado yie rombe,
E kor ot molworo hekalu, e udi ma iye gi udi ma oko, nopayoe kido mar kerubi, gi mag yiend othidhe kod thiepe maupe.
E dhoudi ariyogo mag yiend zeituni nopayoe kerubi, gi yiend othidhe kod thiepe maupe, kendo nobawo kerubi kod yiend othidhego gi dhahabu moleny.
Noketo kido mar kerubi gi sibuor kod yiend othidhe e bethe rachungi kod bepe kamoro amora mane ni thuolo, gi kido mar maua e alworane duto.
Ketgi duto e lwet Harun gi yawuote kendo ofwagi e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mifwayo.
Bangʼ ka isekawo agoko mar im mitimogo nyasi mar walo Harun, fwaye e nyim Jehova Nyasaye kaka misango mifwayo kendo mano nobed lemo ma kori.
“Pwodh lemo mag im mane otimgo misango mar walo Harun kod yawuote ma gin agoko kaka misango mifwayo gi em mane ochiw.
Kane chiengʼ osepodho kendo piny oyuso, tago mar mach madum iro kod chuk mach maliel nothinyore mi okadho e kind lemo mag gik manoyangʼ ka.
Migawo mar jower mar ariyo nowuotho kochiko komachielo. Ne aluwogi nyaka ewi ohinga malo, kaachiel gi nus mar ji ka gikalo kama Oger Motingʼore gi Malo mar Kendo mag Mach nyaka e Ohinga Malach,
E sa ma ibiro chopoe, to ibiro miyo gichal gi kendo mar mach mager. Jehova Nyasaye biro mwonyogi kuom mirimbe mager, kendo mach mare biro tiekogi.
Achalo ngʼama nonywol kaachiel gi ondiegi, bende achalo osiep tula.
To pod ne igoyowa agoya mimiyo ondiegi olawowa; kendo ne iumowa gi mudho mandiwa.
Ondiegi noywagre kuondegi mane gigeno, kibwe to noywe e ute mabeyo mag ruoth. Ndalo mag Babulon osekayo machiegni ma ok notony.
Eka Miriam janabi madhako ma nyamin Harun, nokawo oyieke e lwete kendo mon duto noluwo bangʼe ka gin gi oyieke kendo ka gimiel.
Daudi kod dhood Israel duto ne miel gi tekregi duto e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ka giwer gi thumbe gi nyatiti gi orutu gi oyieke gi kayamba gi nyiduonge.
Daudi kod jo-Israel duto ne miel gi tekregi duto e nyim Nyasaye ka gimor gi-ilo ka giwer gi thumbe gi nyatiti gi orutu gi oyieke gi kayamba kod turumbete.
Kane pundano oneno malaika mar Jehova Nyasaye kochungʼ e chuny yo kotingʼo ligangla e lwete, nobaro oko mar yo modhi e puodho. Balaam nogoye mondo oduog e wangʼ yo.

Gisegero kuonde motingʼore malo mar Tofeth e Holo mar Ben Hinom mondo gi wangʼ yawuotgi kod nyigi e mach ma en gima ne ok achiko, kata ne ok odonjo e pacha.
Omiyo bed motangʼ, ndalo biro, Jehova Nyasaye owacho, ma ji ok nochak oluonge ni Tofeth kata Holo mar Ben Hinom, to ni Holo mar Yengʼo, nimar giniyik joma otho ei Tofeth maonge thuolo modongʼ.
Ka turumbete ariyogi oywak, to ogandagi mondo ochokre e nyimi e dhoranga Hemb Romo.
Ka turumbete achiel kende ema oywak, to jotelo mag oganda, jo-Israel nyaka chokre e nyimi.

Ruoth nowachone Itai ja-Giti niya, “Angʼo momiyo idhi kodwa? Dogi mondo ibed gi Ruoth Abisalom. In ngʼama wendo, moringo koa e pinygi.

To Itai nodwoko ruoth niya, “Akwongʼora gi nying Jehova Nyasaye mangima kendo akwongʼora ni ruodha ma en ruoth ni kamoro amora ma ruodha ma en ruoth nobedie, bed ni en kar ngima kata kar tho, to kanyo bende ema jatichni nobedie.”
Daudi nowachone Itai niya, “Wuoth wadhi.” Omiyo Itai ja-Giti nowuotho gi joge duto gi joutegi mane ni kode.
“Wach ni jo-Israel ni: ‘E odiechiengʼ mokwongo mar dwe mar abiriyo, nyaka ubed gi odiechieng yweyo; ma en odiechieng chokruok mowal kaka rapar kugoyo turumbete.
Eka gouru turumbete kamoro amora e odiechiengʼ mar apar mar dwe mar abiriyo, kendo Odiechieng Pwodhruokno gouru turumbete e gwengeu duto.
Ka turumbete oywak, to dhoudi mantie yo wuok chiengʼ nyaka chak wuoth.
Kane Nahor ja-higni piero ariyo gochiko nonywolo Tera.
Kendo bangʼ kane osenywolo Tera, Nahor nodak higni mia achiel gapar gochiko kendo nonywolo yawuowi kod nyiri mamoko.
Bangʼ ka Tera nosedak higni piero abiriyo nonywolo Abram, Nahor kod Haran.
Koro ngʼatni ma nyinge ne Mika neni gikare mar lemo, kendo noloso law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod kod nyisechegi kendo noketo achiel kuom yawuote kaka jadolo.

Eka chwo abich mane obiro nono piny Laish nowachone owetegi niya, “Bende ungʼeyo ni achiel kuom udigi nigi law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod, nyiseche moko manono, kod kido mobaw gi fedha mag nyiseche manono? Koro ungʼeyo gima onego utim.”

Ji abich mane osetimo nonro matut mar pinyno nodonjo ei ot mokawo kido mopa machalo gi law mayom mar dolo miluongo ni efod, gi nyiseche manono mag udi, kod mago mopa, ka jadolo kod jolweny mia auchiel to ochungʼ e dhorangach.

Abidan wuod Gideoni, ma jatend joka Benjamin, nokelo misango mare e odiechiengʼ mar ochiko.
E higa mar ochiko mar loch Hoshea, ruodh Asuria nokawo Samaria kendo nomako jo-Israel motero e twech Asuria. Nomiyogi kar dak Hala kod Gozan man but Aora Habor kaachiel gi mier mag Medes.
Eka Nyasaye noyawo wengene kendo oneno soko mar pi. Kuom mano nodhi mopongʼo puga gi pi kendo nomiyo nyathi omodho.
Ibrahim nonyiso Abimelek chandruok mar soko mar pi ma jotich Abimelek nomaye githuon.
Noketo ngamia onindo piny machiegni gi soko but dala; ne en kar angʼich welo, seche mamon dhi umbo.
Kinyne gokinyi mangʼich Ibrahim nokawo chiemo kod puga mar pi kendo nomiyo Hagar. Noketonegi e goke kendo ogole odhi gi wuode. Hagar nowuok modhi kendo nobayo abaya e thim mar Bersheba.
Mano emomiyo kanyo iluongo ni Bersheba nikech ji ariyogo notimo singruok kanyo.
Bangʼ ka winjruok nosetim Bersheba, Abimelek kod Fikol ma jatend jolwenje nodok e piny jo-Filistia.
Pinje mokwongo mag pinyruodhe ne gin Babulon, Erek, Akad kod Kalne e piny Shinar.
Ruodh Asuria nokelo ji koa Babulon, Kutha, Ava, Hamath kod Sefarvaim moketogi gidak e miech Samaria mondo gikaw kar jo-Israel. Negikawo Samaria ma gidak e mieche duto.
Nyiseche mane gilamo e magi: Ji mane oa Babulon noloso Sukoth-Benoth, ji mane oa Kutha noloso Nergal to ji mane oa Hamath noloso Ashima;
Kendo Nyasaye nowacho niya, “Piny mondo onywol gik mangima kaka kitgi obet: Jamni, kod gik moko duto mamol e lowo, kod le mag bungu, mana kaka kit moro ka moro obet.” Kendo nobet kamano.
Nyasaye noloso le mag bungu kaka kitgi obet; jamni kaka kitgi obet kendo gi gik mamol e lowo kaka kitgi obet. Nyasaye noneno ni mano ber.
Eka Nyasaye nowacho niya, “We wachwe dhano e kido machal kodwa kendo gibed gi teko ewi rech mae nam kendo gi winy mae kor polo, ewi jamni, ewi piny duto kendo ewi chwech duto mawuotho ewi lowo.”

Yangʼ imno kendo ikaw rembe moko mi imien e it Harun ma korachwich kod it yawuote ma korachwich kod lith lwetgi mathuon ma korachwich kod lith tiendegi ma korachwich, to remo modongʼ to ikir e bath kendo mar misango moluoro.
Musa moyangʼo imno kendo nokawo remb imno moko momieno e it Harun ma korachwich, gi lith lwete mathuon ma korachwich kod lith tiende mathuon ma korachwich.

Eka bangʼe Musa nochungo yawuot Harun, kendo nomieno remo e itgi ma korachwich gi lith lwetgi mathuon ma korachwich kod lith tiendegi mathuon ma korachwich. Remo modongʼ to ne okiro e bath kendo mar misango moluoro.

To kaka ne osengʼeyo oganda ma Modekai ae, ne ochayo wach nego mana Modekai kende. Kar timo mano, Haman nodwaro yo monyalo tiekogo oganda gi Modekai duto, ma gin jo-Yahudi, e pinyruodh Ahasuerus duto.
An to an mana kudni ma ok dhano, ngʼama ji duto jaro kendo ma ji ochayo.
Nikech pok ochayo kata ojaro sandruok mar joma winjo malit; pok opandone wangʼe to osewinjo ywakne mar dwaro kony.
Chiwgi mana e kama Jehova Nyasaye biro yiero e kind jo-dhoutu, kendo kanyo ema itimie gik moko duto ma achiki.

Unucham gigo kama Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu biro yiero, in kaachiel gi yawuoti kod nyigi, jotichgi machwo kod ma nyiri, gi jo-Lawi manie miechu, kendo nyaka ubed mamor e nyim Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachu kuom gik moko duto ma lwetu timo.
to inyalo loko mwandugo pesa mondo iter kama Jehova Nyasaye ma Nyasachi biro yiero.

Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya, “Nyis Harun ni, ‘Kaw ludhi mondo irie badi ewi pige mag Misri, ma gin aore matindo kod madongo, yewni kod kuonde duto mag kano pi, kendo gibiro lokore remo.’ Remo biro bedo kamoro amora e piny Misri nyaka ei agulni molos gi kite.”
Eka Jehova Nyasaye nowacho ne Musa niya; “Nyis Harun kama: ‘Rie ludhi ewi aore, sokni kod yewni, kendo ogwende nowuog maim piny Misri duto.’ ”
To bende nomiyo piny ongoro odoko yewni mag pi, kendo lowo motwo nolokore sokni mamol;
Eka Juda nodhi ire kendo owachone niya, “Yaye ruodha, yie mondo jatichni owuo kodi. Kik ikech gi jatichni kata obedo ni tekoni mar loch romre gi mar Farao owuon.
kendo nowacho ne Musa niya, “Yaye, ruodha, kik iwe wachul gowi mar richo kata obedo ni wasetimo gima ofuwoni.

To Gideon nodwoke niya, “Ruodha, ka Jehova Nyasaye nikodwa, to angʼo momiyo magi duto osetimorenwa? Ere honni duto mane kwerewa onyisowa kagiwacho ni, ‘Donge Jehova Nyasaye ema nogolowa e piny Misri?’ To koro Jehova Nyasaye osejwangʼowa mi oketowa e lwet jo-Midian.”
